title.en: It was Dolly Parton's proudest legacy. Now an Australian town must keep it alive
title.zh: 这是多莉·帕顿最值得骄傲的遗产。现在，澳大利亚小镇必须保持活力

summary.en: In Australia, Dolly Parton's legacy extends far beyond music, touching the lives of 151,000 children.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
In the regional NSW city of Tamworth, more than 3,000 children are reading more books because of Dolly Parton — a mark of Australia's connection to the legendary country singer, actor and philanthropist that runs deeper than one might initially think.

Parton died on Wednesday morning at 80. Tributes have poured in from around the world, but in Tamworth, the loss is more personal.

The city, dubbed the country music capital of Australia, holds an official sister-city bond with Parton's adopted hometown of Nashville and hosted Parton herself on her last Australian tour in 2014.

"It's an incredible nod to us that she would come here when most stars are looking for the big 70,000-seater auditoriums, whereas ours is 5,000 seats," Cheryl Brown, from the Tamworth Country Music Festival, told SBS News.

"So for her to come here, she certainly validated us as the country music capital and that saw us being an important part of country music here in Australia."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But it's her gift of the Imagination Library program, one of Parton's most personal philanthropic projects, that has really transformed Tamworth.

Founded in 1995 as a tribute to her illiterate father, Dolly Parton's Imagination Library is a free book-gifting program — now running across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Ireland, and Australia — that mails new, age-appropriate books to children from birth until they turn five, completely free of charge.

It has gifted more than 300 million books to children since it started 31 years ago. In Australia, more than two million of those books have been delivered to 151,000 children across 480 communities since its launch here in 2013.

In Tamworth, where the program has run since 2019, its ambassador Lisa Rennie says it has fundamentally changed how children relate to reading and literacy.

"Children from birth to the age of five are eligible to receive the books, which are chosen by qualified speech pathologists and early literacy teachers," Rennie told SBS News.

"There are currently about 3,500 children on average on the program in the Tamworth region."

Since 2019, more than 98 per cent of children born in Tamworth have been enrolled.

Families sign up at no cost, ensuring accessibility for those experiencing disadvantage — books are posted to each home each month, and caregivers are also given reading guidance sheets to help foster lifelong reading in families.

About 70 per cent of those books are by Australian authors and 10 per cent by First Nations authors.

title.en: The antisemitism royal commission hearings are over. What happens now?
title.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会听证会结束了。现在会发生什么？

summary.en: After months of evidence, the antisemitism royal commission will enter its final phase before delivering a report in December.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
After more than 340 witnesses were called to give evidence across 62 days, the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion hearings have concluded.

The inquiry was established in response to the Bondi Beach terror attack, in which 15 people were killed during a Hanukkah celebration last December. It was tasked with investigating the circumstances of the attack, the impact of antisemitism on Jewish Australians and how social cohesion can be promoted.

The ninth and final block of hearings concluded on Wednesday , after examining how social cohesion could be understood, measured and promoted.

The inquiry will now turn to preparation of a final report, authored by commissioner Virginia Bell, who will summarise submissions, analyse evidence, establish facts and make recommendations.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As with the interim report released in April, some material may remain confidential because of national security concerns or to avoid prejudicing criminal proceedings.

The sole surviving alleged gunman, Naveed Akram, has been charged with terror and murder offences, in a case that is separate from the commission. He has yet to enter a plea.

The commission does not determine criminal guilt or impose criminal penalties. It can, however, refer matters to law enforcement or prosecuting authorities.

Its recommendations will be considered by governments, which will decide whether and how to implement them.

Bell was due to submit her final report by 14 December — the one-year anniversary of the shooting — but she has requested a four-day deadline extension.

That request was in response to concern from Australia's Jewish community that the report coming out on the day of the anniversary of the attack would be a distraction from memorials.

Leaders of Australia's Jewish community expressed gratitude for those who gave evidence at the commission, often at a personal cost.

The commission heard directly from roughly 14,000 community members through evidence submitted in person and in writing, Bell said.

Executive Council of Australian Jewry co-chief Peter Werheim said the community had put its heart and soul into the commission.

"Hundreds of people have told the truth about their everyday experience of antisemitism, and thousands more have provided detailed accounts through written submissions. We thank everyone who has made a contribution. The commissioner has a great deal of evidence to weigh, and we trust her to do that carefully."

body.zh: 在 62 天内传唤了 340 多名证人提供证据后，皇家反犹太主义和社会凝聚力委员会听证会结束了。 该调查是为了回应去年 12 月光明节庆祝活动期间发生的邦迪海滩恐怖袭击事件，造成 15 人死亡。它的任务是调查袭击的情况、反犹太主义对犹太澳大利亚人的影响以及如何促进社会凝聚力。 在审查了如何理解、衡量和促进社会凝聚力后，第九次也是最后一次听证会于周三结束。 调查现在将转向准备一份由专员弗吉尼亚·贝尔撰写的最终报告，她将总结提交的意见，分析证据，确定事实并提出建议。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 与四月份发布的中期报告一样，出于国家安全考虑或避免损害刑事诉讼，某些材料可能会保持机密。 唯一幸存的枪手纳维德·阿克兰 (Naveed Akram) 被指控犯有恐怖罪和谋杀罪，该案件与该委员会无关。他尚未提出抗辩。 该委员会不确定刑事罪名或判处刑事处罚。但是，它可以将问题提交给执法机构或检察机关。 其建议将由各国政府考虑，并决定是否以及如何实施这些建议。 贝尔原定于 12 月 14 日（枪击事件一周年纪念日）之前提交最终报告，但她请求将截止日期延长四天。 这一要求是为了回应澳大利亚犹太社区的担忧，即在袭击周年纪念日发布的报告会分散人们对纪念活动的注意力。 澳大利亚犹太社区的领导人对那些在委员会提供证据的人表示感谢，而这些证据往往是由个人付出的。 贝尔说，委员会通过亲自和书面提交的证据直接听取了大约 14,000 名社区成员的意见。 澳大利亚犹太人执行委员会联席主席彼得·韦海姆 (Peter Werheim) 表示，社区已全身心投入该委员会。 “数百人讲述了他们日常反犹太主义经历的真相，还有数千人通过书面意见提供了详细的叙述。我们感谢所有做出贡献的人。专员有大量证据需要权衡，我们相信她会谨慎行事。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: A $1.4 billion question: The case for a new tax on Australians
title.zh: 价值 14 亿美元的问题：对澳大利亚人征收新税的理由

summary.en: Fresh research is adding weight to a proposal that has long divided experts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A Griffith University study published in BMJ Public Health on Wednesday found a levy applied to non-alcoholic drinks with added sugar, such as soft drinks and most juices, could prevent 3.7 million cases of tooth decay, 191,000 cases of gum disease, and 115,000 cases of complete tooth loss across Australia over the next 25 years.

The study suggested that tax revenue could be used to strengthen health services and to implement a universal health care approach to dental care, but co-author Lennert Veerman said the benefits would extend beyond oral health.

"The study also estimates a 20 per cent sugar tax would generate approximately half a million health-adjusted life years for the 2019 Australian population over their lifetime, both from dental health improvements and reductions in weight-related illness," the Griffith University public health professor said.

As of 2017–2018, approximately 9.1 per cent of Australians adults reported drinking sugar-sweetened beverages every day, while nearly one-third of Australians aged 15 and older had untreated tooth decay or cavities, according to the study.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Using a computer-based simulation, researchers found that for every 1 per cent increase in the price of sugar-sweetened drinks, consumption was expected to drop by 1.2 per cent.

Assuming a 20 per cent tax is passed on in full to consumers, the study predicted the price increase would result in a 24 per cent reduction in consumption.

Marco Peres from SingHealth Duke-NUS in Singapore said the findings highlighted the oral health benefits of sugar taxes.

"It does not rely solely on individuals changing their behaviour but helps create an environment in which healthier choices become easier.

"This is particularly important if we want prevention strategies to reach the whole population and reduce health inequalities." 

Oral diseases are a growing public health concern, affecting approximately 3.5 billion people globally.

The study found that oral diseases contributed to 2.4 per cent of Australia’s total health burden — the impact of a health problem on a population — and ranked among the top 10 diseases.

According to the World Health Organization, 116 countries have an excise tax on at least one type of sugar-sweetened beverage. The study notes there is a high level of support among the Australian public for policies that reduce sugar intake.

In 2018, the United Kingdom introduced a tax of 19.4 or 25.9 pence per litre, depending on the sugar content of beverages.

title.en: Northern Territory MP Luke Gosling steps down as defence envoy after assault charge
title.zh: 北领地议员卢克·高斯林在袭击指控后辞去国防特使职务

summary.en: Gosling says he "categorically denies" the charges against him and will defend himself in court.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A Labor politician in the Northern Territory has stood aside from an envoy role after he was charged by police for a second time.

Darwin-based Luke Gosling, who holds the federal seat of Solomon, is facing fresh accusations of breaching his bail conditions.

He was originally charged in July with the assault of Northern Territory Administrator David Connolly, the jurisdiction's equivalent to a state governor.

In a statement on Wednesday, Gosling announced his decision to step down until the matters have been dealt with in court.

"Due to the ongoing media attention and the distraction this is causing to the business of government, I have decided to temporarily stand aside as Special Envoy for Defence, Veterans' Affairs and Northern Australia," Gosling said in a post on social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I am more committed than ever to my role serving the people of Darwin and Palmerston."

Gosling vowed to "rigorously" defend himself against the charges in court and strongly denies the allegations.

Gosling was charged on Tuesday with one count of breach of bail and is due to appear in Darwin Local Court on 30 September.

Earlier on Wednesday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said the prime minister faced an even "stronger test" of his leadership since charges were first laid.

"[Anthony Albanese] must act. It's completely unacceptable for a second charge to be placed on Luke Gosling. He should be stood down," he told ABC News Breakfast.

"Presumption of innocence is important in our system, but he should be stood down whilst these proceedings continue."

The assault is alleged to have occurred at the NT Thailand Grand Festival in Darwin on 18 July, with Gosling posting photos from the event on social media that day.

"You've gotta get punted, mate. I don't know, let's see what Mr Albanese does," he told News24.

NT Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro said the matter was for Albanese to deal with.

"Ultimately, if all of these allegations are true, it clearly doesn't meet the expectation of our community," she told ABC radio.

Gosling's lawyer, Marty Aust, has previously criticised police for arresting the politician at his home rather than issuing him a summons or notice to appear.

As part of his bail conditions, Gosling is banned from going within 50 metres of the NT's Government House building and must give the administrator's office 48 hours' notice before attending any event where the two men would be present.

If they are at an event together, the Labor politician must not be within 15m of Connolly.

summary.en: Despite falling to its lowest level in eight months, inflation is still higher than consensus expectations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia's headline inflation rate has come in above expectations despite falling to its lowest level in eight months.

The consumer price index rose 1 per cent in July, with the annual rate of inflation falling to   3.5   per cent, the Australian Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday.

Largely as a result of a decline in the growth of electricity prices, headline inflation was down from 3.8 per cent in the year to June and the lowest level since November.

Worryingly for the Reserve Bank, trimmed mean inflation — a measure of underlying inflation that strips out volatile items — held steady at 3.6 per cent, above expectations for a fall to 3.5 per cent.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Housing was the largest contributor to inflation, up 5 per cent, said ABS head of price statistics Rachael McCririck.

"New dwellings prices rose 5.7 per cent in the 12 months to July as builders passed on higher costs for materials and labour," she said.

Fuel prices rose 7.5 per cent in the month after falling for three months in a row.

"This was driven by higher world oil prices and the partial unwinding of the federal government's fuel excise relief measures in July," McCririck said.

Food and non-alcoholic beverages were also strong contributors in the month, rising 3.2 per cent, as well as recreation and culture, which rose 2.6 per cent.

Minutes from the RBA's August board meeting, released on Tuesday, showed the board was concerned about upside risks to inflation.

title.en: Should Australian travellers be worried? What 22 years of runway incidents reveal
title.zh: 澳大利亚跑道警示：22年数据揭示了什么

summary.en: Recent safety incidents at Sydney Airport, including four close calls within three weeks, have prompted a deep dive into 22 years of aviation data. Investigators are examining whether runway incursions and taxiing collisions are becoming more frequent at Australia's busiest transport hub.
summary.zh: 悉尼机场近期在三周内发生了四起险些相撞的事故，引发了对跑道安全的高度关注。调查人员正在分析过去22年的航空数据，以确定在澳大利亚最繁忙的交通枢纽，跑道入侵和滑行碰撞事故是否正变得更加频繁。

body.en:
Four close calls on Sydney Airport runways in as many weeks have put air traffic management in the spotlight.

It's too early to determine the exact cause of each one. But four ground-safety occurrences at Australia's busiest airport in a little over three weeks raise an obvious question: how common are occurrences like these, and are they becoming more frequent?

To examine the broader pattern, I analysed Australian Transport Safety Bureau data from 2003 to 2025 for Australian commercial air transport, focusing on runway incursions (the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle or person in a protected runway area) and taxiing collisions or near collisions (an aircraft colliding or nearly colliding with another aircraft, person or object while taxiing).

The most recent incident occurred just after 8am last Tuesday, when two planes were given permission to use the same runway at the same time. Luckily, one plane stopped when its pilot saw the other plane.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A little over a week earlier, on 9 August, there were two more incidents in less than three hours.

At 7.20am, a Jetstar Airbus A320 preparing to depart for the Gold Coast encountered an empty Qatar Airways Boeing 777 being towed across a taxiway. Both planes stopped abruptly. One Jetstar cabin crew member sustained a serious injury.

Then, at about 10am, a Virgin Australia Boeing 737 bound for Perth began its take-off sequence on a runway as a Qantas 737 crossed another runway ahead. Both crews reported having received the relevant clearance from air traffic control. The Virgin crew stopped as air traffic control cancelled its take-off clearance.

On July 27, air traffic control cleared a Qantas Boeing 737 to cross a runway while a smaller plane was still landing. Air traffic control detected the issue and alerted both crews, with the 737 stopping after passing the holding point.

The Australian Transport Safety Bureau investigates and reports on safety incidents involving planes, helicopters, trains and boats. These incidents include those that happen during taxiing, takeoff and landing.

Raw counts of reported occurrences can be misleading because aviation activity has varied substantially, particularly during the COVID pandemic. More flying creates more risk. So I also calculated occurrence rates per million flight hours, for both domestic aviation and all commercial air transport, which includes domestic aviation as well as other forms of aviation such as freight and charter.

For domestic aviation, analysis of the annual data from 2003 to 2025 shows a significant increasing underlying trend in both the number and rate of taxiing collisions or...
body.zh: 数周内悉尼机场跑道发生四次险情，使空中交通管理成为人们关注的焦点。 现在确定每个问题的确切原因还为时过早。但在三周多的时间里，澳大利亚最繁忙的机场发生了四起地面安全事件，这引发了一个明显的问题：此类事件有多常见？它们是否会变得更加频繁？ 为了研究更广泛的模式，我分析了澳大利亚运输安全局 2003 年至 2025 年澳大利亚商业航空运输的数据，重点关注跑道侵入（飞机、车辆或人员错误地出现在受保护的跑道区域）和滑行碰撞或接近碰撞（一架飞机在滑行时与另一架飞机、人员或物体相撞或几乎相撞）。 最近一次事件发生在上周二上午 8 点刚过，当时两架飞机获准同时使用同一跑道。幸运的是，当一架飞机的飞行员看到另一架飞机时停了下来。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一周多前的 8 月 9 日，不到三个小时又发生了两起事件。 上午 7 点 20 分，一架捷星空客 A320 飞机准备飞往黄金海岸，在滑行道上遇到一架空的卡塔尔航空波音 777 飞机。两架飞机都突然停了下来。捷星航空的一名机组人员受重伤。 然后，上午 10 点左右，一架飞往珀斯的维珍澳大利亚航空波音 737 飞机开始在跑道上起飞，而前面的一架澳洲航空 737 飞机也穿过了另一条跑道。两名机组人员报告称已获得空中交通管制的相关许可。由于空中交通管制取消了起飞许可，维珍机组人员停下来。 7 月 27 日，空中交通管制允许一架澳航波音 737 飞机穿越跑道，而另一架较小的飞机仍在着陆。空中交通管制发现了这一问题并向两名机组人员发出警报，737 在经过等待点后停下来。 澳大利亚运输安全局负责调查和报告涉及飞机、直升机、火车和船只的安全事件。这些事件包括滑行、起飞和着陆期间发生的事件。 报告事件的原始计数可能会产生误导，因为航空活动变化很大，特别是在新冠疫情期间。更多的飞行会带来更多的风险。因此，我还计算了国内航空和所有商业航空运输（包括国内航空以及货运和包机等其他形式的航空）每百万飞行小时的发生率。 对于国内航空而言，对 2003 年至 2025 年年度数据的分析表明，滑行碰撞的数量和发生率均呈显着增加的潜在趋势……

summary.en: Twenty-five years after the Tampa affair, the people, policies, and political fault lines behind Australia's border debate remain.
summary.zh: 坦帕事件25年后，澳大利亚边境辩论背后的人物、政策和政治分歧依然存在。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

For Farid — a pseudonym used to protect his identity — those three words still carry him back 25 years, to a ship in the Indian Ocean, a teenage boy surrounded by hundreds of strangers, and the sudden arrival of Australian authorities after the vessel that had rescued him was prevented from reaching Christmas Island — an Australian territory.

He was 17. He had fled Afghanistan, leaving behind his single mother and siblings, and spent eight months moving from one boat to another in search of safety.

By the time the Norwegian freighter MV Tampa rescued him and 432 other asylum seekers — most of them Hazara Afghans — from a stricken fishing boat named the Palapa in August 2001, he had already endured storms, days at sea and the uncertainty of not knowing where the journey would end. At the time, Hazaras were fleeing Afghanistan, fearing persecution from the resurgent Taliban.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We weren't clearly told where they were going to take us. When we first saw the authorities' ship, I thought they were going to take us to Australia," Farid tells SBS News.

Instead, he was taken to Naoero (formerly known as Nauru), where he would spend years caught up in Australia's newly established offshore processing system before eventually returning to Afghanistan.

"It was like a camp. We get our turns, about once a month, to go out for a few hours," he says.

"For the first year we didn't get to go out at all. We were not very hopeful. It was just tents at first, but then they set up portable rooms," Farid says.

Today, he is 42 and lives in Melbourne's south-east, where he works as a painter after completing trade courses and an apprenticeship. He was granted asylum in Australia in 2012.

The ordinary life Farid has built in Australia is a long way from the journey that brought him here, one that began when he was a teenager fleeing Afghanistan and led him into the centre of the 'Tampa crisis' and Australia's emerging offshore processing system .

Twenty-five years on, his experience offers a human window into the events surrounding the Tampa and the policy that followed, known as the Pacific Solution, as Australia continues to debate how it responds to people seeking protection.

On 24 August 2001, the Palapa ran into trouble in rough seas about 140km north of Christmas Island, leaving those on board facing the prospect of sinking.

Two days later, on 26 August, Australia's Rescue Coordination Centre alerted ships in the area that the vessel was in distress, with the words "HELP" and "SOS" painted...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 对于法里德（Farid）——一个用来保护自己身份的化名——来说，这三个词仍然把他带回到 25 年前，印度洋上的一艘船上，一个十几岁的男孩被数百名陌生人包围，以及在营救他的船只无法到达澳大利亚领土圣诞岛后，澳大利亚当局突然赶到。 他当时 17 岁。他离开了阿富汗，留下了单亲母亲和兄弟姐妹，花了八个月的时间从一艘船搬到另一艘船以寻求安全。 2001 年 8 月，当挪威货船 MV Tampa 从一艘名为 Palapa 的失事渔船上救出他和其他 432 名寻求庇护者（其中大多数是哈扎拉阿富汗人）时，他已经经历了暴风雨、在海上漂泊的日子以及不知道旅程将在哪里结束的不确定性。当时，哈扎拉人因担心受到死灰复燃的塔利班的迫害而逃离阿富汗。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 法里德告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们没有明确告知他们要带我们去哪里。当我们第一次看到当局的船时，我以为他们会带我们去澳大利亚。” 相反，他被带到瑙鲁，在那里他在澳大利亚新建立的离岸加工系统中度过了数年，然后最终返回阿富汗。 “这就像一个营地。我们大约每月一次轮流出去几个小时，”他说。 “第一年，我们根本不能出去。我们没有太大希望。一开始只是帐篷，但后来他们设立了便携式房间，”法里德说。 如今，他 42 岁，住在墨尔本东南部，完成贸易课程和学徒期后，他在那里担任画家。 2012年，他在澳大利亚获得庇护。 法里德在澳大利亚建立的平凡生活与他来到这里的旅程相去甚远，他十几岁的时候就开始了逃离阿富汗的旅程，并带领他进入了“坦帕危机”和澳大利亚新兴离岸加工系统的中心。 二十五年过去了，他的经历为了解坦帕事件及其随后的政策（称为“太平洋解决方案”）提供了一个人性化的窗口，澳大利亚仍在争论如何应对寻求保护的人。 2001年8月24日，帕拉帕号在圣诞岛以北约140公里处的波涛汹涌的海面上遇到麻烦，船上的人面临沉没的危险。 两天后，即 8 月 26 日，澳大利亚救援协调中心向该地区的船只发出该船遇险的警报，并在船顶涂上了“HELP”和“SOS”字样。 最近的...

title.en: Neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell has been talking about autism. Experts say he's recruiting
title.zh: 新纳粹分子托马斯·塞维尔谈论自闭症。专家称他正在招募

summary.en: Neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell has been recorded joking about 'recruiting' autistic men and discussing how to channel their 'fixations.' Experts warn this is a tactic to recruit vulnerable individuals into extremist movements.
summary.zh: 新纳粹分子托马斯·塞维尔被录下视频，他开玩笑地谈论“招募”自闭症男性并讨论如何引导他们的“执念”。专家警告说，这是将弱势个体招募到极端主义运动中的一种策略。

body.en:
Watch the full documentary 'Autism, Extremism and Recruitment' on our YouTube channel.

"Adolf Hitler, huge autist, massive autist, like all these incredible men, some of the best men that ever lived," Thomas Sewell tells viewers online.

Sewell, a neo-Nazi who led the National Socialist Network (NSN), now White Australia, is 10 minutes into a 22-minute monologue giving his "take" on autism.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We used to bully nerds and now we coddle them. Now we're like, 'Oh, you have a disability. You're autistic.' And we treat them like that they're f---ing retarded."

Sewell repeatedly returns to the idea that autistic men do not need to be treated differently, but instead need challenge, male role models and to ‘channel their fixations’. He suggests joining the military — Sewell is ex-Army himself — learning a trade or pursuing higher education.

Sewell dismisses expert understanding of autism repeatedly in his videos — "none of these experts understand autism" — and argues instead that those who struggle have not had "the right mentoring from the right male role models".

Running through his commentary is Sewell’s own movement. Sewell claims that at one point about one-fifth of NSN members were autistic and tells viewers about one former NSN member he says he took under his wing.

"I became like his big brother, and I taught him how to lift [weights], and I taught him how to fight and I taught him how to talk to girls and after two years of just intense bullying … he became like a normal person."

A year later, in 2025, Sewell shared another video speaking about autism. This time as he criticised a Countering Violent Extremism program.

"I've recruited hundreds of autistic teenagers and zero of them have stabbed anyone," Sewell jokes.

We contacted Sewell and he denied that he ever actively recruited autistic people.

But his comments come as the Australian Federal Police (AFP) and researchers stress that extremist groups target young people, who they see as vulnerable, including those who are neurodivergent.

Peta Lowe, who spent years leading the NSW government’s Countering Violent Extremism program for young people, has no doubts about the video.

"It is a recruitment video. Whether he frames it that way for himself or not," she tells The Feed.

"For a lot of neurodivergent people, one of the things they really struggle with is social interactions and understanding what people mean and the various layers of communication," she says.

What Lowe sees in Sewell’s language is an attempt to reframe difference as an asset. Something that may leave a person...
body.zh: 在我们的 YouTube 频道上观看完整的纪录片“自闭症、极端主义和招募”。 “阿道夫·希特勒，巨大的自闭症患者，巨大的自闭症患者，就像所有这些令人难以置信的人一样，是有史以来最优秀的人，”托马斯·休厄尔在网上告诉观众。 休厄尔是一位新纳粹分子，领导着国家社会主义网络 (NSN)（现为白澳大利亚），他在长达 22 分钟的独白中讲述了他对自闭症的“看法”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我们过去欺负书呆子，现在却溺爱他们。现在我们会说，‘哦，你有残疾。你是自闭症患者。’”我们对待他们就好像他们是弱智一样。” 休厄尔反复重申，自闭症男性不需要受到区别对待，而是需要挑战、男性榜样并“引导他们的固着”。他建议参军——休厄尔本人也曾退伍——学习一门手艺或接受高等教育。 贯穿他的评论的是休厄尔自己的运动。他向观众讲述了一名前 NSN 成员的故事，他说他曾将他置于自己的保护之下。 “我变得像他的哥哥一样，我教他如何举重，我教他如何打架，我教他如何与女孩交谈，经过两年的激烈欺凌……他变得像一个正常人一样。” 一年后，即 2025 年，休厄尔分享了另一个谈论自闭症的视频。这次他批评的是一项反暴力极端主义计划。 “我招募了数百名自闭症青少年，其中零人刺伤过任何人，”休厄尔开玩笑说。 我们联系了休厄尔，他否认自己曾积极招募自闭症患者。 但在他发表上述言论之际，澳大利亚联邦警察（法新社）和研究人员强调，极端主义团体以年轻人为目标，他们认为年轻人是弱势群体，包括那些神经分歧的人。 佩塔·洛（Peta Lowe）多年来一直领导新南威尔士州政府针对年轻人的打击暴力极端主义计划，他对这段视频毫不怀疑。 “这是一段招聘视频。无论他是否是为了自己而这样设计的，”她告诉 The Feed。 洛说，一些神经分歧的人有一些弱点，招聘人员要学会识别这些弱点。 “对于许多神经分歧的人来说，他们真正面临的困难之一是社交互动以及理解人们的意思和各个层面的沟通，”她说。 “极端主义团体所做的一件事就是他们接受你。‘如果你想来，我们就会接受你。我们不仅会接受你，你还会成为兄弟会的一部分。’” 休厄尔在他的视频中反复驳斥了专家对自闭症的理解——“这些专家都不理解自闭症”——并认为那些……

reflection.en: It is deeply concerning to hear of attempts to exploit individuals with autism for extremist recruitment. The principle of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves, as found in Proverbs 31:8, calls us to protect the vulnerable from manipulation and harm. We must be vigilant against those who prey on perceived weaknesses, ensuring that all...
reflection.zh: 听到有人试图利用自闭症患者进行极端主义招募，这令人深感担忧。《箴言》31:8 中为那些不能为自己说话的人代求的原则，呼吁我们保护弱者免受操纵和伤害。我们必须警惕那些利用他人弱点的人，确保所有人都得到尊重和支持，而不是被剥削。

title.en: NSW’s koala national park will protect threatened species and cap logging across the state. Could the Greens really block it? | Adam Morton
title.zh: 新南威尔士州的考拉国家公园将保护受威胁的物种并限制全州的伐木活动。绿党真的能阻止吗？ |亚当·莫顿

summary.en: The Albanese government approved a proposal allowing the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars, sparking a schism among environmentalists What qualifies as a win in environmental campaigning? Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of threatened species, including koalas, and has been the focus of years and years of campaigning, is protected from logging?

Or does it depend on how the battle is won – for example, if it lets companies claim that the forest is helping cut their pollution?

It sounds like the start of a philosophical debate, but isn’t. It’s at the heart of a dispute dividing environment and climate activists, and is being weighed by the Greens ahead of a vote in the Senate next month.

In blunt terms, the minor party is considering whether to make an extraordinary call: to support a Nationals motion to strike down a Labor plan that would create a long-discussed great koala national park in northern New South Wales, and significantly reduce native forest logging in the state.

The vote was scheduled for last week but – in a sign of how vexed the issue has become – has been delayed until next month after the Greens asked the Nationals for more time to reach a consensus position.

In terms of a national political debate, the issue hasn’t had much of a look-in yet. But the ramifications could be substantial.

The story starts with a grassroots campaign to create a large park around Coffs Harbour to protect forests and more than a hundred threatened species, including koalas, gliders and glossy black cockatoos. That campaign is backed by a range of local campaigners and First Nations leaders.

NSW Labor signed up as a supporter more than a decade ago while in opposition. Under the premier, Chris Minns , it wasn’t until September 2025 that it announced it would add 176,000 hectares of state forest – an area more than twice the size of Canberra – to existing protected areas to create a 476,000 hectare reserve. It is said to protect about 12,000 koalas, water catchments and carbon stores.

The final confirmation that the park would go ahead didn’t come until June , when the Albanese government approved a NSW proposal that allows it to use the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

Carbon credits remain opaque to most people, but they are the centre of the Australian government’s climate change policy. We need to explain why (bear with me here).

Each credit is said to represent one tonne of greenhouse gas emissions that has been prevented or drawn down from the atmosphere. In Australia, they most often come from projects that are meant to regenerate forests in the outback and capture and burn methane released from landfill sites.

The goal of the projects is sound. Regenerating forests is good! Cutting methane pollution is good! But the projects themselves have been sharply criticised.

Scientific studies have found major shortcomings with the main types of projects used in Australia and...
body.zh: 是不是当一片巨大的森林地区受到保护，免遭砍伐时，这里栖息着包括考拉在内的许多受威胁物种，并且多年来一直是运动的焦点？ 还是取决于这场战斗如何获胜——例如，是否可以让公司声称森林正在帮助减少污染？ 这听起来像是一场哲学辩论的开始，但事实并非如此。这是环境和气候活动人士之间争论的核心，绿党在下个月参议院投票之前正在权衡这一问题。 坦白说，这个小党正在考虑是否发出特别呼吁：支持国家党一项动议，否决一项工党计划，该计划将在新南威尔士州北部建立一个讨论已久的大考拉国家公园，并大幅减少该州的原生森林采伐。 投票原定于上周举行，但在绿党要求国民队有更多时间达成共识后，投票被推迟到下个月，这表明这个问题已经变得多么棘手。 就全国政治辩论而言，这个问题还没有得到太多关注。但其影响可能是巨大的。 故事始于一场草根运动，旨在在科夫斯港周围创建一个大型公园，以保护森林和一百多种受威胁的物种，包括考拉、滑翔机和光泽的黑色凤头鹦鹉。该活动得到了一系列当地活动人士和原住民领导人的支持。 新南威尔士州工党十多年前在反对党时期就加入了支持者行列。在州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 的领导下，直到 2025 年 9 月，澳大利亚才宣布将在现有保护区的基础上增加 176,000 公顷的国家森林（面积是堪培拉面积的两倍多），以创建 476,000 公顷的保护区。据说它可以保护大约 12,000 只考拉、集水区和碳储存。 直到六月，阿尔巴尼亚政府才最终确认该公园将继续建设，当时阿尔巴尼亚政府批准了新南威尔士州的一项提案，允许其利用该公园创造价值数亿澳元的碳信用额。 碳信用额对大多数人来说仍然不透明，但它们是澳大利亚政府气候变化政策的核心。我们需要解释一下原因（请耐心听我说）。 据说每个信用额代表已被阻止或从大气中减少的一吨温室气体排放量。在澳大利亚，它们通常来自旨在再生内陆森林并捕获和燃烧垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷的项目。 这些项目的目标是合理的。恢复森林是好事！减少甲烷污染是好事！但这些项目本身却遭到了严厉批评。 科学研究发现澳大利亚使用的主要项目类型存在重大缺陷......

title.en: 'You can't escape': A growing fight over what belongs in Australia's suburbs
title.zh: 肖恩想在这里抚养儿子，直到那个“巨大的黑匣子”出现

summary.en: Residents in West Footscray, Melbourne, are reporting significant disruptions from a newly constructed NextDC data center located 300 meters from residential homes. The facility brings constant humming noise and light pollution, leading to calls for better planning protections for existing communities.
summary.zh: 墨尔本西富茨克雷的居民反映，距离住宅区仅300米的新建 NextDC 数据中心造成了严重干扰。该设施带来了持续的嗡嗡声和光污染，引发了人们呼吁为现有社区提供更好的规划保护。

body.en:
When Sean Brown moved to West Footscray two years ago, days after his son was born, he thought he'd found a good spot to raise a family — green space, a train station nearby, and a community with room to grow.

Instead, his home is now 300 metres from one of the largest data centres in the country.

"It's a massive black box in the middle of a residential area. There's this visual heaviness to it that you can't really escape," Brown told SBS News.

NextDC's M3 facility in the Melbourne suburb brings a constant humming noise audible even 100m away, he said, while ongoing construction means near-constant light, noise and disruption.

Parking is scarce with facility workers competing for street spots, and Brown said whole streets have lost power for full days at a time during infrastructure works, with little warning and no compensation. He's also worried about health risks, and the future of his entire suburb.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Branded by its chief executive, Craig Scroggie, as "Australia's largest hyperscale AI factory", the M3 site is set to double in size by 2027 — covering 10 hectares in size, and drawing 225MW of power, 24 hours a day.

A separate facility, the Perri Melbourne Data Centre (PMDC), has been approved and planned just a few blocks over.

There are currently 162 operational data centres across Australia, with a further 90 proposed, according to the Climate Council — and it's unclear whether planned rules to data centres in residential areas will apply to any of them.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese used a speech to the Business Council of Australia's annual dinner on Tuesday night to announce new national rules that would block future data centres from being built near homes, schools, or prime agricultural land.

Developers will also be required to add more renewable energy to the grid than their data centres consume, minimise water use, and ensure new sites are appropriate for their size — avoiding land that could otherwise be used for housing.

"Australia is in a strong position to attract investment in data centres, but maintaining social licence will be essential," Albanese said.

"That means ensuring energy bills do not rise, water security is maintained and locations are appropriate."

Asked about communities already living with data centres, Albanese did not directly answer when pressed on ABC Perth on Tuesday, instead pointing to the same social licence framework.

Asked by SBS News whether any measures would target existing sites or address community concern that the new rules don't cover people already affected, the prime minister's office declined to comment.

body.zh: 两年前，当肖恩·布朗搬到西富茨克雷时，也就是他儿子出生几天后，他认为自己找到了一个养家糊口的好地方——绿地、附近的火车站和一个有成长空间的社区。 相反，他的家现在距离该国最大的数据中心之一只有 300 米。 “这是一个位于住宅区中央的巨大黑匣子。它给人一种视觉上的沉重感，你无法真正逃脱，”布朗告诉 SBS 新闻。 他说，NextDC 位于墨尔本郊区的 M3 设施发出持续的嗡嗡声，即使在 100m 之外也能听到，而正在进行的施工意味着几乎持续不断的光线、噪音和干扰。 由于设施工作人员争夺街道停车位，停车位稀缺，布朗表示，在基础设施施工期间，整条街道一度停电一整天，几乎没有任何警告，也没有任何补偿。他还担心健康风险以及整个郊区的未来。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 M3 工厂的首席执行官 Craig Scroggie 称其为“澳大利亚最大的超大规模人工智能工厂”，到 2027 年，其规模将扩大一倍——占地 10 公顷，每天 24 小时提供 225 兆瓦的电力。 一个单独的设施，即佩里墨尔本数据中心 (PMDC)，已在几个街区之外获得批准和规划。 根据气候理事会的数据，澳大利亚目前有 162 个正在运营的数据中心，并计划再建设 90 个数据中心，目前尚不清楚计划中的住宅区数据中心规则是否适用于其中任何一个数据中心。 澳大利亚总理安东尼·艾博内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 将于周二晚上在澳大利亚商业委员会年度晚宴上发表讲话，宣布新的国家规定，禁止未来的数据中心建在住宅、学校或主要农田附近。 开发商还需要向电网添加比数据中心消耗的更多的可再生能源，最大限度地减少用水，并确保新场地适合其规模，避免使用本来可以用于住房的土地。 阿尔巴尼斯表示：“澳大利亚在吸引数据中心投资方面处于有利地位，但维持社会许可至关重要。” “这意味着确保能源费用不上涨、维持水安全以及地点合适。” 周二，当被问及已经拥有数据中心的社区时，阿尔巴尼斯在接受澳大利亚广播公司珀斯 (ABC Perth) 采访时没有直接回答，而是指出了相同的社会许可框架。 当被 SBS 新闻问及是否有任何措施针对现有场所或解决社区对新规则不涵盖已经受影响的人的担忧时，总理办公室拒绝发表评论。 尽管...

This situation illustrates that while a project may be legally 'lawful,' it is not necessarily 'beneficial' if it fails to build up the surrounding community. We are called to consider how our advancements...
reflection.zh: 肖恩·布朗原本希望在宁静的社区抚养儿子，但这一愿望被巨大数据中心的“视觉沉重感”和持续噪音打破了。这种情况说明，虽然一个项目在法律上可能是“可行的”，但如果它不能造就周围的社区，就不一定是“有益的”。我们受召去思考我们的进步如何影响邻舍平静的生活，确保技术的发展不会以牺牲人类的福祉为代价。

title.en: North Korea to ‘bring joy’ to Kim with 100 athletes at Asian Games
title.zh: 朝鲜将携100名运动员参加亚运会为金正恩“带来欢乐”

summary.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. This picture taken on August 16, 2026 and released by North Korea’s official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) via KNS on August 17, 2026 shows North Korean leader Kim Jong Un (centre R) and his daughter Kim Ju Ae watching swimming and diving competitions, to mark the 81st anniversary of the end of World War II in Pyongyang. Photo: KCNA via KNS/AFP. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the Covid pandemic but returned at the Asian Games in China in 2023 and also took part in the Paris Olympics. The team for the regional Games in Nagoya and the Aichi region includes two Japan-based ethnic Koreans competing in women’s football and karate, said Ko Chol Ho, secretary general of North Korea’s Olympic committee. “Our delegation will send more than 100 athletes to compete in 14 sports, including men’s and women’s football, weightlifting, boxing and wrestling,” Ko told Choson Sinbo, a pro-North Korean publication based in Japan, during an interview in Pyongyang. Kim Jong Un. File photo: USGov. “We are making every effort, driven by a strong desire to live up to the expectations of our country and people by achieving even greater results at the upcoming Games,” the official said, in remarks published Tuesday. He noted that the delegation would be smaller than the one sent to the Hangzhou Games of 2023 but said he hoped it would win more medals. Authoritarian North Korea won 11 golds last time, half of them in weightlifting. The official said that morale among the athletes was high for the event, which runs from September 19 to October 4, and they were motivated to win for their leader. “Our athletes are training tirelessly every day, determined to bring joy to Marshal Kim,” he said. North Korea has recently been hurling criticism at Japan, a former regional colonial power, over what Pyongyang describes as its remilitarisation.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，朝鲜将派出约 100 名运动员参加下个月在日本举行的亚运会，参加 14 个项目的比赛，旨在“为金正恩元帅带来欢乐”。这张拍摄于 2026 年 8 月 16 日、朝鲜官方朝中社 (KCNA) 通过 KNS 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日发布的照片​​显示，朝鲜领导人金正恩（中右）和他的女儿金珠爱正在观看游泳和跳水比赛，以纪念平壤第二次世界大战结束 81 周年。照片：朝中社/法新社。这个拥有核武器的国家在新冠病毒大流行期间暂停了参加国际体育比赛，但在 2023 年中国亚运会上回归，还参加了巴黎奥运会。朝鲜奥委会秘书长高哲浩表示，参加名古屋和爱知地区地区运动会的代表队包括两名居住在日本的朝鲜族选手，她们参加女子足球和空手道比赛。 “我们代表团将派出100多名运动员参加14个项目的比赛，包括男女足球、举重、拳击和摔跤，”高在平壤接受采访时告诉日本亲朝鲜出版物《朝鲜新报》。金正恩.资料图：美国政府。这位官员在周二发表的讲话中表示：“我们正在尽一切努力，强烈希望在即将到来的奥运会上取得更好的成绩，不辜负我们国家和人民的期望。”他指出，代表团规模将比参加 2023 年杭州奥运会的代表团规模要小，但他表示希望代表团能赢得更多奖牌。独裁的朝鲜上次赢得了 11 枚金牌，其中一半是举重金牌。这位官员表示，在9月19日至10月4日举行的这项赛事中，运动员们士气高昂，他们有动力为自己的领袖赢得胜利。 “我们的运动员每天都在不知疲倦地训练，决心为金元帅带来欢乐，”他说。朝鲜最近一直对前地区殖民国家日本提出批评，平壤称其为重新军事化。

title.en: Hong Kong’s first Chinese medicine hospital to offer inpatient services from December
title.zh: 香港首间中医院12月起提供住院服务

summary.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11, authorities said on Tuesday. It currently provides only outpatient and day-patient services. A total of 93 beds will be made available. This includes 60 government-subsidised beds, available to eligible Hong Kong residents, as well as 33 non-subsidised ones. The hospital will also provide 20 beds under its Clinical Trial and Research Centre, and two high-dependency beds for patients who require closer observation and nursing care. The total number of beds is expected to reach 400 by the end of 2030. The city’s first hospital dedicated to traditional Chinese medicine, the facility operates under a public-private partnership model. It is managed by a company set up by Hong Kong Baptist University, which was selected as the project contractor in 2021 following a government tender process. Hong Kong Baptist University. Photo: GovHK. The hospital uses two fee structures: one for subsidised services and another for more expensive “market-oriented services.” Inpatient services will cost $980 under the subsidised scheme – more than three times the day charge for a public hospital bed, which is currently priced at HK$300. For non-subsidised beds, fees range from HK$810 to HK$3,100 per day, depending on the room type. These rates do not include medical attendance or consultation, which start from HK$560 per visit. More services expanded In addition to launching inpatient services, the hospital will expand existing outpatient services, including those offered in its radiological diagnostic and pathology departments. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The hospital will also introduce 10 new special disease programmes in September and November, covering conditions such as eczema, Parkinson’s disease, and functional gastrointestinal disorders. “By leveraging the strengths of Chinese medicine and the complementary advantages of Chinese and Western medicine, the multidisciplinary team of the hospital will provide patients with highly effective treatment to enhance clinical outcomes,” the government said in a statement . Authorities predict that annual outpatient attendance will rise from 140,000 in the first year of operation to over 260,000 in the second year.
body.zh: 香港中医院将于12月开始提供住院服务，起价是公立医院的三倍。香港中医院。照片：香港政府一站通。当局周二表示，去年 12 月启用的将军澳医院将于 12 月 11 日起提供 24 小时住院服务。目前仅提供门诊和日间住院服务。共有93张床位可供使用。其中包括60个供合资格香港居民使用的政府资助床位，以及33个非资助床位。医院还将在其临床试验和研究中心下提供20张床位，并为需要密切观察和护理的患者提供两张高依赖床位。预计到2030年底，床位总数将达到400张。该医院是该市第一家中医医院，以公私合作模式运营。该项目由香港浸会大学成立的一家公司管理，该公司于 2021 年通过政府招标程序被选为项目承包商。香港浸会大学。照片：香港政府一站通。该医院采用两种收费结构：一种用于补贴服务，另一种用于更昂贵的“市场导向服务”。根据补贴计划，住院服务费用为 980 美元，是目前公立医院床位日费 300 港元的三倍多。对于非资助床位，收费范围为每日港币 810 元至港币 3,100 元，视乎房型而定。这些费用不包括就诊或咨询，每次就诊 560 港元起。扩大更多服务除了推出住院服务外，医院还将扩大现有的门诊服务，包括放射诊断和病理科提供的服务。香港中医院。照片：香港政府一站通。医院还将在9月和11月推出10个新的专科疾病项目，涵盖湿疹、帕金森病、功能性胃肠病等疾病。政府在一份声明中表示：“医院的多学科团队将利用中医优势和中西医互补优势，为患者提供高效的治疗，以提高临床效果。”当局预计，每年门诊量将从开业第一年的14万人次增加到第二年的26万人次以上。

title.en: Ex-Lamma Island quarry to be turned into tourist site

summary.en: The former quarry on Lamma Island will be turned into a tourist and recreational spot with low-density housing supply and yacht berths, according to authorities. In the latest proposal submitted to the Islands District Council, the Development Bureau said the site could become a...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The former quarry on Lamma Island will be turned into a tourist and recreational spot with low-density housing supply and yacht berths, according to authorities. In the latest proposal submitted to the Islands District Council, the Development Bureau said the site could become a unique tourism destination in Hong Kong to attract travellers. The bureau proposed to build 1,200 residential units at the site, accommodating an estimated population of 3,400. “The population planning has taken into account the capacity limits of supporting infrastructure, the surrounding environment, living space quality and public expectations, with the aim of creating a high-quality living environment,” it said. The low-density housing design would also help preserve the unique rural lifestyle of Lamma Island, it added. Meanwhile, around 150 to 200 yacht berths, as well as water sports facilities, would be offered at the site to boost tourism. The bureau also proposed to set up restaurants, retail stores and other facilities for the convenience of visitors. Lawmaker Steven Ho welcomed the proposal, saying it aligns with the promotion of island tourism and the marine economy in Hong Kong. But he urged authorities to improve the quality of major public piers across the city to enhance transport links to the islands. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 当局表示，南丫岛的前采石场将改建成旅游休闲胜地，提供低密度住房供应和游艇泊位。发展局在向离岛区议会提交的最新建议中表示，该地点可成为香港独特的旅游目的地，以吸引旅客。该局计划在该地点建造1,200个住宅单元，预计可容纳3,400人。人口规划综合考虑基础设施配套能力、周边环境、居住空间质量和公众期望，着力营造优质人居环境。报告补充说，低密度住房设计也有利于保留南丫岛独特的乡村生活方式。同时，该地点将提供约150至200个游艇泊位以及水上运动设施，以促进旅游业。该局还建议设立餐厅、零售店和其他设施，以方便游客。立法会议员何鸿燊对这项建议表示欢迎，称这符合促进香港海岛旅游和海洋经济的发展。但他敦促当局提高全市主要公共码头的质量，以加强与岛屿的交通联系。托尼·萨宾编辑

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Wednesday paid a community visit to Sham Shui Po District where he talked to residents to gather views ahead of his Policy Address next month. Lee first came to Un Chau Estate in Cheung Sha Wan, spending about 15 minutes inside Un Shing House to check...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Wednesday paid a community visit to Sham Shui Po District where he talked to residents to gather views ahead of his Policy Address next month. Lee first came to Un Chau Estate in Cheung Sha Wan, spending about 15 minutes inside Un Shing House to check on an 88-year-old woman. Lee said he was glad to hear that the elderly resident was satisfied with her recent follow-up check-up at an ambulatory care centre, saying that reflects the government's policy in promoting ambulatory care service had achieved results. Ambulatory care surgery allows patients to undergo procedures and return home the same day without an overnight hospital stay. Lee then headed to a nearby elderly centre to learn about the various types of activities and services provided there before taking to the streets to chat with residents. Many locals expressed excitement about his visit, with some taking the chance to snap a selfie with the city's leader. "He really shows his care for us elderly, and the government is doing a good job," one resident said. Others urged Lee to "strive for the public's welfare." Lee promised that the government would keep building on its efforts, saying that "there's no best, only better." Lee noted that many elderly residents have lived in the estate for a long time and share a deep connection with the neighbourhood. The chief executive encouraged seniors to stay active and reminded them that the local district health centre offers a wide range of primary healthcare services. During his walk, Lee came across a community sports event and decided to try out an exercise bike. Lee said while he enjoys exercising, he rarely gets the chance due to his busy schedule. He also chatted with one of the participants, a secondary school student, telling him that young people are the future of Hong Kong. "It was my first time meeting the chief executive," said the student, surnamed Kong. "I thought I'd be really nervous, but once we started talking, it felt like chatting with a friend.” Lee also visited a 1823 contact centre to learn about how the 24-hour hotline applies AI tools to expedite the handling of public enquiries. Officials including Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak, Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau and Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong joined Lee in different parts of his visit. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周三到深水埗区进行社区走访，在下个月发表施政报告之前与居民交谈，收集意见。李先来到长沙湾元州村，在元盛楼内逗留约15分钟，探望一名88岁女子。李先生表示很高兴得知长者对近期在日间护理中心的复诊感到满意，反映政府推动日间护理服务的政策已取得成效。门诊护理手术允许患者在当天接受手术并回家，无需住院过夜。随后，李先生前往附近的老人中心，了解那里提供的各类活动和服务，然后上街与居民交谈。许多当地人对他的访问表示兴奋，一些人还趁机与该市领导人合影留念。 “他确实对我们老人家很关心，政府做得很好。”一位居民说。其他人则敦促李“为公众的福祉而努力”。李承诺政府将继续努力，并表示“没有最好，只有更好”。李先生表示，不少长者已长期居住在屋村，与邻里关系深厚。行政长官鼓励长者保持活跃，并提醒他们当地地区卫生中心提供广泛的初级医疗保健服务。在散步的过程中，李偶然发现了一场社区体育​​活动，于是决定尝试一下健身车。李说，虽然他喜欢锻炼，但由于日程繁忙，他很少有机会锻炼。他又与其中一名中学生交谈，告诉他年轻人是香港的未来。 “这是我第一次见到行政长官，”这名孔姓学生说。 “我以为我会很紧张，但一旦我们开始交谈，感觉就像和朋友聊天一样。”李先生亦到访1823联络中心，了解该24小时热线如何运用人工智能工具，加快处理市民查询。民政及青年事务局局长麦家丽、卫生局局长罗仲茂和创新科技及工业局局长孙东等官员陪同李光耀访问。托尼·萨宾编辑

title.en: Customs arrest two over illegal storage warehouse
title.zh: 海关拘捕两人非法仓储

summary.en: Customs officers on Wednesday said they arrested two people after they discovered an illegal storage warehouse in Sheung Shui for what they suspected were controlled pharmaceutical products that were being smuggled into the SAR. Among the 400,000 pharmaceutical items seized, a...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Customs officers on Wednesday said they arrested two people after they discovered an illegal storage warehouse in Sheung Shui for what they suspected were controlled pharmaceutical products that were being smuggled into the SAR. Among the 400,000 pharmaceutical items seized, a majority of them were products to enhance virility. They had an estimated market value of about HK$11 million. Investigator Woo Suet-yi, from the Syndicate Crimes Investigation Bureau, said officers also found packaging tools and a large number of paper boxes, which they believe were used for packaging and storage before the pills were smuggled to other places. “We believe a majority of the suspected controlled pharmaceutical products were from South Asia. As for exactly which regions or countries are they from, we are still investigating,” she said. “We believe that for now, we have already intercepted the relevant (suspected) controlled pharmaceutical products at source, and none of them have entered the market.” Woo also said that most of the packaging stated that they contained Part 1 poisons, meaning that the import and export, as well as storage for relevant controlled pharmaceutical products, are subject to strict regulations. She did not rule out the possibility of further arrests. Senior pharmacist Chan Hon-wah, from the Department of Health, warned that the public faced health risks if they purchased drugs from unknown sources or through illegal means. Pharmaceutical products that contain Part 1 poisons and prescription drugs can only be taken under a doctor’s supervision, he added. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 海关人员周三表示，他们在上水发现一个非法储存仓库后逮捕了两人，怀疑这些仓库是走私进入特区的受管制药品。查获的40万件药品中，大部分是增强男子气概的产品。他们的估计市值约为1100万港元。集团罪案调查局调查员胡学义表示，警方还发现了包装工具和大量纸盒，他们认为这些纸盒是在药丸被走私到其他地方之前用于包装和储存的。 “我们相信大部分涉嫌受管制的药品来自南亚。至于它们到底来自哪些地区或国家，我们仍在调查中，”她说。 “我们认为，目前我们已经从源头截获了相关（疑似）管制药品，没有任何产品流入市场。”胡还表示，大部分包装均注明含有第1部分毒药，这意味着相关受管制药品的进出口和储存均受到严格规定。她不排除进一步被捕的可能性。卫生署高级药剂师陈汉华警告，市民若从不明来源或以非法途径购买药物，会面临健康风险。他补充说，含有第 1 部分毒药和处方药的药品只能在医生的监督下服用。托尼·萨宾编辑

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee announced on Wednesday that he will deliver both the city’s first five-year plan and the annual Policy Address on September 16. He made the announcement after paying a visit to Un Chau Estate in Cheung Sha Wan where he met with residents there. Speaking...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee announced on Wednesday that he will deliver both the city’s first five-year plan and the annual Policy Address on September 16. He made the announcement after paying a visit to Un Chau Estate in Cheung Sha Wan where he met with residents there. Speaking to reporters after the visit, Lee noted that the arrangement is to make it easier for the public to understand the government's policy direction. "The arrangement is to make it easier for people to understand how the five-year plan and the Policy Address are closely connected and share a continuous, coherent relationship," he said. "By reading the five-year plan together with the Policy Address, people will be able to better understand how the government will adhere to the direction and strategies set out in the five-year plan, turning the blueprint into policy measures and move forward." Lee said he will set out various performance indicators in this year’s Policy Address as "annual milestones". The five-year plan will be announced in Legco, to be followed immediately by the release of the Policy Address. "By releasing the Policy Address immediately after the announcement of Hong Kong's first five-year plan, I aim to help the public better understand the close interconnection between the two documents," Lee said in a statement. "Hong Kong's first five-year plan sets out the blueprint for the city's economic and social development over the next five years, and is a forward-looking, strategic and directional guiding document. The Policy Address serves as an annual report on the chief executive's implementation of Hong Kong's first five-year plan and sets out the key policy priorities for the year in response to the prevailing circumstances. The two are inextricably related." Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周三宣布，将于9月16日发表香港第一个五年计划和年度施政报告。他是在到访长沙湾元州村与居民会面后作出上述宣布的。李在访问后接受记者采访时表示，这一安排是为了让公众更容易了解政府的政策方向。他说：“这样的安排是为了让人们更容易理解五年计划和施政报告是如何紧密相连、具有连续性、连贯性的。” “把五年规划与施政报告放在一起阅读，人们将能够更好地了解政府将如何坚持五年规划所确定的方向和策略，将蓝图转化为政策措施并向前迈进。”李显龙表示，他将在今年的施政报告中列出各项表现指标，作为“年度里程碑”。五年计划将于立法会公布，紧接着发表施政报告。李在声明中表示：“我在香港第一个五年计划公布后立即发表施政报告，旨在帮助公众更好地了解两份文件之间的密切联系。” “香港第一个五年规划描绘了未来五年香港经济社会发展的蓝图，是一份具有前瞻性、战略性、方向性的指导性文件。《施政报告》是行政长官执行香港第一个五年规划的年度报告，并因应形势提出了全年施政重点，两者密不可分。”埃德蒙·方编辑

summary.en: A senior news editor at Hong Kong’s government-funded broadcaster has been sentenced to 160 hours of community service after pleading guilty to filming up a women’s skirt in Mong Kok last year. Chong Tak-yin, an Assistant Chief Assignment Editor at Radio Television Hong Kong’s...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A senior news editor at Hong Kong’s government-funded broadcaster has been sentenced to 160 hours of community service after pleading guilty to filming up a women’s skirt in Mong Kok last year. West Kowloon Law Courts Building. File photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Chong Tak-yin, an Assistant Chief Assignment Editor at Radio Television Hong Kong’s Chinese-language news and current affairs division, appeared before Magistrate Jeffrey Sze at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday morning. He had earlier been charged with one count of unlawful recording or observation of intimate parts. Chong’s lawyer told the court that the 57-year-old’s probation and community service reports were “positive,” adding that he has a family and a “good career,” according to court news outlet The Witness . The defence said that Chong has sought professional help to address his issues, and that he is confident he can fulfil a community service order with a low risk of reoffending. Chong’s full cooperation during the investigation reflected genuine remorse, his lawyer added, before Sze handed down a 160-hour community service order. RTHK. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The maximum sentence for upskirting is five years’ imprisonment. Chong is still listed as an editor at RTHK on the government’s civil servants directory. ‘Moment of lustfulness’ In an earlier mitigation hearing, the defence said that Chong was married with an unemployed older son and a younger son in school. Chong’s family relied on his monthly salary of approximately HK$90,000, the court heard. Chong pleaded guilty earlier this month because he said that failing to do so after committing a crime would leave a bad impression on his sons. According to an earlier court document, Chong followed the victim along Mong Kok’s Tung Choi Street on November 14 last year. Police officers on patrol noticed Chong acting suspiciously while following the woman, holding his phone at a 45-degree angle beneath her. After intercepting him, they found a 17-second video showing the victim’s underwear on his phone. Under caution, Chong admitted to acting in “a moment of lustfulness,” and begged the officers to give him a second chance.
body.zh: 香港政府资助的广播公司的一名高级新闻编辑承认去年在旺角拍摄女性裙子的罪名，被判处 160 小时社区服务。西九龙法院大楼。档案照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。香港电台中文新闻及时事部助理总编辑庄德贤周三上午在西九龙裁判法院受审。早些时候，他被指控犯有一项非法录音或观察私密部位的罪名。据法庭新闻媒体《见证人》报道，Chong 的律师告诉法庭，这位 57 岁的男子的缓刑和社区服务报告是“积极的”，并补充说他有一个家庭和“良好的职业生涯”。辩方表示，Chong 已寻求专业帮助来解决他的问题，并且他有信心能够以较低的再犯罪风险履行社区服务令。他的律师补充说，在施下达 160 小时社区服务令之前，张在调查期间的全力配合反映了他真诚的悔恨。香港电台。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。偷拍裙底罪的最高刑罚是五年监禁。在政府公务员名录中，庄仍被列为香港电台编辑。 “淫荡的时刻” 在早些时候的减刑听证会上，辩方表示，Chong 已婚，有一个失业的大儿子和一个在学校的小儿子。法庭获悉，庄先生的家人依靠他约9万港元的月薪生活。张本月早些时候认罪，因为他表示，犯罪后不认罪会给儿子们留下不好的印象。根据较早前的一份法庭文件，庄某于去年11月14日跟随受害人沿着旺角通菜街行进。巡逻的警察注意到Chong在跟踪该女子时表现可疑，并将手机与她呈45度角。拦截他后，他们在他的手机上发现了一段17秒的视频，显示受害者的内衣。在谨慎的情况下，张承认自己是在“一时情欲”下行事的，并恳求警察再给他一次机会。

title.en: China tells citizens to leave Taiwan-allied Eswatini
title.zh: 中国要求公民离开与台湾结盟的斯威士兰

summary.en: China has told its citizens to immediately leave Eswatini, citing security risks in the African nation that is one of Taiwan’s few remaining diplomatic allies. China claims Taiwan is part of its territory and opposes the self-governed island’s attempts at international exchange....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China has told its citizens to immediately leave Eswatini, citing security risks in the African nation that is one of Taiwan’s few remaining diplomatic allies. Eswatinians welcoming Taiwan president Lai Ching-te during his visit to the country on May 2, 2026. Photo: Wang Yu Ching/Office of the President, via Flickr. China claims Taiwan is part of its territory and opposes the self-governed island’s attempts at international exchange. Taiwan’s president Lai Ching-te travelled to Eswatini in May, with Taipei accusing Beijing of trying to derail the trip by pressuring nearby countries to revoke overflight permits. The consular affairs department of China’s foreign ministry said on Tuesday that “Chinese nationals and institutions already in the country should evacuate as soon as possible or relocate to relatively safer areas such as South Africa”. The ministry cited “rampant cyber fraud and online gambling criminal activities” as among the ongoing security concerns. Taiwan president Lai Ching-te (centre) visiting Eswatini on May 2, 2026. Photo: Wang Yu Ching/Office of the President, via Flickr. It was not immediately clear how many Chinese citizens were working or living in Eswatini. “Those who insist on travelling to or remaining in the area will face extremely high security risks, and the timeliness of receiving consular assistance may be affected,” the department said in a statement shared to social media platform WeChat. Eswatini, a small enclave kingdom formerly known as Swaziland, is one of 12 countries that still recognise Taiwan. China has persuaded other nations to break diplomatic ties with the self-ruled island. On May 1, China extended a zero-tariff policy to all African countries except Eswatini.
body.zh: 中国已要求其公民立即离开斯威士兰，理由是这个非洲国家存在安全风险，该国是台湾仅存的几个外交盟友之一。 2026 年 5 月 2 日，斯威士兰人民欢迎台湾总统赖清德访问该国。照片：Wang Yu Ching/总统办公室，来自 Flickr。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并反对这个自治岛屿进行国际交流的尝试。台湾总统赖清德五月前往斯威士兰，台北指责北京试图向周边国家施压，要求吊销飞越许可，从而破坏此次行程。中国外交部领事司周二表示，“已在该国的中国公民和机构应尽快撤离或转移到南非等相对安全的地区”。该部将“猖獗的网络欺诈和在线赌博犯罪活动”列为持续存在的安全问题。台湾总统赖清德（中）于 2026 年 5 月 2 日访问斯威士兰。照片：Wang Yu Ching/总统府，来自 Flickr。目前尚不清楚有多少中国公民在斯威士兰工作或生活。 “那些坚持前往或留在该地区的人将面临极高的安全风险，接受领事协助的及时性可能会受到影响，”该部门在社交媒体平台微信上分享的一份声明中表示。斯威士兰是一个小飞地王国，以前称为斯威士兰，是仍然承认台湾的 12 个国家之一。中国已说服其他国家与这个自治岛屿断绝外交关系。 5月1日，中国对除斯威士兰以外的所有非洲国家实行零关税政策。

title.en: Hong Kong privacy watchdog warns 3 domestic workers over use of employers’ data for loans
title.zh: 香港隐私监管机构警告 3 名家庭佣工使用雇主数据获取贷款

summary.en: Hong Kong’s privacy watchdog has issued warning letters to three domestic workers after they used their employers’ personal data without consent to secure loans. The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (PCPD) said in a press conference on Tuesday that it has...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Hong Kong’s privacy watchdog has issued warning letters to three domestic workers after they used their employers’ personal data without consent to secure loans. Ada Chung, commissioner of PCPD, speaks at a press conference on August 25, 2026. Photo: PCPD. The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (PCPD) said in a press conference on Tuesday that it has been following three cases concerning foreign domestic workers who used the names, mobile phone numbers, and residential addresses of their employers to borrow money from finance companies. All three employers were unaware of the situation and did not consent to the use of their personal data. Since the loans were unrelated to their employment, the workers were found to have violated the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, the PCPD said. Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data Ada Chung said in the press conference that all three employers received phone calls and WhatsApp messages asking them to remind the domestic workers to meet their outstanding payments. One employer was also warned that debt collectors would be sent to their home if the domestic worker’s debts were not repaid by a certain date. Migrant domestic workers sit in front of a luxury fragrance advertisement in Hong Kong, on November 5, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Many employers also fully recognise FDHs’ [foreign domestic workers’] contributions to their households,” Chung said in a press release. “However, if FDHs use their employers’ personal data to apply for loans without the employers’ knowledge or consent, unnecessary distress may be caused to the employers.” All three domestic workers were dismissed soon after their employers found out about the inappropriate use of their personal data. The commissioner also said on Commercial Radio on Wednesday that affected employers should report cases to the government so that they can be taken into consideration should the workers apply to return to Hong Kong in the future. The watchdog reminded foreign domestic workers to obtain explicit consent before using their employers’ personal information for loan applications and other purposes unrelated to their employment. HKFP reported in 2024 that loan sharks often target foreign domestic workers in Hong Kong , as they are expected to send back money regularly to support their family back home.
body.zh: 香港隐私监管机构向三名家庭佣工发出警告信，因为他们未经同意使用雇主的个人数据来获得贷款。公署专员钟少芬于2026年8月25日在新闻发布会上发言。图片：公署。个人资料私隐专员公署周二在记者会上表示，已跟进三起外籍家庭佣工利用雇主姓名、手机号码和住址向金融公司借款的案件。三名雇主均不知情，也不同意使用他们的个人资料。公署表示，由于这些贷款与他们的工作无关，这些工人被发现违反了《个人资料（私隐）条例》。个人资料私隐专员钟丽珊在记者会上表示，三名雇主均接到电话和WhatsApp讯息，要求他们提醒家政工人缴付欠款。一名雇主还被警告，如果家庭佣工在特定日期前未偿还债务，收债员将被派往他们的家中。 2023 年 11 月 5 日，香港，外来家政工人坐在豪华香水广告前。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “许多雇主也充分认可外籍家庭佣工对其家庭的贡献，”钟在一份新闻稿中说。 “不过，如果外佣在雇主不知情或不同意的情况下使用雇主的个人资料申请贷款，可能会给雇主带来不必要的困扰。”在雇主发现他们的个人数据被不当使用后，这三名家庭佣工很快就被解雇了。该专员周三还在商业电台表示，受影响的雇主应向政府报告案件，以便工人将来申请返回香港时能够得到考虑。监管机构提醒外籍家庭佣工在将雇主的个人信息用于贷款申请或与就业无关的其他目的之前，应获得雇主的明确同意。 HKFP 在 2024 年报道称，高利贷者经常针对在香港的外籍家庭佣工，因为他们需要定期寄回钱来支持家乡的家人。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

body.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date. Continue reading...

Now the potatoes came up soft and collapsing, “like boiled potatoes”, spoiled by heat that had turned the ground into something closer to an oven. Continue reading...

title.en: Do customer loyalty programs actually work? The benefits are in the eye of the cardholder
title.zh: 客户忠诚度计划真的有效吗？优惠尽在持卡人眼中

summary.en: Whether you love a loyalty discount at the supermarket or frequently forget your loyalty card, loyalty programs (LPs) can be an essential support for families and households amid growing cost-of-living pressures.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Whether you love a loyalty discount at the supermarket or frequently forget your loyalty card, loyalty programs (LPs) can be an essential support for families and households amid growing cost-of-living pressures.

The number of LPs offered by retailers is increasing. Globally, the loyalty management market is projected to grow in value from $17.38 billion in 2026 to $51.65 billion by 2034. The market will continue to expand as cost-of-living pressures force households to seek discounts, coupons, gifts and vouchers to reduce their shopping expenditures.

New research led by Edith Cowan University (ECU) analyzed survey data from more than 800 Australian supermarket customers to better understand what influences customer engagement with LPs and how effectively the programs affect loyalty to retailers.

The findings will help retailers design LPs based on what is most important to customers.

ECU Professor of Marketing and Service Science Sanjit Roy from the School of Business and Law said the research found that customer behavior and retailer loyalty are driven by customers' characteristics and capacity to engage with LPs.

"Many customers don't have the time to do a mental cost-benefit analysis. What am I getting, and what am I giving up? Retailers know this, so they'll prompt you at the checkout before you pay, either at a self-service checkout or through a customer service representative asking: 'Do you want to scan your rewards card? Do you want to scan your Flybuys card?' Retailers know how to reinforce our habit," Roy explained.

"But as customers, we are losing more than we are gaining. If we earn one point for every dollar spent, and every 2,000 points we receive a $10 voucher—is it worth handing over our personal data when discounts and promotions aren't being personalized or tailored to our buying habits as a reward for our loyalty? Therefore, is it worth signing up for loyalty programs?"

The results show that LP engagement leads to retailer engagement and customer loyalty—both in attitude and behavior toward a customer's retailer of choice.

"If a customer predicts there will be a future discount on an item they frequently purchase, they may wait a week or two to buy it and buy more of the same product. But if they don't have the capacity to wait—like a parent desperately needing diapers or with too tight a budget to buy in bulk—they will miss out on the discount despite their loyalty to the retailer," Dr. Sadeque said.

In the age of digital marketing algorithms and discount codes, engaging customers through LPs can create both challenges and opportunities for...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 无论您喜欢超市的忠诚度折扣还是经常忘记携带忠诚卡，忠诚度计划 (LP) 都可以成为生活成本压力日益增大的家庭的重要支持。 零售商提供的 LP 数量正在增加。在全球范围内，忠诚度管理市场的价值预计将从 2026 年的 173.8 亿美元增长到 2034 年的 516.5 亿美元。随着生活成本压力迫使家庭寻求折扣、优惠券、礼品和代金券以减少购物支出，该市场将继续扩大。 埃迪斯科文大学 (ECU) 领导的一项新研究分析了 800 多名澳大利亚超市客户的调查数据，以更好地了解影响客户与 LP 互动的因素以及这些计划如何有效地影响零售商的忠诚度。 研究结果将帮助零售商根据对客户最重要的因素来设计 LP。 ECU 商法学院营销与服务科学教授 Sanjit Roy 表示，研究发现，客户行为和零售商忠诚度是由客户的特征以及与有限合伙人互动的能力驱动的。 “许多顾客没有时间进行精神成本效益分析。我得到了什么，我放弃了什么？零售商知道这一点，因此他们会在付款前在结账时提示您，无论是在自助结账处还是通过客户服务代表询问：“您想扫描您的奖励卡吗？您想扫描您的 Flybuys 卡吗？”零售商知道如何强化我们的习惯，”罗伊解释道。 “但作为客户，我们失去的比我们得到的更多。如果我们每花一美元就赚取一分，并且每消费 2,000 分，我们就会收到一张 10 美元的代金券——当折扣和促销活动没有个性化或根据我们的购买习惯定制作为对我们忠诚度的奖励时，是否值得交出我们的个人数据？因此，是否值得注册忠诚度计划？” 结果表明，有限合伙人的参与度会提高零售商的参与度和客户忠诚度——包括对客户选择的零售商的态度和行为。 “如果顾客预测他们经常购买的商品将来会有折扣，他们可能会等待一两周才能购买，然后购买更多相同的产品。但如果他们没有能力等待——就像父母迫切需要尿布或预算太紧张而无法批量购买一样——他们就会错过折扣，尽管他们对零售商很忠诚，”萨德克博士说。 在数字营销算法和折扣代码的时代，通过有限合伙人吸引客户可以为……带来挑战和机遇。

title.en: Hyperdoped silicon photodiode advances short-wave infrared detection at room temperature
title.zh: 超掺杂硅光电二极管推进室温短波红外检测

summary.en: Detecting short-wave infrared (SWIR) light, a region of the electromagnetic spectrum just beyond the light visible to the human eye, could be advantageous for many real-world applications. For instance, it could enable more advanced systems for capturing images at night, as well...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Detecting short-wave infrared (SWIR) light, a region of the electromagnetic spectrum just beyond the light visible to the human eye, could be advantageous for many real-world applications. For instance, it could enable more advanced systems for capturing images at night, as well as sophisticated medical imaging, environmental monitoring and industrial inspection technologies.

Despite their potential, most SWIR detection devices developed so far are based on expensive semiconducting materials that are often difficult to integrate with existing electronic hardware. This is because silicon, the most widely used semiconductor in the electronics industry, cannot absorb SWIR photons due to its wide band gap.

Researchers at Complutense University of Madrid have developed a silicon photodiode that can efficiently absorb SWIR light and is compatible with current electronics manufacturing processes. The new device, introduced in a paper published in Physical Review Letters , is based on silicon doped with a high concentration of tellurium (Te) atoms.

"Our primary objective with this research was to essentially 'democratize' SWIR technology," Eric García-Hemme, first author of the paper, told Phys.org.

"Currently, SWIR detection relies on expensive materials like InGaAs, but by enabling silicon to see in this spectrum, we can drastically lower manufacturing costs and open the door to mass-market applications. The scientific community working on hyperdoped silicon for photodetection had hit a performance ceiling.

"When we analyzed the problem, we realized that while the material successfully detects SWIR light, the specific fabrication methods we use (which operate outside thermodynamic equilibrium) only allow us to create very thin active layers."

When they reviewed earlier efforts aimed at creating SWIR detectors based on hyperdoped silicon, the researchers realized that previously produced materials were simply too thin to absorb much of the incoming light. To overcome this limitation, they tried to decouple a material's light absorption properties from its thickness.

"We implemented advanced light-trapping techniques, including micro-texturing the silicon surface with pyramids and adding a gold mirror," said García-Hemme. "This architecture forces the light to reflect back and forth inside the thin hyperdoped layer, significantly increasing its optical path and dramatically boosting the device's overall photoresponse."

Typically, silicon is transparent to much of the SWIR spectrum, as photons in this range do not carry enough energy to push electrons across its...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 检测短波红外（SWIR）光（电磁频谱中的一个区域，刚好超出人眼可见光的范围）对于许多实际应用来说可能是有利的。例如，它可以支持更先进的夜间图像捕获系统，以及复杂的医学成像、环境监测和工业检查技术。 尽管潜力巨大，但迄今为止开发的大多数短波红外检测设备都是基于昂贵的半导体材料，这些材料通常很难与现有的电子硬件集成。这是因为硅是电子工业中使用最广泛的半导体，由于其宽带隙而无法吸收短波红外光子。 马德里康普顿斯大学的研究人员开发了一种硅光电二极管，可以有效吸收短波红外光，并且与当前的电子制造工艺兼容。这种新器件是在《物理评论快报》上发表的一篇论文中介绍的，它基于掺杂高浓度碲 (Te) 原子的硅。 该论文的第一作者 Eric García-Hemme 告诉 Phys.org：“我们这项研究的主要目标是从本质上‘民主化’短波红外技术。” “目前，SWIR 检测依赖于 InGaAs 等昂贵的材料，但通过使硅能够看到该光谱，我们可以大幅降低制造成本，并为大众市场应用打开大门。致力于用于光电检测的超掺杂硅的科学界已经达到了性能上限。 “当我们分析这个问题时，我们意识到，虽然该材料成功地检测短波红外光，但我们使用的特定制造方法（在热力学平衡之外操作）只能让我们创建非常薄的活性层。” 当他们回顾早期旨在创建基于超掺杂硅的短波红外探测器的努力时，研究人员意识到以前生产的材料太薄，无法吸收大部分入射光。为了克服这一限制，他们试图将材料的光吸收特性与其厚度分离。 “我们采用了先进的光捕获技术，包括用金字塔对硅表面进行微纹理处理并添加金镜，”García-Hemme 说道。 “这种架构迫使光在超掺杂薄层内来回反射，显着增加其光程并显着提高设备的整体光响应。” 通常，硅对大部分短波红外光谱是透明的，因为该范围内的光子没有携带足够的能量来推动电子穿过其...
