title.en: Appropriated racial oppression shapes Black parents' socialization of children
title.zh: 适当的种族压迫塑造了黑人父母对孩子的社会化

summary.en: Black parents who experienced higher levels of appropriated racial oppression—defined as shaping one's behavior and self-concept around dominant cultural norms of whiteness—were less likely to transmit positive, culturally protective messages that affirmed racial pride and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Black parents who experienced higher levels of appropriated racial oppression—defined as shaping one's behavior and self-concept around dominant cultural norms of whiteness—were less likely to transmit positive, culturally protective messages that affirmed racial pride and self-worth to their adolescent children, a recent study found.

However, these effects were moderated by skin tone, becoming more pronounced among lighter-skinned parents and teens, said first author Shardé McNeil Smith, a professor of human development and family studies and African American studies at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

Published in the Journal of Social and Personal Relationships , the study was co-written by then-research coordinator Jaden Anderson and Shawn C.T. Jones, a professor and the director of the counseling psychology program, both of Virginia Commonwealth University; and U. of I. graduate students Anisa Codamon and Chelsea S. Alexander.

The findings raise troubling questions about the generational effects of racial oppression and how it may hamper parents' ability to instill resilience, cultural pride and other protective qualities that prepare youths for navigating a racialized society, Smith said.

"We know that Black parents engage in parenting practices that help their children if and when they encounter racial discrimination, but we find that parents' own racialized worldview can impact their ability to transmit positive messages that are empirically found to promote well-being," Smith said. "Interestingly, our research found that this is particularly apparent for parents and youth with lighter skin tones."

The study included 201 pairs of Black parents—75% of whom were the mothers—and their adolescent children who were part of the Ethnic and Racial Dynamics in Black Families project. About 15% of the adults were the children's fathers, and the remainder were other relatives who were the children's primary caregivers, such as grandparents or aunts.

The adults' average age was about 43, while the adolescents' average age was about 15. The majority of the adults were college educated, having earned two- or four-year college degrees or master's, doctoral or professional degrees, according to the study.

The adults' levels of appropriated racial oppression were assessed with a 24-item scale that examined their emotional responses to being a member of their race, negative perceptions of their racial group and beauty standards such as their perceptions of attractiveness or superiority associated with skin tones. In addition, the scale measured the adults'...

title.en: Island could protect 30% of waters in marine plan
title.zh: 岛屿可以保护海洋计划中30%的水域

summary.en: The proposal would give added protection to about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An island wants to protect 30% of its waters under plans aimed at safeguarding marine life.

The proposal would see about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark in the Channel Islands receive additional protection under plans developed by the island's agriculture, environment and sea fisheries committee with support from the Blue Marine Foundation, local fishermen and marine experts.

Freddie Watson, Channel Islands project manager at Blue Marine Foundation, told BBC Radio Guernsey that marine protection could help safeguard sensitive habitats while supporting sustainable fishing.

The proposal is expected to be submitted to the island's governing Chief Pleas by 1 September.

Watson explained that evidence had been used to identify important habitats, including previously unmapped areas of seagrass, so protection could be focused where it was needed most.

The waters around Sark are home to species including European spiny lobster, rays, catsharks, octopus and pink sea fans.

Watson said the plans formed part of a wider effort across the Channel Islands to safeguard marine environments, including a plan to protect more than 20% of Jersey's waters.

Watson said stronger protection could bring benefits for both wildlife and people by helping to sustain fish stocks and preserve habitats that support marine biodiversity.

He added: "Some of those habitats are really important at drawing down and locking away carbon."

The Sark proposal depends on political approval, with members of Chief Pleas expected to debate the plans on 30 September.

body.zh: 一个岛屿希望根据旨在保护海洋生物的计划保护其 30% 的水域。 根据该提案，海峡群岛萨克岛周围约 50 平方英里（128.8 平方公里）的海域将根据该岛农业、环境和海洋渔业委员会在蓝色海洋基金会、当地渔民和海洋专家的支持下制定的计划获得额外保护。 蓝色海洋基金会海峡群岛项目经理弗雷迪·沃森 (Freddie Watson) 告诉 BBC 根西岛广播电台，海洋保护可以帮助保护敏感栖息地，同时支持可持续捕捞。 该提案预计将于 9 月 1 日提交给该岛的行政长官。 沃森解释说，证据已被用来识别重要的栖息地，包括以前未绘制地图的海草区域，因此可以将保护重点放在最需要的地方。 萨克岛周围的水域是欧洲龙虾、鳐鱼、猫鲨、章鱼和粉红海扇等物种的家园。 沃森表示，这些计划是整个海峡群岛保护海洋环境的更广泛努力的一部分，其中包括保护泽西岛超过 20% 水域的计划。 沃森表示，加强保护可以帮助维持鱼类种群和支持海洋生物多样性的栖息地，从而为野生动物和人类带来好处。 他补充道：“其中一些栖息地对于减少和锁定碳非常重要。” 萨克岛提案取决于政治批准，Chief Pleas 成员预计将于 9 月 30 日就该计划进行辩论。 在 X, external 和 Facebook, external 上关注 BBC Guernsey。在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

title.en: Support groups for parents halved violence against children in wartime Ukraine, trial finds
title.zh: 审判发现，父母支持团体将乌克兰战时针对儿童的暴力行为减少了一半

summary.en: Ukrainian parents who joined a support group program called "Hope Groups," designed for families living through the war, reported that violence against children was cut in half and that they had less than half the depression and anxiety symptoms of parents who had not yet...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Ukrainian parents who joined a support group program called "Hope Groups," designed for families living through the war, reported that violence against children was cut in half and that they had less than half the depression and anxiety symptoms of parents who had not yet participated in the program, according to a new trial led by the University of Oxford.

These findings come from a randomized controlled trial of 510 parents and caregivers published in The Lancet Regional Health—Europe , led by researchers at Oxford's Department of Social Policy and Intervention, Ukrainian partner organizations, World Without Orphans and World Relief. It is among the first randomized trials to test whether a group-based mental health, parenting and violence prevention program can work during an active war, rather than after the fighting stops.

More than 1 in 5 children worldwide were living in a conflict zone in 2024, according to analysis by the Peace Research Institute Oslo. Decades of research on adverse childhood experiences demonstrate the lifelong consequences of trauma experienced in childhood, which makes the case for acting as soon as possible during a crisis.

Sydney Tucker, lead author, Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of Oxford, said, "Often, society may think that there is no way to protect families during an active war, and investment toward mental health or child protection programming may tragically wait until the war ends. However, if we wait, we are missing a crucial window of critical action.

"The evidence shows that investment to scale the Hope Groups intervention can bring significant relief for parents from depression and anxiety symptoms, and prevent violence against children, even amidst the active war."

After Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion, Ukrainians wanted resources related to how to care for their children and keep them safe from violence, and they also needed resources to process their own trauma, grief and loss. The Hope Groups were developed as a 12-session program from evidence-based content and adapted with Ukrainian parents, rather than an imported, ready-made program.

Groups of five to seven met wherever possible amidst the war: in shelters, community centers, churches and people's homes, or over Telegram video calls. Sessions were led by local facilitators recruited and trained through churches and community organizations, a deliberately nonclinical model designed to work in a crisis when systems are overwhelmed.

title.en: Researchers map tick habitat to strengthen African swine fever preparedness
title.zh: 研究人员绘制蜱虫栖息地地图以加强非洲猪瘟防范

summary.en: A small, nest-dwelling tick found across large parts of Texas could play an outsized role in how the United States responds to African swine fever (ASF) should the virus reach domestic or wild pigs.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A small, nest-dwelling tick found across large parts of Texas could play an outsized role in how the United States responds to African swine fever (ASF) should the virus reach domestic or wild pigs.

In a recent study , researchers at the Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences (VMBS), Texas A&M AgriLife Research and the Department of Biology mapped where Ornithodoros turicata—a soft tick species native to Texas and the southwestern United States—is most likely to survive and examined what that means for ASF preparedness. The work was published in the journal Ecology and Evolution .

Led by Dr. Meriam Saleh, a clinical assistant professor in VMBS' Department of Veterinary Pathobiology, the project seeks to understand whether Texas-derived populations of the tick could help sustain or transmit the virus if it were introduced into the U.S.—and how that risk could affect the food supply, trade and cross-border livestock movement.

The study is co-led by Dr. Dee Ellis, a veterinarian in AgriLife Research and the Department of Entomology. Ellis focuses on the industry and stakeholder impacts of the virus. Though ASF is not currently in the U.S., it is present in the Caribbean, Europe, Africa and parts of Asia. The virus is highly contagious in pigs and often fatal, making it one of the most economically devastating livestock diseases in the world.

"It's on our doorstep," Saleh said. "Even though introduction isn't probable, it's possible—and because the consequences are so severe, it warrants serious attention."

In countries where ASF has been introduced, outbreaks have led to mass depopulation of herds, long-term trade restrictions and billions of dollars in losses.

The U.S. pork industry contributes more than $50 billion annually to the national gross domestic product and supports more than 550,000 jobs across production, processing and export sectors. The U.S. is one of the world's leading pork exporters, and international trade depends heavily on disease-free status.

If ASF were detected in the U.S., immediate export bans and large-scale control measures would likely follow.

"Because the implications are so severe, even a low-probability risk deserves close scrutiny," Saleh said.

ASF spreads primarily through direct contact between infected pigs, contaminated feed or meat products and infected environments. However, in parts of Africa where the virus is endemic, it is maintained in wildlife through soft ticks in the same genus as O. turicata.

title.en: Utah mountain ranges may store a billion tons of hidden ice
title.zh: 犹他山脉可能蕴藏着十亿吨隐藏的冰

summary.en: Unlike conventional glaciers, rock glaciers appear as piles of rock that obscure large masses of unaccounted-for ice. Rock glaciers are common in the Wasatch and Uinta ranges, even appearing on the Colorado Plateau in the La Sal Mountains near Moab.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Unlike conventional glaciers, rock glaciers appear as piles of rock that obscure large masses of unaccounted-for ice. Rock glaciers are common in the Wasatch and Uinta ranges, even appearing on the Colorado Plateau in the La Sal Mountains near Moab.

Now, University of Utah geologists are bringing one of Utah's largest rock glaciers, located under the towering summit of Mount Timpanogos near Salt Lake City and Provo, into sharp focus. Two new studies document how Timpanogos Rock Glacier formed and how much ice it contains. By measuring minute differences in gravitational pull between rock and ice, the team created a novel technique to image the 3D ice body within a large rock glacier.

Timpanogos Rock Glacier stores enough frozen water to fill 600 Olympic swimming pools, or 1.5 million cubic meters (about 396 million gallons). That is also equivalent to the volume of the largest pyramid at Giza in Egypt, according to Bronson Cvijanovich, a former graduate student in the Department of Geology & Geophysics.

"Timpanogos Rock Glacier is surprisingly ice-rich. It is 83% ice and 17% loose rock," said Cvijanovich, the lead author of one of two studies overseen by geophysics professor Michael Thorne and glaciology professor Leif Anderson.

"There's a lot of ice that's hidden in Utah's mountains," Anderson said. "When we are high in the mountains and walking across loose rocks or rubble, you don't realize there could be 120 feet (37 meters) of ice buried beneath your feet."

Cvijanovich led field campaigns to Timpanogos Rock Glacier, hauling sensitive instruments, including a state-of-the-art gravimeter, to the ice buried above Emerald Lake in fall 2024. Over the course of six forays, Cvijanovich took gravity readings at 232 locations, separated by 25 meters (about 80 feet), in a grid atop the rock glacier.

The gravimeter measures density differences between rock and ice, enabling scientists to calculate the 3D shape of the buried ice body. "There is a large contrast in mass density between the rock that makes up Mount Timpanogos and the much lower-density ice that is in the rock glacier adjacent to it," Thorne said. "When we measure the gravitational acceleration over the rock glacier, we see a larger decrease in that gravitational acceleration as we make measurements over areas with thicker ice."

title.en: New quantum computing method broadens spectroscopy of hard-to-model matter
title.zh: 新的量子计算方法拓宽了难以建模物质的光谱

summary.en: Scientists could have a new way to explore the hidden behavior of matter, thanks to research involving Queen Mary University of London that uses a quantum computer to carry out a new form of computational spectroscopy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists could have a new way to explore the hidden behavior of matter, thanks to research involving Queen Mary University of London that uses a quantum computer to carry out a new form of computational spectroscopy.

Spectroscopy is an important scientific technique used to understand the properties of matter. By analyzing how materials and molecules respond to energy or light, researchers can gain insights into their structure and behavior. Computational approaches can complement these experiments by allowing scientists to investigate and predict properties using theoretical models and simulations.

However, quantum systems can be exceptionally difficult to model using conventional computers. The new research, published in Nature Communications, develops a generalized approach to quantum computational spectroscopy that allows researchers to study a much broader range of quantum systems.

The method can be used not only for relatively simple, static systems but also for systems that are affected by their environment or change over time. The researchers reconstructed a key measure of quantum behavior using a quantum computing technique known as an ancilla-assisted Hadamard test.

The researchers used the method to investigate unusual quantum phenomena, including parity-time symmetry breaking and topological holonomy. These examples demonstrate how quantum computational spectroscopy could provide insights into quantum behavior that are difficult to access using conventional spectroscopy or existing quantum approaches.

The work could ultimately be relevant to areas including physics, chemistry and materials science. Computational spectroscopy can help researchers investigate the properties of real or hypothetical materials before they are produced experimentally, with potential applications in areas such as molecular engineering, drug design and advanced materials research.

Dr. Jinzhao Sun, from the School of Physical and Chemical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London, led the theoretical aspect of the study. The research represents a step toward using quantum computers not simply to perform calculations but to serve as tools for exploring and understanding the behavior of complex quantum systems.

As quantum computing technology develops, approaches such as this could provide scientists with new ways to investigate phenomena that are difficult to reproduce or calculate using conventional methods.

title.en: Yellow warnings remain in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
title.zh: 由于降雨和雷暴袭击英国部分地区，黄色预警仍然有效

summary.en: Yellow warnings updated as torrential downpours affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Downpours and thunderstorms will continue to bring the risk of flooding to parts of the UK on Wednesday.

A Met Office yellow warning for thunderstorms is valid until 22:00 BST, and was amended on Wednesday morning to cover northern and eastern Wales, as well as north-west England, the Midlands and parts of eastern and southern England.

The rain could be heavy enough to bring flash flooding and travel disruption, with lightning and large hail posing additional hazards.

Another Met Office yellow warning is in place for Thursday, when more thunderstorms are expected.

For some areas that have seen barely any rain so far this August, the next few days could bring the wettest weather in many weeks.

The Met Office yellow thunderstorm warning covers a large swathe of England and Wales.

As much as 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) of rain could fall in some locations within just an hour, and it is even possible that 40-50mm (1.6-2in) could accumulate over a few hours.

However, due to the hit-and-miss nature of showers, some places will miss the rain and weather apps may struggle to get the detail of the forecast correct.

Where the rain does fall, flash flooding is a real concern. This will be especially problematic where the ground is hard after the prolonged dry spell, making it difficult for the water to soak in.

Difficult driving conditions are expected with the chance that some roads could be closed.

Northern Ireland will also see some showers but these are likely to be less intense with less thunder.

Many parts of Scotland will remain dry with sunny spells, although some showers are likely in the south-west later.

Thursday will bring another zone of thunderstorms, again affecting mostly England and Wales.

The Met Office has issued a further yellow weather warning, valid from 06:00 until 22:00 BST.

Widespread rainfall totals of 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) are expected in the warning area within three hours, while some areas could see 50mm (2in) within the same timeframe.

There is a small chance that eastern-facing hills - exposed to easterly winds - could record 75mm (3in) during 12 hours, which would bring a significant flood risk.

Gusty winds may also accompany the storms, especially in southern England on Thursday morning.

The showers may eventually reach southern Scotland and Northern Ireland but are likely to weaken and become less intense as they drift northwards.

Despite a period of unsettled weather last week, some southern parts of the UK have still seen barely any rain recently.

Brize Norton in Oxfordshire has recorded just 0.4mm of rain so far this August, less than 1% of what it would normally expect during the month as a whole.

It means the rain we are expecting this week is likely to far outstrip what has fallen recently in some areas.

title.en: Things are getting worse, says litter picker
title.zh: 捡垃圾的人说情况变得更糟

body.en:
An 81-year-old anti-littering campaigner has travelled across the country encouraging people to pick up rubbish rather than dropping it.

Ruth Major, from Redruth, Cornwall visited all 39 BBC radio stations in England across 55 days armed with a litter picker and a bus pass.

Affectionately known as Rubbish Ruth, she has collected litter for 10 years and said "things are getting worse".

"We live in a beautiful country and we should be so ashamed of what's happening in it," she said.

title.en: RSPB reports record-breaking chough numbers
title.zh: RSPB报告鹪鹩数量创纪录

summary.en: RSPB England reports a record 161 choughs counted, an increase of 32 from the 129 recorded last year. These birds, which had died out in Cornwall in the 1970s and returned in 2001, are now thriving due to successful breeding and inter-agency cooperation.
summary.zh: 英国皇家鸟类保护协会（RSPB）报告称，今年夏天在康沃尔海岸线上筑巢的鹪鹩数量创下纪录，共有161只，比去年的129只增加了32只。该鸟类在20世纪70年代在康沃尔灭绝，于2001年回归。今年的成功归功于56个繁殖对的努力以及各机构、农民和地主的合作。

body.en:
A record-breaking number of choughs have made their nests around the Cornish coastline this summer, proving the breed is in "robust health", a bird conservation charity has said.

RSPB England said 161 choughs had been counted in Cornwall - 32 more than the 129 recorded in 2025 .

The charity said the new birds came from 56 successful breeding pairs, meaning the average productivity of a Cornish chough nest was three fledglings.

It said choughs died out in Cornwall in the 1970s but returned in 2001 when three birds believed to be from Ireland landed at Lizard Point and began rebreeding. The National Trust added the success had been down to cooperation between agencies, farmers and landowners.

The birds, part of the carrion crow family, have a particular significance in Cornwall, featuring on the county's official coat of arms, alongside a miner and a fisherman.

Peter Hall, a National Trust chough monitoring volunteer on the Lizard, is in his 11th year of monitoring the nest sites.

He said he had not foreseen a time when he would be monitoring so many sites -"certainly not having 16 choughlets fledge".

Hall said: "The past two winters we have been blessed with chatterings in excess of 20 chough around the Lizard - a far cry from the solitary single pair we had when I started as part of the then nest protection team in 2016.

"Long may the successful return of this iconic Cornish bird delight myself and others."

The charity said the Lizard was the prime breeding ground for the Cornish chough, with 26 chicks, 11 more than 2025, emerging from eight nests on the peninsula.

National Trust volunteer Lydia Allt said 2026 had been "an exceptional one" for choughs on the Lizard and across Cornwall.

She said: "Thanks to a quarter of a century of conservation work, partnership working and the support of local farmers and land managers, we are seeing record numbers ofchough across the area.

"Their remarkable recovery shows what can be achieved when habitats are restored and protected, giving wildlife the space it needs to thrive.

"To see so many choughs successfully breeding and feeding across the Lizard is incredibly encouraging and highlights the importance of continuing to care for this special landscape for future generations."

Andrew Jones, chough conservation officer for the RSPB in Cornwall, said the repopulation work would not be possible without volunteers.

He said: "There has been a huge volunteer effort over the past 25 years to protect and monitor Cornwall's iconic choughs and we're grateful to everyone who has played their part in this conservation success story.

"This year, the RSPB and National Trust have had a team of around 50 dedicated volunteer chough watchers, covering the coastline from the Roseland all the way round to Bude,...
body.zh: 一家鸟类保护慈善机构表示，今年夏天，康沃尔海岸线附近筑巢的山鸦数量打破了纪录，证明该品种处于“健康状态”。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会表示，康沃尔郡已统计到 161 只山鸦，比 2025 年记录的 129 只多了 32 只。 该慈善机构表示，这些新鸟来自 56 对成功繁殖的鸟，这意味着康沃尔山鸦巢的平均生产力为三只雏鸟。 报告称，康沃尔郡的山鸦于 1970 年代灭绝，但在 2001 年又回归，当时三只据信来自爱​​尔兰的鸟降落在 Lizard Point 并开始重新繁殖。国民信托补充说，成功归功于各机构、农民和土地所有者之间的合作。 这些鸟是腐肉乌鸦家族的一部分，在康沃尔郡具有特殊的意义，与矿工和渔夫一起出现在该县的官方徽章上。 彼得·霍尔 (Peter Hall) 是一名国家信托山鸦监测蜥蜴的志愿者，今年已经是他监测巢穴的第 11 个年头了。 他说，他没有预见到自己会监控如此多的地点——“当然没有 16 只小山雀羽翼未丰”。 霍尔说：“过去两个冬天，我们有幸看到超过 20 只山鸦在蜥蜴周围叽叽喳喳地叫个不停，这与我 2016 年加入当时的巢穴保护团队时看到的单独一对相去甚远。 “祝愿这只标志性的康沃尔鸟成功回归，让我和其他人感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，这种蜥蜴是康沃尔山鸦的主要繁殖地，半岛上的 8 个巢中共有 26 只雏鸟，比 2025 年增加了 11 只。 国家信托志愿者莉迪亚·奥尔特 (Lydia Allt) 表示，2026 年对于蜥蜴河和整个康沃尔郡的山鸦来说是“特殊的一年”。 她说：“由于四分之一个世纪的保护工作、合作伙伴关系以及当地农民和土地管理者的支持，我们看到该地区山鸦的数量创历史新高。 “它们的显着恢复表明，当栖息地得到恢复和保护，为野生动物提供繁衍生息所需的空间时，可以取得什么样的成就。 “看到如此多的山鸦成功地在蜥蜴身上繁殖和进食，真是令人鼓舞，也凸显了为子孙后代继续照顾这一特殊景观的重要性。” 康沃尔郡皇家鸟类保护协会的山鸦保护官员安德鲁·琼斯表示，如果没有志愿者，繁殖工作就不可能进行。 他说：“过去 25 年里，志愿者们为保护和监测康沃尔郡的标志性山鸦付出了巨大的努力，我们感谢所有在这一保护成功故事中做出贡献的人。 “今年，皇家鸟类保护协会和国家信托基金会组建了一支由约 50 名热忱的山鸦观察志愿者组成的团队，覆盖从罗斯兰一直到布德的海岸线，......

reflection.en: The resurgence of the chough in Cornwall is a hopeful sign of nature's resilience and the impact of dedicated conservation. It reminds us that even after periods of decline, life can flourish when efforts are made to protect and restore it, reflecting the goodness of creation.

title.en: 'Magical' and rare barn owl has bumper breeding season
title.zh: “神奇”的稀有仓鸮迎来丰收繁殖季

summary.en: Ten chicks have been successfully reared by two breeding pairs at secret sites across Fermanagh. This success follows years of conservation work, including farmers installing nest boxes and improving habitats. With fewer than 30 breeding pairs left in Northern Ireland, conservationists are asking the public to report...
summary.zh: 在菲曼郡的秘密地点，两对繁殖的仓鸮成功抚养了十只雏鸟。这一成功得益于多年的保育工作，包括农民安装巢箱和改善栖息地。北爱尔兰目前仅存不到30对繁殖的仓鸮，保育人士呼吁公众报告目击情况，以协助进一步的保护工作。

body.en:
Barn owls have had a bumper summer in County Fermanagh, with 10 chicks recorded across two sites.

The breeding success follows years of conservation work by Ulster Wildlife with local farmers installing nest boxes and improving habitat for the elusive bird.

There are thought to be fewer than 30 breeding pairs left in Northern Ireland. The chicks have had rings placed on their legs so that they can be recorded in any other areas they turn up in after leaving the nest.

People are being encouraged to report any sightings of barn owls across Northern Ireland, particularly in the west, to help fill in gaps in the records and even help protect important breeding areas.

The Fermanagh chicks are thought to be the first recorded ones in the county for half a century.

Most of Ulster Wildlife's barn owl records come from the east of Northern Ireland.

The two broods of five chicks appeared in nest boxes that had been installed at different sites, after more than a decade of work with landowners.

The locations are being kept secret to help protect the rare, locally endangered bird.

Katy Bell, a senior conservation officer from Ulster Wildlife, said nest boxes play a part, but the willingness of farmers to adapt to the needs of the "magical, mystical" barn owl has been important too.

"We've been working closely with landowners, advising on land management and also putting up boxes," she said.

"So it's the combination of both - really you need nice thick hedgerows, lots of kind of rough areas and long grass for them to hunt over and then somewhere for them to nest. And that's really exciting."

The charity has worked closely with BirdWatch Ireland and has seen the population start to spread up from County Cavan.

The chicks have had small identification rings placed round their legs so that they can be traced when they are spotted again.

It is the first time chicks are known to have been ringed in Fermanagh under licence from the Northern Ireland Environment Agency, with support from the British Trust for Ornithology.

The birds are now red-listed - classified as being at risk of extinction - largely due to a loss of habitat but also the use of pesticide.

"They get poisoned with rodenticides, the loss of trees for them to nest in, the loss of nice big hedgerows for them to hunt over, the loss of rough ground for them to hunt over. They do get hit on our roads.

"They're just really up against it, so anything that we can do to create little safe havens for them here Is just they really need."

Those safe havens come in the form of nest boxes, specially designed to resemble the tree cavities barn owls nest in that are disappearing from our countryside.

Conservationists can access the nests to check on any chicks and ensure their wellbeing.

body.zh: 弗马纳郡的仓鸮度过了一个丰收的夏天，两个地点共记录到了 10 只仓鸮雏鸟。 此次繁殖成功是阿尔斯特野生动物协会多年来与当地农民合作开展的保护工作，为这种难以捉摸的鸟类安装了巢箱并改善了栖息地。 据信，北爱尔兰仅剩不到 30 对繁殖对。小鸡的腿上戴着环，这样就可以记录它们离开巢穴后出现的任何其他区域。 我们鼓励人们报告北爱尔兰各地（尤其是西部地区）看到的仓鸮的踪迹，以帮助填补记录空白，甚至帮助保护重要的繁殖区。 弗马纳小鸡被认为是半个世纪以来该县第一批有记录的小鸡。 阿尔斯特野生动物局的大部分仓鸮记录都来自北爱尔兰东部。 经过与土地所有者十多年的合作，两窝五只小鸡出现在安装在不同地点的巢箱中。 这些地点一直处于保密状态，以帮助保护这种稀有的、当地濒临灭绝的鸟类。 阿尔斯特野生动物管理局的高级保护官员凯蒂·贝尔表示，巢箱发挥了一定作用，但农民适应“神奇、神秘”仓鸮需求的意愿也很重要。 “我们一直在与土地所有者密切合作，提供土地管理方面的建议，并设立盒子，”她说。 “所以这是两者的结合——实际上你需要漂亮的茂密树篱、大量粗糙的区域和长草供它们捕猎，然后为它们筑巢。这真的很令人兴奋。” 该慈善机构与爱尔兰鸟类观察组织密切合作，发现鸟类开始从卡文郡扩散。 这些小鸡的腿上戴着小识别环，以便再次被发现时可以追踪它们。 这是第一次在北爱尔兰环境局的许可下，在英国鸟类学信托基金的支持下，在弗马纳对雏鸟进行圈养。 这些鸟类现已被列入红色名单，被列为濒临灭绝的鸟类，主要是由于栖息地的丧失以及杀虫剂的使用。 “它们被杀鼠剂中毒，失去了可供它们筑巢的树木，失去了可供它们狩猎的漂亮大树篱，失去了供它们狩猎的粗糙地面。它们确实在我们的道路上被击中。 “他们真的很反对，所以我们可以做任何事情来为他们创造小小的安全港，这正是他们真正需要的。” 这些安全港以巢箱的形式出现，专门设计成类似于谷仓猫头鹰筑巢的树洞，而这些树洞正在从我们的乡村消失。 自然资源保护者可以进入巢穴检查雏鸟并确保它们的健康。 还有...

reflection.en: The remarkable breeding success of the rare barn owls in Fermanagh is a beautiful reminder of the intricate wisdom woven into the fabric of creation. Psalm 104:24 marvels at the diversity and abundance Yahweh has made, and this story offers a glimpse of that wonder in action. It speaks to the deep satisfaction found in observing and participating in the...
reflection.zh: 菲曼郡稀有仓鸮繁殖的惊人成功，提醒我们造物中蕴含的精妙智慧。诗篇104:24赞叹雅伟所造的万物多样而丰盛，这个故事让我们得以一窥那奇妙的运作。它体现了观察和参与生命繁荣所带来的深刻满足感，是造物主持续工作的见证。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Fires still burn in charred landscape as focus turns to wildfire prevention
title.zh: 野火仍在燃烧，焦点转向野火预防

summary.en: The RSPB is considering measures to improve resilience following a five-week wildfire in the Cairngorms, with hot-spots still emerging a week after firefighters left the scene.
summary.zh: 在苏格兰凯恩戈姆山脉发生长达五周的野火后，皇家鸟类保护协会（RSPB）正在考虑采取措施提高韧性，消防员离开现场一周后，仍有余烬点出现。

body.en:
As we're driving in a pickup truck to see the aftermath of a huge fire which burnt for more than a month in the Cairngorms, I spot fresh smoke coming from the ground.

My guide - RSPB Scotland's site manager at the Abernethy nature reserve, Ben Oliver-Jones - puts the vehicle in reverse and we jump out to see what's happening.

It's one of several hot-spots which keeps emerging a full week after firefighters left the scene , which Ben likens to a game of whack-a-mole in an already charred landscape where the smell of burning still hangs heavily in the air.

But while the small pockets of smouldering vegetation are still being dealt with, attention is turning to improving wildfire protection.

More than 2,500 hectares of moorland and forest - about 10 square miles - was destroyed in the fire, which led to the evacuation of an entire village and where the smoke could be seen and smelt 60 miles (96.5km) away in Aberdeen.

Like a growing number of Scotland's estates, the Loch Garten and Abernethy nature reserve is being managed for ecological restoration - what others might describe as 'rewilding', a now polarising term which the RSPB avoids using.

Opponents have argued that the process leaves areas more vulnerable to uncontrollable fires, which the charity disputes, but it has identified significant land management changes it plans to make.

The changes focus on four key areas: fire breaks, wetlands, heather management and tree planting.

While the estate's network of tracks functioned as a fire break in some locations, in other areas strong winds helped high flames jump the gap.

Experts say fire from burning heather can reach heights of six metres and that fire breaks need to be three times the flame height.

RSPB Scotland says it now acknowledges that fire breaks need to be wider and has already started that process on its long network of forest trails.

Machines have been used to remove vegetation on either side of the track with the hope that what remains would not create such high flames if it were to ignite.

While it might look desolate now, the hope is that some insects and plant species will eventually colonise the ground either sides of the tracks.

It also plans to create more ponds and wet areas around the site which can be used as a source of water to pump onto fires.

A small fire on the reserve in June was extinguished using water from a pond created with cash from the Scottish government's nature restoration fund as a habitat for species like rare dragonflies.

The charity says it's working to raise water tables where bogs have been drained and create new areas of standing water for fire fighting.

Peatlands have proved problematic for wildfires because the fire can spread through the peat, deep underground as well as on the...
body.zh: 当我们开着一辆皮卡车去看凯恩戈姆一场大火烧了一个多月的余波时，我发现地面冒出新鲜的烟雾。 我的导游——皇家鸟类保护协会苏格兰阿伯内西自然保护区的现场经理本·奥利弗-琼斯——让车辆倒车，我们跳下车去看发生了什么。 这是消防员离开现场整整一周后不断出现的几个热点之一，本将其比作在已经烧焦的土地上进行的打地鼠游戏，空气中仍然弥漫着烧焦的气味。 不过，虽然仍在处理小片阴燃植被，但人们的注意力正在转向改善野火防护。 超过 2,500 公顷的沼泽地和森林（约 10 平方英里）在大火中被毁，导致整个村庄被疏散，在 60 英里（96.5 公里）外的阿伯丁也能看到并闻到浓烟。 与越来越多的苏格兰庄园一样，加滕湖和阿伯内西自然保护区也正在进行生态恢复管理——其他人可能将其描述为“野化”，这是一个现在两极分化的术语，皇家鸟类保护协会避免使用这个术语。 反对者认为，这一过程使地区更容易遭受无法控制的火灾，慈善机构对此提出了异议，但它已经确定了计划进行的重大土地管理改革。 这些变化集中在四个关键领域：防火带、湿地、石南花管理和植树。 虽然庄园的轨道网络在某些地方起到了防火带的作用，但在其他地区，强风帮助大火跳过了缺口。 专家表示，燃烧石南花的火可以达到六米的高度，火势需要是火焰高度的三倍。 苏格兰皇家鸟类保护协会表示，它现在承认防火带需要更宽，并且已经在其漫长的森林步道网络上开始了这一进程。 机器已被用来清除轨道两侧的植被，希望剩下的植物在点燃时不会产生如此高的火焰。 虽然现在看起来很荒凉，但希望一些昆虫和植物物种最终能够在铁轨两侧的地面上定居。 它还计划在现场周围建造更多的池塘和潮湿区域，可用作消防水源。 六月保护区发生的一场小火被扑灭，水来自一个池塘，该池塘是用苏格兰政府自然恢复基金的资金建造的，作为稀有蜻蜓等物种的栖息地。 该慈善机构表示，正在努力提高已排干沼泽的地下水位，并开辟新的积水区域用于消防。 事实证明，泥炭地容易引发野火，因为火可以通过泥炭、地下深处以及地面蔓延。

reflection.en: Even after the immediate danger of the Cairngorms wildfire has passed, smoldering hot-spots serve as a stark reminder of nature's power and the need for careful stewardship. The vastness and intricate systems of creation, as Psalm 104:24 reminds us, are a testament to Yahweh's wisdom, urging us to learn from these events and work towards greater resilience...
reflection.zh: 即使在凯恩戈姆山野火的直接危险过去后，仍在燃烧的余烬也令人警醒地提醒我们大自然的力量以及审慎管理的重要性。正如诗篇104:24所提醒我们的，创造的浩瀚与精妙系统是雅伟智慧的见证，促使我们从这些事件中学习，并努力提高韧性，更好地照管这片土地。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Toxic waste sites exposed in Michael Sheen documentary are 'tip of the iceberg'
title.zh: 迈克尔·辛的纪录片揭露的有毒废物场是“冰山一角”

summary.en: One scientist states that thousands of sites across the UK require investigation, with a former worker recalling inadequate protective equipment and a lack of information about the toxic waste he handled.
summary.zh: 一位科学家表示，英国各地有数千个地点需要调查，一位前工人回忆说，他使用的防护设备廉价且未被告知所埋藏的有毒废物。

body.en:
A former Monsanto worker who spent three years helping seal toxic waste underground said staff had "cheap" protective equipment and were not told what they were burying.

Stephen Constance worked at the chemical giant's Newport factory in the 1990s and came forward after the BBC documentary Buried with Michael Sheen highlighted Wales' toxic waste legacy.

But the 14 sites identified in the programme are just the tip of the iceberg and there are about 20,000 high-concern sites in the UK, said Dr David Megson, the scientist involved in the documentary.

Eastman Chemical Company, which is responsible for Monsanto's legacy production in the UK, did not respond when asked to comment.

Constance was one of dozens of people who contacted BBC Wales after coverage of Sheen's investigation into Monsanto and the dumping of polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs).

Researcher and whistleblower Douglas Gowan spent 50 years trying to persuade authorities to investigate what he believed was widespread dumping of industrial chemicals.

These included PCBs, which he called "some of the worst contaminants known to man", and were widely used in the 20th Century, including for lipstick and white goods.

They were banned in the UK in the 1970s and have since been banned by 151 countries.

Looking back, he said it was "quite evident that nobody was fully appraised of the potential hazard that they were exposed to".

The material was already buried when Constance arrived and it was his job to dig a 6m-deep trench around the outside of the mound before it was sealed using plastic membrane sheets and liquid clay.

While he believes this prevented airborne contamination, he is unsure if it would have stopped contamination into the Earth due to the high water table linked to the tides.

When asked if he felt safe, he said: "In terms of what we knew was there and what we were potentially exposed to, no."

Constance is in remission from cancer after having follicular lymphoma , external .

"I'm not suggesting in any way at all that it's linked, but the thought did cross my mind," he said.

In the documentary, journalists Dan Ashby and Lucy Taylor reveal a memo from Monsanto dated to 1972 which found that it knew PCBs were a danger to human health and was closing its site in the US as a result of legal action from a town.

"The government in the UK told the industry 'we're not going to put any restrictions on importing PCBs'," said Ashby.

Dr Megson, a reader in chemistry and environmental forensics at Manchester Metropolitan University, led the scientific data collection in the documentary.

"Public pressure is the only thing that's going to make this action happen. This is our only chance, if I'm being brutally honest.

"What our data shows is those sites are leaking and those sites...
body.zh: 一名花了三年时间帮助将有毒废物密封在地下的前孟山都员工表示，工作人员拥有“廉价”的防护设备，并且不知道他们要埋什么。 史蒂芬·康斯坦斯 (Stephen Constance) 于 20 世纪 90 年代在这家化学巨头的纽波特工厂工作，在 BBC 纪录片《与迈克尔·辛一起埋葬》(Buried with Michael Sheen) 强调了威尔士的有毒废物遗留问题后，他挺身而出。 但参与该纪录片的科学家 David Megson 博士表示，该计划中确定的 14 个地点只是冰山一角，英国大约有 20,000 个高度关注的地点。 负责孟山都在英国传统生产的伊士曼化学公司在被要求置评时没有回应。 在报道辛对孟山都公司和倾倒多氯联苯 (PCB) 的调查后，康斯坦斯是联系 BBC 威尔士的数十人之一。 研究人员兼举报人道格拉斯·高恩 (Douglas Gowan) 花了 50 年的时间试图说服当局调查他认为普遍存在的工业化学品倾倒现象。 其中包括多氯联苯，他称之为“人类已知的一些最严重的污染物”，并在 20 世纪被广泛使用，包括用于口红和白色家电。 它们于 20 世纪 70 年代在英国被禁止，此后已被 151 个国家禁止。 回顾过去，他说“很明显，没有人充分评估他们所面临的潜在危险”。 当康斯坦斯到达时，这些材料已经被掩埋了，他的工作是在土堆外部挖一条 6m 深的沟槽，然后用塑料膜片和液体粘土密封。 虽然他相信这可以防止空气污染，但他不确定由于与潮汐有关的高地下水位，这是否会阻止对地球的污染。 当被问及他是否感到安全时，他说：“就我们所知的情况以及我们可能接触到的情况而言，不安全。” 康斯坦斯患有外部滤泡性淋巴瘤后，癌症已得到缓解。 “我并不是以任何方式暗示两者之间存在联系，但这个想法确实闪过我的脑海，”他说。 在纪录片中，记者丹·阿什比和露西·泰勒透露了孟山都公司 1972 年的一份备忘录，其中发现孟山都公司知道多氯联苯对人类健康构成威胁，并且由于一个城镇的法律诉讼而关闭了其在美国的工厂。 “英国政府告诉业界‘我们不会对进口多氯联苯施加任何限制’，”阿什比说。 曼彻斯特城市大学化学和环境法医学专业的读者梅格森博士领导了纪录片中的科学数据收集工作。 “公众压力是唯一能让这一行动发生的因素。如果我说实话，这是我们唯一的机会。 “我们的数据显示，这些网站正在泄露，并且这些网站......

reflection.en: The report of toxic waste sites and a former worker's experience of inadequate protection and withheld information points to a deep need for justice and accountability. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide how industries handle hazardous materials and treat their employees.
reflection.zh: 有毒废物场地的报道以及一位前工人的经历——防护不足和信息被隐瞒——都指向了对公正和问责的深切需求。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则应指导各行业如何处理危险品以及如何对待员工。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Sand overextraction weakening riverbanks as concrete demand soars
title.zh: 沙子过度开采削弱河岸，混凝土需求激增

summary.en: Research indicates that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled since 2000, with 80% of current demand originating from Asia. This surge in demand, driven by concrete production for global construction projects, is leading to the extraction of these materials from riverbeds at a rate faster than natural...
summary.zh: 研究表明，自2000年以来，沙子和砾石的需求量增加了一倍多，目前80%的需求来自亚洲。由于混凝土生产对全球建筑项目的需求激增，这些材料正以比自然补充速度更快的速度从河床中提取。研究强调了其后果，包括河岸变弱、地下水位下降、沿海盐水入侵以及水质恶化。2024年，全球有280亿吨沙子和砾石被用于制造混凝土。

body.en: Research finds demand has more than doubled since 2000 and 80% of current demand comes from Asia A booming demand for concrete has resulted in sand and gravel being extracted from riverbeds faster than nature can replenish it. A study published in Reviews of Geophysics shows that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled in the last two decades, with overextraction leading to weaker riverbanks, lower groundwater levels, coastal salt intrusion and poorer water quality. In 2024, city-building and infrastructure projects around the world turned 28bn tonnes of sand and gravel into concrete. Researchers reviewed data on sand and gravel extraction going back to 1974 and have shown that since 2000 demand has more than doubled, with more than 80% of current demand coming from Asia, supporting urban development and road-building across China and India in particular. They found much of the material was being extracted from rivers across Asia and Africa. Data on extraction is scarce but where it does exist the researchers showed that extraction often exceeded natural sediment replacement severalfold. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 的需求来自亚洲。对混凝土的需求旺盛，导致从河床上提取沙子和砾石的速度超过了自然补充的速度。 《地球物理学评论》上发表的一项研究表明，过去二十年对沙子和砾石的需求增加了一倍多，过度开采导致河岸脆弱、地下水位降低、沿海盐分入侵和水质恶化。 2024 年，世界各地的城市建设和基础设施项目将 280 亿吨沙子和砾石转化为混凝土。研究人员回顾了自 1974 年以来的砂石开采数据，结果表明，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 以上的需求来自亚洲，支持着中国和印度的城市发展和道路建设。他们发现大部分材料是从亚洲和非洲的河流中提取的。有关提取的数据很少，但在确实存在的情况下，研究人员表明，提取量通常超过自然沉积物替代量的数倍。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless demand for construction materials, particularly sand and gravel, is straining the Earth's resources. This overextraction from riverbeds, as detailed in the research, disrupts natural systems and impacts water quality and stability. The Psalmist reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This perspective calls for...
reflection.zh: 对建筑材料，特别是沙子和砾石的无情需求，正在给地球的资源带来压力。正如研究中所详述的，从河床过度开采这些材料会破坏自然系统，并影响水质和稳定性。《诗篇》的作者提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属雅伟。”这一视角呼吁我们负责任地管理所托付给我们的资源，认识到它们的神圣起源和超越人类即时用途的内在价值。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Your genes may decide whether a low-carb diet sends cholesterol soaring
title.zh: 您的基因可能决定低碳水化合物饮食是否会导致胆固醇飙升

summary.en: A low-carb diet may raise LDL cholesterol much more sharply in people who are genetically predisposed to high cholesterol, particularly when they consume lots of saturated fat. The findings could help explain why people following seemingly similar diets can have dramatically...
summary.zh: 低碳水化合物饮食可能会使那些有高胆固醇遗传倾向的人的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平急剧升高，尤其是在他们摄入大量饱和脂肪的情况下。这些发现有助于解释为什么遵循看似相似饮食的人胆固醇反应会大相径庭……

body.en:
Low-carb diets have become increasingly popular, but their effects on cholesterol are far from uniform. Some people see little change, while others experience a substantial increase. New research suggests that genetics may help explain why.

The findings indicate that saturated fat, which can make up a larger share of some low-carb diets, may interact with a person's genetic makeup to raise low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol, a major contributor to heart disease risk. This genetic influence could help explain why two people following similar diets can have very different cholesterol responses.

"Our findings suggest that some individuals may be more sensitive to the LDL cholesterol-raising effects of saturated fat, particularly in the context of a low-carbohydrate diet, because of their genetic background," said Alexa Barad, PhD, RDN, a postdoctoral scholar at Stanford University School of Medicine. Barad presented the findings at NUTRITION 2026, the flagship annual meeting of the American Society for Nutrition.

"These findings highlight that there is real heterogeneity in how people respond to diet. Dietary conversations can sometimes become overly simplified. One person may say, 'Low-carb diets always raise LDL cholesterol,' while another says, 'My LDL cholesterol did not change at all.' Our findings suggest that both experiences can be true, depending, at least in part, on the individual's genetic makeup," said Barad.

Earlier research has found that healthy low carbohydrate diets can help some people lose weight and improve blood sugar control. Their impact on LDL cholesterol, however, has been inconsistent.

The researchers wanted to determine whether genetic information could help identify people who are more likely to benefit from eating fewer carbohydrates and those who may instead experience a potentially dangerous rise in LDL cholesterol.

The analysis used data from DIETFITS, a randomized controlled trial involving more than 600 adults who followed either a healthy low-carb diet or a healthy low-fat diet for one year. The original trial found no significant advantage for either diet when it came to weight loss.

For the new analysis, the researchers focused on 431 DIETFITS participants for whom genetic data were available. They examined how genotype, saturated fat consumption, diet type, and changes in LDL cholesterol from baseline to 6 months were related.

Among participants assigned to the low-carb diet, those who were genetically predisposed to higher LDL cholesterol were more likely to experience an increase.

The researchers found that greater sensitivity to saturated fat appeared to drive this pattern. Participants with the highest genetic risk showed the largest LDL increases when they consumed more saturated fat. The same...
body.zh: 低碳水化合物饮食越来越受欢迎，但它们对胆固醇的影响却远非均匀。有些人几乎看不到变化，而另一些人则经历了大幅增加。新研究表明遗传学可能有助于解释原因。 研究结果表明，饱和脂肪在一些低碳水化合物饮食中占较大比例，它可能与人的基因构成相互作用，从而提高低密度脂蛋白（LDL）胆固醇，而低密度脂蛋白胆固醇是心脏病风险的一个主要因素。这种遗传影响可能有助于解释为什么两个饮食相似的人会产生截然不同的胆固醇反应。 斯坦福大学医学院博士后学者 Alexa Barad 博士说：“我们的研究结果表明，某些人可能对饱和脂肪导致 LDL 胆固醇升高的影响更加敏感，特别是在低碳水化合物饮食的情况下，因为他们的遗传背景。” Barad 在美国营养学会的旗舰年会 NUTRITION 2026 上公布了这一发现。 “这些发现强调，人们对饮食的反应存在真正的异质性。饮食对话有时会变得过于简单。一个人可能会说，‘低碳水化合物饮食总是会升高低密度脂蛋白胆固醇’，而另一个人会说，‘我的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇根本没有改变。’我们的研究结果表明，这两种经历都可能是真实的，至少部分取决于个人的基因构成，”巴拉德说。 早期研究发现，健康的低碳水化合物饮食可以帮助一些人减肥并改善血糖控制。然而，它们对低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的影响却不一致。 研究人员想要确定遗传信息是否可以帮助识别哪些人更有可能从减少碳水化合物摄入中受益，以及哪些人可能会经历低密度脂蛋白胆固醇潜在危险的升高。 该分析使用了 DIETFITS 的数据，这是一项随机对照试验，涉及 600 多名成年人，他们遵循健康的低碳水化合物饮食或健康的低脂肪饮食一年。最初的试验发现，这两种饮食在减肥方面都没有显着的优势。 在新的分析中，研究人员重点关注了 431 名 DIETFITS 参与者，他们的遗传数据是可用的。他们研究了基因型、饱和脂肪消耗、饮食类型和 LDL 胆固醇从基线到 6 个月的变化之间的关系。 在接受低碳水化合物饮食的参与者中，那些遗传上倾向于较高低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的人更有可能出现低密度脂蛋白胆固醇升高的情况。 研究人员发现，对饱和脂肪的敏感性更高似乎推动了这种模式。遗传风险最高的参与者在摄入更多饱和脂肪时，LDL 增加幅度最大。相同...

reflection.en: This research on low-carb diets and LDL cholesterol reminds us of the intricate design of the human body. The finding that genetic predispositions can dramatically alter how individuals respond to saturated fat highlights the unique biological blueprint each person possesses. It encourages a humble appreciation for the complexity of our physical selves,...
reflection.zh: 这项关于低碳水化合物饮食与低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的研究，提醒我们人体设计的精妙。基因倾向会显著改变个体对饱和脂肪的反应，这一发现突显了每个人独特的生物学蓝图。这鼓励我们谦卑地欣赏我们身体的复杂性，我们是雅伟所造，奇妙可畏。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Three forgotten kings could rewrite the history of ancient Assyria
title.zh: 被遗忘的三位国王或将改写亚述古国历史

summary.en: Three previously unknown Assyrian kings, potentially omitted from the standard Assyrian King List, are being identified by researchers through the careful assembly of evidence from various ancient sources. This suggests that the early history of the Neo-Assyrian period was more complex than previously understood.
summary.zh: 研究人员通过拼凑来自古代文献、铭文和雕像的线索，发现了三位可能被遗漏在亚述国王名单之外的亚述国王。这一发现表明，新亚述时期的早期政治历史比以往认为的更为复杂。

body.en:
For about a century, scholars studying the Assyrian Empire have treated the Assyrian King List (AKL) as the standard record of the kingdom's rulers and the order in which they reigned, particularly during the later phases of Assyrian history.

A recent study in the Journal of Cuneiform Studies , titled "Three New Kings of Assyria," argues that the AKL may not be as complete or politically neutral as researchers once assumed. Alexander Johannes Edmonds and Eckart Frahm identify three rulers who do not appear on the list but whose reigns can be reconstructed from other surviving evidence.

Their findings suggest that "early Neo-Assyrian political history was much messier, but also more interesting, than has so far been recognized."

The first overlooked ruler identified by Edmonds and Frahm used the name Tiglath-pileser, apparently adopting the name of an earlier Assyrian king.

This Tiglath-pileser appears to have ruled at the same time as the officially recognized king Aššur-dān III, who was also his nephew. He tried to remove Aššur-dān III from power following a solar eclipse that would have carried major political and religious significance in the ancient world.

Evidence for his administration survives on a clay tablet now held by the British Museum. The tablet records a royal grant and indicates that Tiglath-pileser probably ruled from roughly 763-762 BCE before eventually being deposed.

The evidence for another forgotten ruler comes from a stela discovered in 1894 at Tell 'Abta, Iraq.

For years, researchers have debated why the name of the Assyrian king originally associated with the monument was overwritten with the name of another "Tiglath-pileser." Edmonds and Frahm argue that this long-standing puzzle can be explained by adding another ruler to the royal sequence.

They propose that a king named Shalmaneser ruled immediately before Tiglath-pileser III came to power in 745 BCE.

A cuneiform text attributed to King Tukultī-Ninurta II refers to a libation vessel that had originally been created by Tukultī-Ninurta I and was later restored by Aššur-uballit. The problem is that the AKL lists no king by that name between the reigns of Tukultī-Ninurta I and Tukultī-Ninurta II.

Edmonds and Frahm suggest that a previously unrecognized Aššur-uballit ruled from 913-912 BCE. His existence would account for the reference on the tablet and could also explain the identity of a royal figure shown in a statue discovered at Aššur. The statue is heavily damaged, with its head removed and its arms and royal insignia worn away.

The possible existence of these three rulers raises broader questions about what the Assyrian King List was actually designed to...
body.zh: 大约一个世纪以来，研究亚述帝国的学者一直将亚述国王名单（AKL）视为王国统治者及其统治顺序的标准记录，特别是在亚述历史的后期。 《楔形文字研究杂志》最近发表的一项题为“亚述的三位新国王”的研究认为，AKL 可能并不像研究人员曾经假设的那样完整或政治中立。亚历山大·约翰内斯·埃德蒙兹和埃卡特·弗拉姆指出了三位没有出现在名单上的统治者，但他们的统治可以从其他幸存的证据中重建。 他们的研究结果表明，“早期的新亚述政治历史比迄今为止所认识的要混乱得多，但也更有趣。” 埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆确认的第一位被忽视的统治者使用了提格拉斯·皮勒色这个名字，显然采用了早期亚述国王的名字。 这位提格拉特·皮莱瑟似乎与官方承认的国王阿苏尔丹三世同时统治，阿苏尔丹三世也是他的侄子。在日食发生后，他试图推翻阿苏尔丹三世的权力，这在古代世界具有重大的政治和宗教意义。 他的执政证据保存在一块泥板上，现由大英博物馆收藏。该碑文记录了一项皇家拨款，并表明提革拉毗列色可能在大约公元前 763 年至前 762 年统治，然后最终被废黜。 另一位被遗忘的统治者的证据来自 1894 年在伊拉克特尔阿布塔发现的一块石碑。 多年来，研究人员一直在争论为什么最初与纪念碑相关的亚述国王的名字被另一个“提革拉·帕列色”的名字覆盖。埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆认为，这个长期存在的谜题可以通过在皇家序列中添加另一位统治者来解释。 他们提出，公元前 745 年提革拉毗列色三世上台之前，有一位名叫撒缦以色的国王在位。 图库尔提-尼努尔塔二世国王的楔形文字提到了最初由图库尔提-尼努尔塔一世制造的奠酒器皿，后来由阿什苏尔-乌巴利特修复。问题是，在图库尔提-尼努尔塔一世和图库尔提-尼努尔塔二世统治期间，AKL 没有列出这个名字的国王。 埃德蒙兹和弗拉姆认为，公元前 913 年至公元前 912 年有一位先前未被承认的阿什乌尔-乌巴利特 (Aššur-uballit) 进行统治。他的存在可以解释泥板上的内容，也可以解释在阿什苏尔发现的雕像中显示的皇家人物的身份。雕像严重受损，头部被移除，手臂和皇家徽章也被磨损。 这三位统治者的可能存在引发了更广泛的问题，即亚述国王名单的实际目的是什么……

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, even into the distant past, is a testament to human curiosity and the desire to understand our origins. As Daniel prophesied, in the end times, knowledge will increase, and many will search and understand. This discovery reminds us that history is not always as settled as it seems, and new insights can emerge from...
reflection.zh: 对知识的不懈追求，即使是追溯到遥远的过去，也证明了人类的好奇心和对理解自身起源的渴望。正如但以理所预言的，末世知识将增多，许多人将努力寻求和明白。这一发现提醒我们，历史并非总是如表面那般确定，勤奋的研究可以带来新的见解。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Dogs blink more often when they see owners blinking, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：狗狗看到主人眨眼时会更频繁地眨眼

summary.en: New research indicates that dogs increase their blinking rate when they observe their owners doing the same, suggesting that this behavior may have evolved a social function in human-dog interactions.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，当狗狗看到主人眨眼时，它们的眨眼频率会增加，这表明这种行为可能在人与狗的互动中演化出了社交功能。

body.en: Scientists say research suggests blinking may have acquired a social relevance in interactions between dogs and people Stare into a dog’s eyes and you may encounter a bemused expression. But researchers have found that dogs blink more often when they see their owners doing so, suggesting there may be more to the mutual gaze than meets the eye. Scientists have previously found that dogs turn on the puppy eyes when humans look at them, and that their brains can distinguish happy human faces from other expressions – even telling apart fearful faces from those that are angry or sad. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家表示，研究表明眨眼可能在狗和人之间的互动中具有社会意义。凝视狗的眼睛，你可能会遇到困惑的表情。但研究人员发现，当狗看到主人眨眼时，它们会更频繁地眨眼，这表明相互凝视可能比眼神所表达的更多。科学家此前发现，当人类看着狗时，狗会睁开小狗的眼睛，它们的大脑可以区分快乐的人脸和其他表情，甚至可以区分出恐惧的脸和愤怒或悲伤的脸。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The study on dog blinking offers a glimpse into the subtle ways creatures communicate and connect. It reminds us that wisdom and understanding can be found not only in grand pronouncements but also in the quiet observations of the natural world, much like Job learned from the beasts of the field. Even in the seemingly simple act of blinking, there's a...
reflection.zh: 关于狗狗眨眼的研究，让我们得以一窥生物之间微妙的沟通和连接方式。它提醒我们，智慧和理解不仅在于宏大的宣告，也存在于对自然世界的静默观察之中，正如约伯从田间的走兽那里所学到的。即使在看似简单的眨眼动作中，也蕴含着一种等待被理解的共同语言。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your brain may not actually “make” decisions
title.zh: 您的大脑可能并非真正“做出”决定

summary.en: A neuroscientist is challenging the idea that the brain contains a central system that actually “makes” our decisions. What we experience as choosing may instead emerge from the continuous interaction of perception, movement, the body, and the world around us.
summary.zh: 一位神经科学家正在挑战大脑中存在一个实际“做出”我们决定的中央系统的观点。我们所体验到的选择可能源于感知、运动、身体以及周围世界的持续互动。

body.en:
What we experience when making a decision may be very different from what actually happens inside the brain, according to Indiana University Professor Tom James.

For decades, both scientific theories and everyday intuition have tended to describe decision-making as a sequence. First we perceive something, then we think about it and make a choice, and finally we act. Each step is often assumed to correspond to a distinct brain function, moving from sensory processing to cognition and then to motor activity.

Many scientific approaches, particularly model-based cognitive neuroscience, are built around this same linear framework. It also matches how decision making feels from the inside. As James notes, "Our actions feel like they are caused by decisions based on desires, beliefs, and intentions."

James argues that this familiar explanation, sometimes called the "sandwich model," does not fit neatly with what scientists know about the brain. Sensation has identifiable sensory mechanisms, and action has identifiable motor mechanisms. But the supposed cognitive stage between the two does not appear to have a corresponding neural process that functions as a distinct decision maker.

Rather than proposing a dedicated decision-making system that directs behavior, James suggests that sensory, sensorimotor, and motor processes together produce what he calls 'action selection.' In this view, behavior emerges through ongoing interactions among the brain, body, and environment. These processes can occur simultaneously and feed back into one another rather than unfolding as a simple sequence.

As James says, "Of course they do. We use this language all the time and it's very helpful in terms of describing behavior. The leap, I think, is to say that the brain works by having decision-making or control processes. It produces behavior that is well described in that way. But it doesn't need a process that does that to make it look that way."

James, a professor in the Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences in the College of Arts and Sciences, presents the argument in "Sensorimotor Mechanisms of Decisions and Actions," an article just published in the Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience .

James develops his argument using a "physicalist" framework associated with philosophers such as Daniel Dennett. The approach makes explicit what James sees as a basic assumption underlying science: physical phenomena can cause both physical and nonphysical phenomena, while nonphysical phenomena cannot themselves cause physical events.

Sensory and motor processes, for example, are physical. Decisions, in this framework, are nonphysical. If that is the case, James argues, a decision cannot literally cause a physical action.

Drawing on Daniel Dennett's comparison between the...
body.zh: 印第安纳大学教授汤姆·詹姆斯表示，我们在做出决定时所经历的可能与大脑内部实际发生的情况非常不同。 几十年来，科学理论和日常直觉都倾向于将决策描述为一个序列。首先我们感知某事，然后我们思考它并做出选择，最后我们采取行动。通常认为每个步骤对应于不同的大脑功能，从感觉处理到认知，然后到运动活动。 许多科学方法，特别是基于模型的认知神经科学，都是围绕这个相同的线性框架构建的。它也符合内部决策的感觉。正如詹姆斯所说，“我们的行为感觉像是基于欲望、信仰和意图的决定造成的。” 詹姆斯认为，这种熟悉的解释有时被称为“三明治模型”，与科学家对大脑的了解并不完全吻合。感觉具有可识别的感觉机制，动作具有可识别的运动机制。但两者之间所谓的认知阶段似乎并没有相应的神经过程来充当不同的决策者。 詹姆斯并没有提出一个专门的决策系统来指导行为，而是认为感觉、感觉运动和运动过程共同产生了他所说的“行动选择”。按照这种观点，行为是通过大脑、身体和环境之间持续的相互作用而产生的。这些过程可以同时发生并相互反馈，而不是作为一个简单的序列展开。 正如詹姆斯所说，“当然是这样。我们一直在使用这种语言，它在描述行为方面非常有帮助。我认为，这一飞跃是说大脑通过决策或控制过程来工作。它产生的行为可以通过这种方式得到很好的描述。但它不需要一个过程来让它看起来像那样。” 艺术与科学学院心理与脑科学系教授詹姆斯在刚刚发表在《认知神经科学杂志》上的文章《决策和行动的感觉运动机制》中提出了这一论点。 詹姆斯使用与丹尼尔·丹尼特等哲学家相关的“物理主义”框架来发展他的论点。这种方法明确了詹姆斯所认为的科学基础假设：物理现象可以引起物理现象和非物理现象，而非物理现象本身不能引起物理事件。 例如，感觉和运动过程是物理的。在这个框架中，决策是非物理的。詹姆斯认为，如果是这样的话，一个决定就不可能真正引起实际行动。 根据丹尼尔·丹尼特 (Daniel Dennett) 的比较...

reflection.en: This neuroscientist's challenge to our understanding of decision-making invites us to consider the intricate, interconnected processes underlying our actions. As knowledge rapidly increases, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are continually discovering more about the complex systems, both within us and around us, that shape our experience.
reflection.zh: 这位神经科学家对我们决策过程的理解提出的挑战，邀请我们思考我们行为背后错综复杂、相互关联的过程。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，随着知识的飞速增长，我们不断发现更多关于塑造我们体验的内在和外在复杂系统的信息。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Forces deep inside Earth helped Antarctica freeze before the Arctic
title.zh: 地球深处的力量帮助南极洲比北极洲更早地冰封

summary.en: Scientists have proposed a new theory suggesting that geological forces deep within the Earth, which gradually uplifted East Antarctica, led to the formation of mountains and a high plateau. This elevated terrain created conditions cold enough for snow and ice to accumulate and survive, even during a warmer global...
summary.zh: 科学家提出了一个新的理论，认为地球深处的地质力量逐渐抬升了东极洲，形成了山脉和高地。这片高耸的地形创造了足够寒冷的环境，使得雪和冰能够积累并得以保存，即使在全球气候变暖的时期也是如此，从而解释了为什么南极洲比北极洲更早地被冰封。

body.en:
Scientists have found a new explanation for why Antarctica became covered in ice millions of years before the Arctic.

The international study, published in Science , addresses a long-standing climate mystery: how Antarctica could develop a massive ice sheet at a time when Earth was around 5ºC warmer than it is today.

The findings point to the gradual formation of high terrain in East Antarctica. As an escarpment, plateau, and mountain system rose, it created elevations cold enough for snow and ice to persist and build up over time.

The process began after Antarctica and Africa started separating during the Jurassic Period, 201-143 million years ago. Powerful forces deep inside Earth gradually lifted much of East Antarctica over more than 100 million years, helping set the stage for ice sheet formation about 34 million years ago.

The study was led by researchers at the University of Southampton, working with scientists from Durham University, GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences in Germany, the University of Potsdam in Germany, Utrecht University in the Netherlands, and the University of Florence in Italy.

Lead author Thomas Gernon, Professor of Earth Science at the University of Southampton, explained: "Antarctica's land surface was gradually lifted to the point where ice could gain a permanent foothold, even while the surrounding polar oceans as well as global temperatures remained surprisingly warm."

The East Antarctic Ice Sheet is now the largest ice sheet on Earth. It contains enough frozen water to raise global sea levels by around 52 meters if it were to melt completely.

To understand how the landscape changed, the researchers used computational models to reconstruct the evolution of East Antarctica's surface across 100 million years.

Their results suggest that a phenomenon known as 'mantle waves' was responsible for much of the gradual uplift.

Mantle waves were recently identified by Prof Gernon's team. They travel beneath continents after tectonic plates begin to separate and have previously been linked to the eruption of diamond volcanoes and mysterious phases of uplift within continents.

As these slow-moving waves passed beneath East Antarctica, they helped raise a vast plateau topped by the Gamburtsev Mountains. The recent discovery of mantle waves gave researchers a mechanism that could explain how Antarctica reached elevations high enough to begin freezing.

The simulations indicate that by about 45 million years ago, large parts of East Antarctica had climbed above the critical elevation, about 2 km, required for mountain glaciers to develop and expand. Over time, those glaciers grew together to form the East Antarctic Ice Sheet.

body.zh: 科学家们找到了一个新的解释，解释了为什么南极洲比北极早几百万年就被冰雪覆盖。 这项发表在《科学》杂志上的国际研究解决了一个长期存在的气候谜团：当地球温度比现在高 5 摄氏度左右时，南极洲如何形成巨大的冰盖。 研究结果表明东南极洲逐渐形成高地。随着悬崖、高原和山脉系统的上升，海拔变得足够冷，使得冰雪能够随着时间的推移持续存在和堆积。 这一过程始于侏罗纪时期（201-1.43 亿年前）南极洲和非洲开始分离之后。 1亿多年来，地球深处的强大力量逐渐抬升了东南极洲的大部分地区，为大约3400万年前冰盖的形成奠定了基础。 这项研究由南安普顿大学的研究人员领导，与杜伦大学、德国 GFZ 亥姆霍兹地球科学中心、德国波茨坦大学、荷兰乌得勒支大学和意大利佛罗伦萨大学的科学家合作。 主要作者、南安普顿大学地球科学教授托马斯·格农（Thomas Gernon）解释说：“尽管周围的极地海洋和全球气温仍然出人意料地温暖，但南极洲的陆地表面逐渐上升到冰可以永久立足的程度。” 东南极冰盖现在是地球上最大的冰盖。如果它完全融化，它含有足够的冰冻水，将使全球海平面上升约 52 米。 为了了解地貌如何变化，研究人员使用计算模型重建了东南极洲表面一亿年来的演变。 他们的结果表明，一种被称为“地幔波”的现象是造成逐渐隆起的主要原因。 格农教授的团队最近发现了地幔波。在构造板块开始分离后，它们在大陆下方移动，此前曾与钻石火山的喷发和大陆内神秘的隆起阶段有关。 当这些缓慢移动的波浪穿过东南极洲下方时，它们帮助抬升了甘布尔采夫山脉顶部的广阔高原。最近发现的地幔波为研究人员提供了一种机制，可以解释南极洲如何达到足够高的海拔并开始结冰。 模拟表明，大约 4500 万年前，东南极洲的大部分地区已经爬升至山地冰川发育和扩张所需的临界海拔（约 2 公里）以上。随着时间的推移，这些冰川一起生长，形成了东南极冰盖。 Thea Hincks 博士，南安普顿大学高级研究员，共同领导了...

reflection.en: The vastness of Earth's history and the intricate processes shaping our planet continue to reveal themselves through scientific inquiry. As we observe the slow, powerful forces at work deep beneath our feet, we can gain a profound appreciation for the Creator's wisdom in designing the natural world. The story of Antarctica's ancient ice age reminds us that...
reflection.zh: 地球悠久的历史和塑造我们星球的复杂过程，通过科学探索不断显现。当我们观察脚下深处那些缓慢而强大的力量时，我们可以深刻地体会到造物主在设计自然界时的智慧。南极洲古代冰河时代的故事提醒我们，即使在看似静止的景观中，也存在着动态的力量，这一切都由比我们自身更伟大的那只手所调动。

title.en: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
title.zh: 带状疱疹疫苗与痴呆症风险降低24%相关

summary.en: Older adults who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine were 24% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over four years in a study of more than 500,000 people. Researchers estimate the difference could amount to roughly one dementia case prevented for every 17 people, suggesting a significant secondary benefit to...
summary.zh: 一项针对超过50万人的研究显示，接种Shingrix带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性降低了24%。研究人员估计，每17名接种疫苗的人中就可能减少一例痴呆症病例，这表明该疫苗具有显著的额外健康益处。

body.en:
Older adults who received a shingles vaccine after entering a skilled nursing facility were less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over the following four years, according to a new study. Researchers found that vaccinated adults had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with those who did not receive the vaccine.

The analysis drew on Medicare data and health records from more than 500,000 adults age 66 and older who were admitted to skilled nursing facilities for either short-term or long-term care. Researchers compared patients who received at least one dose of the recombinant shingles vaccine, known as RZV or Shingrix, with patients who remained unvaccinated. Shingrix was introduced in 2017 and is currently the only shingles vaccine available on the market.

"A lot of previous studies with similar results focused on an older vaccine," said study author Kaley Hayes, an assistant professor at Brown University's School of Public Health. "This study looks at the newest vaccine only in an older, vulnerable adult population who were not up to date with shingles vaccination and are at a very clear clinical point in care: entering a skilled nursing facility."

The results are consistent with several earlier studies involving a previous shingles vaccine that also found an association between shingles vaccination and a reduced risk of dementia.

"It fits into this large puzzle that's just starting to come together that the vaccines are effective at preventing shingles and also appear to have neuroprotective benefits as well," said Hayes, who is also the associate director of pharmacoepidemiology for Brown's Center for Gerontology and Healthcare Research.

Hayes led the study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine , with researchers from Brown, the University of Delaware, the Providence Veterans Affairs Medical Center and other institutions.

The researchers used a technique called target trial emulation to analyze the data. This approach attempts to recreate some of the conditions of a randomized clinical trial in situations where conducting such a trial is not practical.

The study included Medicare claims and electronic health records from patients admitted to more than 5,500 skilled nursing facilities nationwide between 2017 and 2022. Of the 509,926 people included in the analysis, just 8,843 received the shingles vaccine.

Participants had to be eligible for shingles vaccination and could not have previously been diagnosed with dementia.

After four years of follow-up, adults who had received at least one of the two Shingrix doses were substantially less likely to receive a dementia diagnosis. Dementia developed in 18.8% of vaccinated participants, compared with 24.6% of those who were not vaccinated.

"This translates to about one in 17 dementia...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，进入专业护理机构后接受带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在接下来的四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性较小。研究人员发现，与未接种疫苗的成年人相比，接种疫苗的成年人患痴呆症的风险降低了 24%。 该分析利用了超过 500,000 名 66 岁及以上成年人的医疗保险数据和健康记录，这些成年人被送往专业护理机构接受短期或长期护理。研究人员将至少接受一剂重组带状疱疹疫苗（称为 RZV 或 Shingrix）的患者与未接种疫苗的患者进行了比较。 Shingrix 于 2017 年推出，是目前市场上唯一可用的带状疱疹疫苗。 研究作者、布朗大学公共卫生学院助理教授卡利·海耶斯 (Kaley Hayes) 表示：“之前许多具有类似结果的研究都集中在较旧的疫苗上。” “这项研究仅在年龄较大、脆弱的成年人群中研究最新的疫苗，他们没有及时接种带状疱疹疫苗，并且处于非常明确的临床护理阶段：进入熟练的护理机构。” 该结果与先前涉及带状疱疹疫苗的几项早期研究一致，这些研究也发现带状疱疹疫苗接种与痴呆风险降低之间存在关联。 海斯说：“疫苗能有效预防带状疱疹，而且似乎还具有神经保护作用，这符合这个刚刚开始解决的大难题。”海耶斯也是布朗大学老年学和医疗保健研究中心的药物流行病学副主任。 海斯领导的这项研究发表在《内科医学年鉴》上，研究人员来自布朗大学、特拉华大学、普罗维登斯退伍军人事务医疗中心和其他机构。 研究人员使用一种称为目标试验仿真的技术来分析数据。这种方法试图在进行随机临床试验不可行的情况下重建随机临床试验的一些条件。 该研究包括 2017 年至 2022 年间全国 5,500 多家专业护理机构收治的患者的医疗保险索赔和电子健康记录。在分析中的 509,926 人中，只有 8,843 人接种了带状疱疹疫苗。 参与者必须有资格接种带状疱疹疫苗，并且之前不能被诊断患有痴呆症。 经过四年的随访，至少接受过两种 Shingrix 剂量之一的成年人被诊断为痴呆症的可能性大大降低。接种疫苗的参与者中有 18.8% 罹患痴呆症，而未接种疫苗的参与者中这一比例为 24.6%。 “这相当于大约十七分之一的人患有痴呆症......

It reminds us that diligent research is a form of stewardship, uncovering the intricate ways Yahweh has designed our bodies to respond to care. As we find new ways to protect the elderly from cognitive decline, we honor...
reflection.zh: 这项发现揭示了人类健康的隐秘复杂性，即保护身体免受一种疾病侵害的同时，竟能意外地守护心智。它提醒我们，勤奋的科研也是一种管家职分，揭示了雅伟设计人体感应医治的奇妙方式。当我们找到保护老年人免受认知能力下降影响的新方法时，我们也尊荣了长者的生命尊严。

title.en: Atomic catalyst unlocks the hidden value of plant waste
title.zh: 原子催化剂释放植物废物的隐藏价值

summary.en: Scientists have created a highly efficient catalyst that breaks down stubborn lignin from plant waste into useful chemicals under relatively mild conditions. By revealing exactly how the catalyst works at the atomic level, the discovery could help turn forestry and agricultural...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Lignin gives plants much of their structural strength and represents the largest renewable source of aromatic chemicals found in nature. It can make up a substantial share (up to 35%) of waste biomass from agriculture and forestry. Yet lignin's complicated molecular structure makes it notoriously difficult to break apart efficiently, which has limited its potential use in sustainable manufacturing.

In a study published in ACS Catalysis , an international team that included Dr. Christopher Parlett, Xinyue Zhou, and Yutao Jiang from the Department of Chemical Engineering developed a highly efficient "single-atom catalyst." The researchers also determined, at the molecular level, how the catalyst breaks the strong chemical bonds that help hold lignin together.

The catalyst contains individual ruthenium atoms embedded within a nitrogen-doped carbon material. By keeping the ruthenium atoms isolated, the design can deliver strong catalytic performance while requiring only very small amounts of metal, improving efficiency compared with conventional systems.

One persistent obstacle in lignin research has been identifying exactly which parts of a catalyst are responsible for breaking the material's unusually strong chemical bonds. Without that information, researchers have had limited guidance for designing more effective catalysts.

The team found that a particular atomic arrangement known as a "Ru-N 4 site" is especially important. These sites activate oxygen molecules and help trigger the breaking of both carbon-oxygen and carbon-carbon bonds within lignin.

Using a combination of laboratory experiments and computational modeling, the researchers were able to reconstruct the process in greater detail. The catalyst first activates oxygen, producing highly reactive species. Those species then attack the lignin structure and split it into smaller molecules.

When tested under optimized conditions, the catalyst converted nearly all of the model lignin compounds and generated high yields of valuable chemical products, including phenol.

The process also works under relatively mild conditions and does not require harsh chemicals. That combination could make the approach useful for developing more sustainable methods of chemical manufacturing.

The researchers went beyond simplified model compounds and tested the catalyst on real lignin collected from several biomass sources. It successfully converted those samples into useful aromatic compounds that could potentially become building blocks for fuels, plastics, and other materials.

The findings provide a more detailed picture of how single-atom catalysts operate during biomass conversion. That understanding could serve as a guide for developing more efficient catalytic systems in the future.

body.zh: 木质素赋予植物很大的结构强度，是自然界中发现的最大的可再生芳香族化学品来源。它可以占农业和林业废弃生物质的很大一部分（高达 35%）。然而，木质素复杂的分子结构使其很难有效分解，这限制了其在可持续制造中的潜在用途。 在《ACS Catalysis》上发表的一项研究中，化学工程系的 Christopher Parlett 博士、Xinyue Zhou 和 Yutao Jiang 等国际团队开发了一种高效的“单原子催化剂”。研究人员还在分子水平上确定了催化剂如何破坏有助于将木质素结合在一起的强化学键。 该催化剂含有嵌入氮掺杂碳材料中的单个钌原子。通过保持钌原子隔离，该设计可以提供强大的催化性能，同时仅需要极少量的金属，与传统系统相比提高了效率。 木质素研究中一个持续存在的障碍是准确识别催化剂的哪些部分负责破坏材料异常坚固的化学键。如果没有这些信息，研究人员在设计更有效的催化剂方面获得的指导就很有限。 研究小组发现，一种被称为“Ru-N 4 位点”的特殊原子排列尤其重要。这些位点激活氧分子并有助于触发木质素内碳-氧和碳-碳键的断裂。 通过结合实验室实验和计算模型，研究人员能够更详细地重建该过程。催化剂首先活化氧气，产生高活性物质。然后这些物质攻击木质素结构并将其分裂成更小的分子。 在优化条件下进行测试时，该催化剂转化了几乎所有的模型木质素化合物，并产生了高产率的有价值的化学产品，包括苯酚。 该过程还可以在相对温和的条件下进行，并且不需要刺激性化学品。这种结合可以使该方法有助于开发更可持续的化学制造方法。 研究人员超越了简化的模型化合物，并在从几种生物质来源收集的真实木质素上测试了催化剂。它成功地将这些样品转化为有用的芳香族化合物，这些化合物有可能成为燃料、塑料和其他材料的基础材料。 这些发现提供了单原子催化剂在生物质转化过程中如何运作的更详细信息。这种理解可以作为未来开发更高效催化系统的指南。 “理解...

title.en: Hard to swallow? The future of snacking may be 3D-printed cookies made from upcycled plastic

summary.en: A NASA-funded project uses yeasts to convert plastics and other waste into edible proteins, fats, and flavorings. The resulting mixture is then 3D-printed into disc-shaped 'cookies,' potentially offering a solution for feeding astronauts on future space missions.
summary.zh: 一个由美国国家航空航天局资助的项目，利用酵母将塑料和其他废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。然后，将产生的混合物通过 3D 打印机制作成圆盘状的“曲奇”，这可能为未来太空任务中的宇航员提供食物。

body.en: Nasa-funded project uses yeasts to turn plastics and other waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings Cookies produced from upcycled plastic may sound like something straight out of a dystopian sci-fi plot. But researchers say that they have succeeded in creating such a product as part of a Nasa-funded project aimed at feeding astronauts on future space missions. The technology uses specially designed yeasts to transform plastics and agricultural waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings. The resulting slurry is passed through a 3D printer to create a disc-shaped “cookie”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国宇航局资助的项目利用酵母将塑料和其他废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。用升级塑料生产的饼干听起来像是直接来自反乌托邦科幻情节的东西。但研究人员表示，他们已经成功地创造了这样一种产品，作为美国宇航局资助的项目的一部分，该项目旨在为未来太空任务中的宇航员提供食物。该技术使用专门设计的酵母将塑料和农业废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。所得浆料通过 3D 打印机，形成圆盘状“饼干”。继续阅读...

It prompts reflection on our ability to transform the unusable into the essential. Yet, it also echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition sought to build a path to the heavens, a narrative that cautions against...
reflection.zh: 由美国国家航空航天局资助、用于太空任务的塑料废物可食用曲奇的诞生，是人类智慧的非凡成就。它促使我们反思将无用之物转化为必需品的能力。然而，这也让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心试图建造通往天堂的道路，这个故事告诫我们要警惕不受约束的技术傲慢。
