verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Vholume review – a headlong rush of parkour perfection in a brutalist wonderland
title.zh: Vholume评测——残酷仙境中的跑酷完美主义的狂奔

summary.en: Vholume is a PC game featuring parkour across dystopian cityscapes, characterized by wall-runs, daring leaps, and split-second improvisation. The game draws inspiration from titles like Mirror's Edge and environments reminiscent of Half-Life 2 and de Chirico's art, showcasing a curated and tasteful design.
summary.zh: Vholume是一款PC游戏，玩家将在反乌托邦的城市景观中进行跑酷，特色是飞檐走壁、大胆跳跃和瞬时反应。游戏借鉴了《镜之边缘》等作品的灵感，并融入了类似《半条命2》和德·基里科艺术风格的环境，展现出一种精心策划且品味不俗的设计。

body.en: PC; Nathan Grange, Léonard Lemaitre, Niels Tiercelin, IronEqual Race across impossible dystopian cityscapes in this exhilarating game of wall-runs, death-chancing leaps and split-second improvisation At first, Vholume seems like a quick rush through some smartly selected references. Has this breathless yet austere parkour game been designed or ingeniously curated? The urban gymnast moveset comes from Mirror’s Edge. Level names use terms like conapt, first coined by Philip K Dick. And the environments themselves are dystopian and surreal, Half-Life 2’s City 17 colliding with the blasted avenues and mute archways of de Chirico. Many games have influences. Vholume has actual taste. All the surface stuff fades away when the game is in motion, however. Vholume’s an on-foot racing game in which you hoof it through spectacularly odd environments, moving from one beam of concrete to the next. You’re clipping your wall-runs and power-slides together to bridge seemingly impossible gaps between buildings, forever in search of the next stretch of track, the next turn, the next jump that gets you to the level’s exit and the worldwide leaderboards. And once that’s done, you have a choice: onwards to another gauntlet, or back to the start of this one again to slice a few microseconds off your score? Or maybe you’d rather head over to multiplayer to race against the ghosts of others? Continue reading...
body.zh: 个人电脑;内森·格兰奇 (Nathan Grange)、莱昂纳德·勒梅特 (Léonard Lemaitre)、尼尔斯·蒂尔塞林 (Niels Tiercelin)、IronEqual 在这款令人兴奋的跑墙游戏、致命的跳跃和瞬间即兴创作中，穿越不可能的反乌托邦城市景观。 起初，Vholume 似乎是快速浏览一些精心挑选的参考资料。这款令人窒息却又朴素的跑酷游戏是精心设计还是精心策划的？城市体操运动员的动作来自《镜之边缘》。级别名称使用 conapt 等术语，该术语最初由 Philip K Dick 创造。环境本身也是反乌托邦和超现实的，《半条命 2》中的 17 号城与德基里科的破败大道和无声拱门相互碰撞。许多游戏都有影响。 Vholume 有真正的味道。然而，当游戏进行时，所有表面的东西都会消失。 Vholume 是一款徒步竞速游戏，在其中，你要踩着蹄子穿过极其奇怪的环境，从一根混凝土梁移动到另一根混凝土梁。你将墙壁滑行和动力滑梯剪在一起，以弥合建筑物之间看似不可能的间隙，永远在寻找下一段轨道、下一个转弯、下一个跳跃，让你到达关卡的出口和全球排行榜。一旦完成，你就可以选择：继续进行另一场挑战，还是再次回到这一挑战的开始，以减少你的分数几微秒？或者也许您更愿意进入多人游戏来与其他人的幽灵竞赛？继续阅读...

reflection.en: In Vholume, players navigate complex, surreal cityscapes, blending influences from various media into a cohesive and exhilarating experience. This mirrors Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times, where human ingenuity and curated information create new forms of expression and understanding. As technology advances, we see ever more...
reflection.zh: 在《Vholume》中，玩家穿梭于复杂、超现实的城市景观，将各种媒介的影响融合成一种令人振奋的体验。这呼应了但以理关于末世知识增长的预言，人类的创造力和精心策划的信息催生了新的表达和理解形式。 随着科技的进步，我们看到像这款游戏这样日益精妙的作品，源于人类知识的积累和艺术的融合。愿我们明智地运用这日益增长的理解力，反映造物主自身精妙的设计。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: IBM's new Granite 4.2 models ride the wave of interest in local LLMs
title.zh: IBM 的新 Granite 4.2 模型乘着对本地 LLM 的兴趣浪潮

summary.en: IBM has released new open-weight large language models (Granite 4.2) designed for self-hosting, featuring large context windows and enhanced agentic capabilities for tasks like web searching and tool use.
summary.zh: IBM 发布了其最新一代的开源大型语言模型（Granite 4.2），这些模型可供下载和本地部署，具有超长的上下文窗口和增强的代理能力，可用于网络搜索和工具使用等任务。

body.en: IBM has rolled out the newest models in its family of open-weight large language models designed to be downloaded and self-hosted. The newly launched Granite 4.2 comes in 3B, 8B, and 30B parameter variants. Like previous versions, IBM is taking a decoder-only approach here. These new releases offer a 128,000-token context window natively. The 8B and 30B variants (not the 3B one) also go through an agentic reinforcement learning block; they were trained for expanded capabilities like using the terminal, searching the web, or using external tools. The 3B model supports tools too, but without the same level of specialized training. Read full article Comments
body.zh: IBM 推出了其开放式重量大型语言模型系列中的最新模型，旨在下载和自托管。新推出的 Granite 4.2 有 3B、8B 和 30B 参数变体。与以前的版本一样，IBM 在这里采用仅解码器的方法。这些新版本本身提供了 128,000 个令牌的上下文窗口。 8B 和 30B 变体（不是 3B 变体）也经历了代理强化学习模块；他们接受了扩展功能的培训，例如使用终端、搜索网络或使用外部工具。 3B 模型也支持工具，但没有相同级别的专业培训。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and accessibility of technologies like IBM's Granite 4.2 models echo the ancient prophecy that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' As these powerful tools become more widespread, they offer immense potential for innovation and problem-solving. Yet, this surge in knowledge also calls for wisdom and discernment in...
reflection.zh: IBM Granite 4.2 模型等技术的快速发展和普及，呼应了古老的预言：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识也必增长。”随着这些强大工具的日益普及，它们为创新和解决问题提供了巨大的潜力。然而，知识的激增也要求我们在开发和部署这些能力时具备智慧和辨别力，确保它们服务于人类的最佳利益。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Xtracycle's Swoop ASM e-bike brings an automatic transmission to cargo bikes
title.zh: Xtracycle 的 Swoop ASM 电动自行车为货运自行车带来自动变速功能

summary.en: A steel frame cargo bike with a unique twist: You can let it choose your gear.
summary.zh: 一款钢架货运自行车，带有一个独特的亮点：你可以让它自动选择档位。

body.en: The Velotric Discover M e-bike we reviewed earlier this year had a feature I found somewhat annoying: It would sporadically block much of the display with an alert telling me I should be in a different gear. While the implementation bugged me, the concept made a certain degree of sense; most e-bikes now know your cadence, how much torque you're generating, and how that power is being translated into speed. That's everything you need to know to determine an optimal gear. Somewhere in the back of my mind, I thought, "If you're so smart, why don't you just shift for me?" I was completely unaware that Shimano had already developed a system that did exactly that. And for the past few weeks, I've been using it on a $4,500 cargo bike from Xtracycle called the Swoop ASM that let me see what it's like to hand control of my gears to an electronic brain. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 我们今年早些时候评测的 Velotric Discover M 电动自行车有一个让我觉得有点烦人的功能：它会偶尔遮挡大部分显示屏，并发出警报，告诉我应该换档。虽然实现过程让我感到困扰，但这个概念在一定程度上是有意义的。现在大多数电动自行车都知道您的节奏、产生的扭矩以及该动力如何转化为速度。这是确定最佳齿轮所需了解的一切。在我内心的某个地方，我想：“如果你这么聪明，为什么不为我换班呢？”我完全不知道 Shimano 已经开发了一个完全可以做到这一点的系统。在过去的几周里，我一直在一辆价值 4,500 美元的 Xtracycle 货运自行车 Swoop ASM 上使用它，它让我亲眼目睹了将齿轮控制交给电子大脑的感觉。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The ingenuity behind Xtracycle's Swoop ASM e-bike, which automatically shifts gears, reflects a deep human drive to understand and improve the world around us. Just as the author wondered why a smart system couldn't shift for them, we constantly seek to uncover better ways of doing things, revealing the 'glory of kings' in searching out matters. This...
reflection.zh: Xtracycle Swoop ASM 电动自行车自动换挡的巧妙设计，反映了人类深入理解和改善世界的强烈愿望。正如作者曾疑惑智能系统为何不能自动换挡一样，我们不断寻求更好的做事方式，这正体现了“君王的荣耀在于查究事物”。这种从简单工具到复杂自动变速器的持续创新追求，指向了人类固有的发现和解决问题的能力。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Fake US thinktank set up and funded by Israel sought to game AI for propaganda
title.zh: 以色列资助的虚假美国智库利用人工智能进行宣传博弈

summary.en: A pro-Israel messaging website, posing as a non-existent think tank, published over 560,000 words in nine days to influence AI chatbots. The site presented arguments on sensitive topics like the treatment of Palestinian prisoners as neutral research, aiming to ensure AI models cite their propaganda as fact.
summary.zh: 一个由以色列资助、冒充美国智库的虚假网站在九天内发布了超过56万字的内容，旨在影响人工智能聊天机器人。该网站将有关巴勒斯坦囚犯待遇等敏感话题的亲以色列论点包装成“中立研究”，试图诱导人工智能模型将其宣传内容作为事实引用。

body.en: In effort to prime chatbots to make pro-Israel arguments the site published 124 reports, over 560,000 words in nine days, Guardian analysis shows A pro-Israel messaging website badged with the name of a thinktank that does not exist has published more than half a million words in nine days, built on a commercial platform that promises to optimize content so that AI chatbots will cite it. The site gives Israel’s position on subjects including the torture of Palestinian prisoners , Israeli war crimes and whether Israel has deliberately starved Palestinians in Gaza, all presented as neutral research. Continue reading...
body.zh: 为了让聊天机器人提出支持以色列的论点，该网站在 9 天内发布了 124 份报告，超过 56 万字，《卫报》分析显示，一个贴有不存在的智库名称的亲以色列消息网站在 9 天内发布了超过 50 万字，该网站建立在一个商业平台上，该平台承诺优化内容，以便人工智能聊天机器人能够引用它。该网站阐述了以色列在巴勒斯坦囚犯遭受酷刑、以色列战争罪行以及以色列是否故意让加沙巴勒斯坦人挨饿等问题上的立场，所有这些都以中立的研究形式呈现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The use of half a million words to 'prime' AI models reminds us that technology can be weaponized to obscure reality rather than reveal it. When we create systems that prioritize volume and optimization over integrity, we risk losing the ability to distinguish between genuine research and manufactured narratives. As followers of Yahweh, we are called to...
reflection.zh: 利用五十万字的内容来“诱导”人工智能模型，这提醒我们，技术可能被武器化，用来掩盖现实而非揭示真相。当我们建立的系统优先考虑信息量和算法优化而非诚信时，我们就面临着无法区分真实研究与人造叙事的风险。作为雅伟的追随者，我们受召拒绝那些经过“优化”的谎言，转而致力于诚实见证这一更为艰巨的工作。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Bill Gates calls for ‘human reserved’ jobs in face of AI takeover
title.zh: 比尔·盖茨呼吁面对人工智能“接管”保留“人类专属”工作

summary.en: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has advocated for "human reserved" jobs in certain sectors to prevent AI from replacing them. In a 6,000-word essay, he also expressed concern that governments are not adequately prepared for the technology's impact, likening the concept to nature reserves.
summary.zh: 微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨呼吁在某些行业设立“人类保留”职位，以防止人工智能取代这些工作。在一篇长达6000字的论文中，他还表达了对各国政府尚未为这项技术的影响做好准备的担忧，并将这一概念比作自然保护区。

body.en: In 6,000-word essay Microsoft co-founder also expresses concern governments not prepared for technology’s impact Business live – latest updates Bill Gates has called for “human reserved” jobs in certain sectors to prevent AI replacing them, and expressed concern that governments are not prepared for the impact the technology will have. In a 6,000 word essay titled The turbulent AI era is here. The choices we make are critical , the billionaire Microsoft co-founder likened the need to spare roles from digital encroachment to how nature reserves operate to protect the environment. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在这篇 6000 字的文章中，微软联合创始人还表达了对政府没有为技术影响做好准备的担忧。比尔·盖茨呼吁在某些行业保留“人力”工作，以防止人工智能取代它们，并表达了对政府没有为技术影响做好准备的担忧。在一篇题为《动荡的人工智能时代已经到来》的 6000 字文章中。我们做出的选择至关重要，这位亿万富翁微软联合创始人将免遭数字化侵蚀的角色比作自然保护区如何运作以保护环境。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Bill Gates's proposal for "human reserved" jobs highlights a critical question in the age of AI: just because technology *can* replace human tasks, does it mean it *should*? His concern that governments are unprepared for AI's impact reminds us to consider the broader human and societal benefits, not just efficiency. As we navigate this turbulent era, we...
reflection.zh: 比尔·盖茨提出“为人类保留工作”的建议，突显了人工智能时代的一个关键问题：科技即便能够取代人类任务，是否就意味着它应该这样做？他对政府尚未为人工智能的影响做好准备的担忧，提醒我们不仅要考虑效率，还要考虑更广泛的人类和社会福祉。在这个动荡的时代，我们被呼召去辨别什么才是真正促进人类繁荣的，而不是仅仅追求每一种技术可能性。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – a game so grotesque it scares its own director
title.zh: 克莱夫·巴克的《养鬼食人：复兴》——一款恐怖到连导演自己都感到害怕的游戏

summary.en: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival, a new first-person action-horror game overseen by Barker himself and featuring Doug Bradley reprising his role as Pinhead, aims to introduce new audiences to the unsettling nature of the Hellraiser universe. Game director Emil Esov discovered he has trypophobia while researching...
summary.zh: 在原著作者克莱夫·巴克（Clive Barker）本人的监督下，以及道格·布拉德利（Doug Bradley）回归扮演“针头人”（Pinhead）一角，克莱夫·巴克的《养鬼食人：复兴》（Hellraiser:...

body.en: With oversight from Clive Barker himself, and a role reprisal as Pinhead from actor Doug Bradley, Revival aims to introduce new audiences to the discomfort of Hellraiser If a horror game gives its own director a physical reaction, it’s probably doing something right. While researching the images people find hardest to look at, game director Emil Esov discovered he has trypophobia – a fear of clusters of small holes. Rather than tone the scary images down, he fed them straight into Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival. The forthcoming first-person action-horror game drops players into a new story in Barker’s universe. Aidan Lynch must use the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to rescue his girlfriend from the Labyrinth as Pinhead, his Cenobites and a cult close in. But Revival is not built around jump scares. The team at Mad Head Games began with one question: what should players feel? The answer was discomfort. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在克莱夫·巴克 (Clive Barker) 本人的监督下，以及演员道格·布拉德利 (Doug Bradley) 饰演针头 (Pinhead) 的角色报复下，《复兴》旨在向新观众介绍《猛鬼追魂》的不适感。 如果一款恐怖游戏让自己的导演产生了身体反应，那么它可能做了正确的事情。在研究人们认为最难看的图像时，游戏总监埃米尔·埃索夫 (Emil Esov) 发现他患有密集恐惧症，即害怕成群结队的小洞。他没有淡化恐怖图像，而是将它们直接输入到克莱夫·巴克的《猛鬼追魂：复兴》中。即将推出的第一人称动作恐怖游戏将玩家带入巴克宇宙的新故事中。艾丹·林奇 (Aidan Lynch) 必须使用“创世配置”谜题盒将他的女朋友从迷宫中解救出来，而 Pinhead、他的修道士和一个邪教正在逼近。但复兴并不是建立在跳跃恐惧之上的。 Mad Head Games 的团队从一个问题开始：玩家应该感受到什么？答案是不舒服。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The creation of entertainment, even horror, pushes boundaries. As we explore new technologies and artistic expressions, the question arises: what is truly beneficial? While this game aims to disturb, it prompts reflection on the purpose and impact of what we create and consume, reminding us that not everything that is possible is also wise or good.
reflection.zh: 娱乐的创造，即使是恐怖内容，也在不断挑战界限。当我们探索新技术和艺术表达时，一个问题随之而来：什么才是真正有益的？虽然这款游戏旨在制造不安，但它促使我们反思所创造和消费内容的宗旨与影响，提醒我们并非所有可能的事物都是明智或有益的。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: London rollout of robotaxis delayed amid lack of guidance for firms to follow
title.zh: 由于缺乏企业遵循的指导，伦敦机器人出租车的推出被推迟

summary.en: Uber and Wayve had said they would start trips ‘later this summer’ but launch now looks unlikely this year Business live – latest updates The rollout of robotaxis on the streets of London is unlikely to happen this year, as regulatory and technical hurdles push back the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Uber and Wayve had said they would start trips ‘later this summer’ but launch now looks unlikely this year Business live – latest updates The rollout of robotaxis on the streets of London is unlikely to happen this year, as regulatory and technical hurdles push back the ambitious schedule set out by the UK government. Only weeks ago Uber and London-based Wayve were granted the first minicab licences in the capital to allow them to offer self-driving taxi rides to paying customers – but with a human safety driver in place, for now – and said they would start trips “later this summer” before a full public launch . Continue reading...
body.zh: Uber 和 Wayve 曾表示，他们将在“今年夏天晚些时候”开始出行，但现在看起来不太可能在今年推出。 商业直播 - 最新更新 今年不太可能在伦敦街头推出机器人出租车，因为监管和技术障碍推迟了英国政府制定的雄心勃勃的时间表。就在几周前，Uber 和总部位于伦敦的 Wayve 获得了伦敦首张小型出租车牌照，允许他们向付费客户提供自动驾驶出租车乘车服务，但目前配备了一名安全驾驶员，并表示他们将在“今年夏天晚些时候”全面公开推出之前开始出行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Would you pay for an algorithm to pick your friends? New social apps spread across cities
title.zh: 付费算法帮你交友？新型社交应用风靡城市

summary.en: With many adults admitting they feel lonely, meetup platforms offer the chance to make new connections. Would you pay £20 a month for the chance of making a friend, on the understanding that an algorithm – not you – gets to decide who you’ll meet? Driven by the decline of “third spaces” such as youth centres and pubs,...
summary.zh: 许多成年人承认感到孤独，约会平台提供了建立新联系的机会。你愿意每月支付20英镑来结交朋友，并且由算法决定你将与谁见面吗？由于青年中心和酒吧等“第三空间”的衰落、远程工作增加以及日益增长的孤独感——根据国家统计局的数据，16至29岁的成年人中有40%“总是、经常或有时”感到孤独——付费社交活动现在正变得流行。

body.en: With many adults admitting they feel lonely, meetup platforms offer the chance to make new connections Would you pay £20 a month for the chance of making a friend, on the understanding that an algorithm – not you – gets to decide who you’ll meet? Driven by the decline of “third spaces” such as youth centres and pubs, an increase in remote working and rising loneliness – 40% of adults aged 16 to 29 feel lonely “always, often or some of the time”, according to the Office for National Statistics – paid social events are now in vogue. Continue reading...
body.zh: 许多成年人承认他们感到孤独，聚会平台提供了建立新联系的机会。如果算法（而不是你）可以决定你会见谁，你会每月支付 20 英镑以获得结交朋友的机会吗？由于青年中心和酒吧等“第三空间”的衰落、远程工作的增加和孤独感的增加——根据国家统计局的数据，40% 的 16 至 29 岁成年人“总是、经常或有时”感到孤独——付费社交活动现在很流行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age where loneliness is increasingly prevalent, even leading people to pay for algorithm-driven social connections, it's vital to cultivate our inner lives. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. This practice can help counter the pervasive feelings of...
reflection.zh: 在这个孤独感日益普遍的时代，甚至有人愿意付费来获得算法驱动的社交联系，培养我们的内心生活至关重要。《腓立比书》4:8提醒我们要将心思意念集中在凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞的事，都要思念。这种操练有助于对抗普遍存在的孤立感，并引导我们走向更有意义的人际关系。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
title.zh: 人工智能淘金热吸引加密公司放弃比特币

summary.en: Companies that previously invested heavily in Bitcoin mining are now re-purposing their powerful computer infrastructure to support artificial intelligence development. This shift is occurring as Bitcoin's price has fallen significantly from its peak, while the AI sector is attracting billions in investment.
summary.zh: 曾大量投资比特币挖矿的公司，现在正将其强大的计算机基础设施重新用于支持人工智能开发。这一转变发生之际，比特币价格已从峰值大幅下跌，而人工智能领域正吸引着数十亿美元的投资。

body.en:
Companies that once filled warehouses with computers to earn Bitcoin - a process known as mining - are now using that computing power for AI.

Bitcoin mining companies invested large sums on giant banks of powerful computers as the price of Bitcoin rocketed in recent years .

But those mining companies have faced falling rewards since the value of the cryptocurrency has slumped from its peak in October 2025.

Now many are pivoting to AI and signing deals with companies such as Anthropic - who are spending billions of dollars on the infrastructure needed to keep up in the AI race.

Like AI systems, Bitcoin relies on vast networks of powerful computers housed in data centres.

Because Bitcoin operates without a central authority, these computers verify transactions and are rewarded with newly-created digital coins.

But the rewards have reduced and the value of coins has dropped since last year.

One bitcoin was worth about $124,000 (£91,000) at its peak in October 2025, but has since fallen sharply.

More recently, it has rallied to around $80,000 - meaning it is up almost 30% so far in August.

But, for companies that have already made the change, even that may not be enough to get them to return to the crypto industry, because the switch of use - once made - is expensive to undo.

Industry analysts say Bitcoin mining companies have been pivoting to AI because they have years of experience in finding cheap electricity and efficiently running large data centres.

TerraWulf, Ionic Digital, Core Scientific, Iris Energy, Bitdeer, Riot Platforms and Hut 8 are just some of the companies increasingly diverting investment and infrastructure from bitcoin mining towards AI.

Riot Platforms signed a $9bn, 20-year compute deal with Anthropic earlier this month.

TerraWulf's website once described the firm as an "infrastructure-focused bitcoin mining company".

Enegix, which opened a huge Bitcoin mining site in Kazakhstan to great fanfare in 2020, is now pivoting too.

"Today, we are moving confidently towards artificial intelligence and planning the gradual alignment of our energy and infrastructure capabilities, both in Kazakhstan and elsewhere, towards the development of AI infrastructure," said the company's chief executive Yerbolsyn Sarsenov.

Enegix says it is in active discussions with AI and HPC (high-performance computing) companies and planning to transform a "significant" portion of the business to AI.

But refitting crypto mines for AI is expensive and in some cases the companies have had to sell some of their Bitcoin holdings to fund the switch.

Wolfie Zhao from The Energy Mag - a publication that rebranded from The Miner Mag to reflect the trend - predicts the industry pivot will continue even as the price of Bitcoin has risen in recent days.

"We...
body.zh: 曾经在仓库里装满计算机来赚取比特币的公司（这一过程称为挖矿）现在正在将这种计算能力用于人工智能。 近年来，随着比特币价格的飙升，比特币挖矿公司向拥有强大计算机的巨型银行投入了大量资金。 但自从加密货币的价值从 2025 年 10 月的峰值下跌以来，这些矿业公司面临着回报下降的局面。 现在，许多人正在转向人工智能，并与 Anthropic 等公司签署协议——这些公司正花费数十亿美元购买人工智能竞赛所需的基础设施。 与人工智能系统一样，比特币依赖于数据中心内强大计算机组成的庞大网络。 由于比特币的运行没有中央权威，这些计算机会验证交易并获得新创建的数字硬币的奖励。 但从去年开始，奖励减少了，硬币的价值也下降了。 一枚比特币在 2025 年 10 月达到峰值时价值约 124,000 美元（91,000 英镑），但此后急剧下跌。 最近，它已反弹至 80,000 美元左右，这意味着 8 月份迄今已上涨近 30%。 但是，对于已经做出改变的公司来说，即使这样也可能不足以让他们重返加密货币行业，因为一旦改变用途，撤销的成本就很高。 行业分析师表示，比特币挖矿公司一直在转向人工智能，因为他们在寻找廉价电力和高效运行大型数据中心方面拥有多年的经验。 TerraWulf、Ionic Digital、Core Scientific、Iris Energy、Bitdeer、Riot Platforms 和 Hut 8 只是越来越多地将投资和基础设施从比特币挖矿转向人工智能的公司中的一部分。 Riot Platforms 本月早些时候与 Anthropic 签署了一项价值 90 亿美元、为期 20 年的计算协议。 TerraWulf 的网站曾将该公司描述为“一家专注于基础设施的比特币挖矿公司”。 Enegix 于 2020 年在哈萨克斯坦大张旗鼓地开设了一个大型比特币矿场，现在也正在转型。 该公司首席执行官 Yerbolsyn Sarsenov 表示：“今天，我们充满信心地迈向人工智能，并计划逐步调整我们在哈萨克斯坦和其他地方的能源和基础设施能力，以发展人工智能基础设施。” Enegix 表示，它正在与人工智能和 HPC（高性能计算）公司进行积极讨论，并计划将业务的“重要”部分转变为人工智能。 但为人工智能改造加密货币矿场成本高昂，在某些情况下，这些公司不得不出售部分比特币资产来为这一转变提供资金。 《能源杂志》（为反映这一趋势而从《矿工杂志》更名为《能源杂志》）的 Wolfie Zhu 预测，尽管比特币价格最近几天有所上涨，但行业的重心仍将持续。 “我们...

reflection.en: The rapid pivot of crypto firms from Bitcoin mining to AI, driven by market shifts and the promise of new billions, highlights the transient nature of earthly pursuits. Just as Bitcoin's value slumped from its peak, so too can any treasure we store up on earth prove fleeting. This story invites us to consider where our true and lasting investments lie.
reflection.zh: 加密货币公司因市场变化和数十亿美元的新机遇，迅速从比特币挖矿转向人工智能，这突显了世俗追求的短暂性。正如比特币的价值从高峰跌落一样，我们积攒在地上的一切财宝也可能转瞬即逝。这个故事邀请我们思考，我们真正持久的投资在哪里。

verse.textEn: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy.
verse.textZh: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏。

title.en: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
title.zh: 全球最繁忙航天港即将迎来一段沉寂期

summary.en: SpaceX is significantly reducing its launch frequency from Florida's Space Coast as it shifts focus toward the future Starship program. While the Falcon 9 has been a prolific workhorse with over 160 launches last year, the region will see a temporary lull until Starship operations are ready, likely around 2027.
summary.zh: SpaceX 正在大幅减少佛罗里达州太空海岸的发射频率，将其重点转向未来的星舰计划。尽管猎鹰 9 号去年完成了超过 160 次发射，是名副其实的“劳模”，但在星舰准备就绪之前（预计在 2027 年左右），该地区将进入一段暂时的沉寂期。

body.en: SpaceX made Florida's Space Coast home to the world's busiest spaceport for a decade, but that will change this year. The company is significantly cutting the number of launches from Florida until Starship arrives, a senior SpaceX official confirmed Tuesday. The Falcon 9 rocket has been SpaceX's workhorse, routinely launching batches of satellites for the company's Starlink network, primarily from launch pads at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. There were 165 Falcon 9 launches last year—about three flights per week—and about 75 percent of them carried Starlink satellites. This year is different. SpaceX has launched more missions from its West Coast launch pad at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California since January, and this trend will amplify for the rest of the year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 十年来，SpaceX 使佛罗里达州太空海岸成为世界上最繁忙的太空港，但今年情况将发生改变。 SpaceX 的一位高级官员周二证实，该公司将大幅削减在 Starship 抵达之前从佛罗里达州出发的发射次数。猎鹰 9 号火箭一直是 SpaceX 的主力，定期为该公司的星链网络发射批量卫星，主要是从卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的发射台发射。去年猎鹰 9 号发射了 165 次——大约每周 3 次——其中约 75% 携带星链卫星。今年有所不同。自 1 月份以来，SpaceX 从位于加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地的西海岸发射台发射了更多任务，这一趋势将在今年剩余时间内加剧。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The transition at Cape Canaveral reminds us that even the most relentless progress requires seasons of recalibration. As the Falcon 9 yields the stage to the next generation of Starship, we see that every great human endeavor has its rhythm of activity and waiting. In our own lives, we can trust Yahweh during the quiet seasons, knowing they are often the...
reflection.zh: 卡纳维拉尔角的这一转型提醒我们，即使是最不懈的进步也需要重新调整的季节。当猎鹰 9 号为下一代星舰让出舞台时，我们看到人类的每一项伟大事业都有其活跃与等待的节奏。在我们的生活中，我们可以在安静的季节里信靠雅伟，因为这些时期往往是通往新高度的必要序曲。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
title.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会：跑者打破纪录，却也起火燃烧

summary.en: The World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing showcased robots sprinting faster than human records, but many struggled with basic stability, crashing into barriers or catching fire. While the speed is impressive, the event highlighted that these machines still lack the nuanced control required for practical tasks or even...
summary.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会上，机器人展示了超越人类纪录的冲刺速度，但许多机器人难以保持基本稳定性，撞上障碍物甚至起火。虽然速度令人印象深刻，但此次活动凸显了这些机器在执行实际任务或安全停止方面仍缺乏细微的控制能力。

body.en: Viral videos of the World Humanoid Robot Games show sprinting robots beating the human 100-meter record held by Usain Bolt—but also feature running robots crashing into barriers and falling down because they cannot readily stop running. A few fallen robots even break at the waist in a shower of sparks or catch on fire. That demonstration of both robotic prowess and limitations came from the second edition of the World Humanoid Robot Games hosted in Beijing from August 22–26. Like the inaugural event held in 2025, this year’s event challenged humanoid robots to run fast, perform kung fu or dance moves, fight one another in kickboxing, and play soccer or table tennis. This year’s games also tested robots in more humdrum practical scenarios like washing and hanging laundry, where they appeared to lag behind typical human working speeds. That suggests the event organizers, including Chinese state media and the Beijing city government, are keen to showcase the commercial potential of humanoid robots at a time when China’s robotics industry is rapidly developing and testing such robots. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会的病毒视频显示，短跑机器人打破了尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的人类 100 米纪录，但也有跑步机器人因无法轻易停止奔跑而撞上障碍物并摔倒的情况。一些坠落的机器人甚至在一阵火花中腰部折断或着火。 8 月 22 日至 26 日在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人运动会展示了机器人的实力和局限性。与 2025 年举办的首届赛事一样，今年的赛事挑战人形机器人快速奔跑、表演功夫或舞蹈动作、踢拳击、踢足球或乒乓球。今年的比赛还在更单调的实际场景中测试了机器人，例如洗衣和晾衣服，它们似乎落后于人类的典型工作速度。这表明，在中国机器人行业正在快速开发和测试此类机器人之际，包括中国官方媒体和北京市政府在内的活动组织者热衷于展示人形机器人的商业潜力。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The spectacle of robots outrunning Olympic legends only to crash into barriers reminds us that speed is not the same as mastery. In our rush to push the boundaries of what is possible, we often neglect the stability and control necessary for true utility. Yahweh invites us to seek a wisdom that values the 'beneficial' over the merely 'possible,' ensuring...
reflection.zh: 机器人跑赢了奥运传奇却撞上障碍物，这一奇观提醒我们，速度并不等同于掌控。在我们急于突破可能性的界限时，往往忽略了真正实用所需的稳定性和控制力。雅伟邀请我们寻求一种智慧，看重“有益”过于仅仅是“可能”，确保我们的工具既卓越又可靠。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Preserving glow-in-the-dark art and fashion for future generations
title.zh: 为子孙后代保存夜光艺术与时尚

summary.en: Understanding unique photochemistry of such materials will help in conservation, storage, and exhibition.
summary.zh: 了解这些材料独特的物理化学特性将有助于其保存、储存和展览。

body.en: Fashionistas of a certain age no doubt remember the late designer Stephen Sprouse , who gave Blondie's Debbie Harry her distinctive Bowery punk style. Sprouse's first collections in the mid-1980s made a major splash, melding graffiti prints, a playful '60s aesthetic, and bright Day-Glo colors that won admirers such as Andy Warhol. Several examples of Sprouse's work are preserved in the textiles collection of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, where conservationists are trying to learn more about the phosphorescent and fluorescent pigments the designer used in his creations in order to keep the colors from dulling over time. They described recent advances in that research at a meeting of the American Chemical Society (ACS) held this week in Chicago. Scientists began describing minerals that glowed in the dark as phosphors in the Middle Ages. Typically, such materials take on a charge when exposed to light, storing the absorbed energy and releasing it gradually as re-emitted light. Henri Becquerel discovered radioactive decay in 1896 because of his work with phosphorescent uranium salts: He left the salts in a closed drawer with photographic plates, which fogged up even without a light source. DayGlo paints and similar materials exploit the related phenomenon of fluorescence. DayGlo pigments fluoresce in daylight by essentially converting UV light into visible light to produce brighter, more vibrant colors. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 某个年龄段的时尚达人无疑还记得已故设计师 Stephen Sprouse，他为 Blondie 的 Debbie Harry 赋予了独特的 Bowery 朋克风格。 Sprouse 在 20 世纪 80 年代中期推出的首个系列引起了巨大轰动，融合了涂鸦印花、俏皮的 60 年代美学以及明亮的 Day-Glo 色彩，赢得了安迪·沃霍尔 (Andy Warhol) 等崇拜者的青睐。纽菲尔德印第安纳波利斯艺术博物馆的纺织品收藏中保存了斯普罗斯作品的几个例子，那里的自然资源保护主义者正在尝试更多地了解设计师在他的创作中使用的磷光和荧光颜料，以防止颜色随着时间的推移而变暗。他们在本周于芝加哥举行的美国化学会 (ACS) 会议上描述了该研究的最新进展。中世纪时，科学家们开始将在黑暗中发光的矿物质描述为磷光体。通常，此类材料在暴露于光时会带电，存储吸收的能量并以重新发射的光的形式逐渐释放能量。 1896 年，亨利·贝克勒尔 (Henri Becquerel) 在研究磷光铀盐时发现了放射性衰变：他将盐放在一个装有照相底片的封闭抽屉中，即使没有光源，底片也会起雾。 DayGlo 涂料和类似材料利用了相关的荧光现象。 DayGlo 颜料在日光下发出荧光，本质上是将紫外线转化为可见光，从而产生更明亮、更鲜艳的颜色。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The dedicated work of conservationists at the Indianapolis Museum of Art, researching the unique photochemistry of Stephen Sprouse's glow-in-the-dark creations, reflects a profound commitment to preserving human ingenuity and beauty. Their efforts to understand these hidden properties for future generations echo the wisdom that finds glory in diligently...

title.en: Google's anti-nausea Motion Assist dots finally rolling out on Android
title.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能终于在安卓系统上推出

summary.en: Google's Motion Assist dots, designed to alleviate motion sickness by addressing the sensory mismatch between the inner ear and eyes, are now slowly rolling out on Android, currently appearing only on Pixels running Android 17.
summary.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能旨在通过解决内耳和眼睛之间的感官不匹配来缓解晕动症，目前正在安卓系统上缓慢推出，仅在运行安卓17的Pixel手机上可见。

body.en: Some people are cursed with motion sickness, which can make it impossible to read or use a phone in a moving vehicle without suffering waves of nausea. There's a surprisingly simple trick that can make smartphones usable in such situations. Apple deployed it on the iPhone a couple of years ago, and now Google's own version is finally coming (slowly) to Android. Motion sickness is caused by a disagreement between what your inner ear senses and what your eyes see. If you're looking at a book or a screen while in a car, the sensory mismatch can lead to a pretty unpleasant time. As part of iOS 18 in 2024, Apple released a feature called Motion Cues that places a network of moving dots on the screen to alleviate motion sickness, and it seems to work surprisingly well. Google's version is similar, but it's called Motion Assist. Google began testing Motion Assist back in 2024, but it never expanded beyond an internal test until now. Android Authority reports Motion Assist is appearing on Pixel phones running Android 17, but there's no app or update you can install to get the feature—it's being delivered by Play Services as part of a staged rollout. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 有些人患有晕车症，在行驶的车辆中阅读或使用手机时会感到一阵阵恶心。有一个令人惊讶的简单技巧可以使智能手机在这种情况下可用。几年前，苹果公司在 iPhone 上部署了它，现在谷歌自己的版本终于（缓慢地）登陆 Android 了。晕动病是由于内耳感觉与眼睛看到的不一致引起的。如果你在车里看书或看屏幕，感官上的不匹配可能会导致一段非常不愉快的时光。作为 2024 年 iOS 18 的一部分，苹果发布了一项名为 Motion Cues 的功能，该功能在屏幕上放置移动点网络来缓解晕动病，而且效果似乎出奇的好。谷歌的版本类似，但它被称为Motion Assist。谷歌早在 2024 年就开始测试 Motion Assist，但直到现在才扩展到内部测试之外。 Android Authority 报告称，Motion Assist 出现在运行 Android 17 的 Pixel 手机上，但您无法安装任何应用程序或更新来获取该功能，该功能由 Play Services 作为分阶段推出的一部分提供。阅读全文 评论

This technological solution, now rolling out on Android, reflects the "glory of kings" in searching out matters, applying knowledge to improve daily life. It...

title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: Australia's music charts have banned songs largely or wholly created by AI, a move that follows a controversy where an AI-remixed Madonna song topped the dance charts and was widely streamed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜已禁止主要或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲，此前一首由人工智能混音的麦当娜歌曲曾登上舞曲榜榜首并被广泛播放，引发了争议。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

body.zh: 大部分或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲已被禁止出现在澳大利亚音乐排行榜上。 澳大利亚唱片工业协会（ARIA）表示，新准则将有助于“促进艺术的人性化”。 此前，澳大利亚 DJ Josh Fawaz 翻唱了麦当娜的《Like A Prayer》引发争议，该歌曲最近登上了 ARIA 舞曲单曲榜榜首，并在该国总体排行榜上排名第二。 这首歌已成为商业广播电台播放列表的主要内容，仅在 Spotify 上的播放量就超过 4800 万次。 ARIA 表示，澳大利亚艺术家正在“在历史上最拥挤的市场”中争夺注意力，并且“对推广或庆祝不包含人类艺术性的人工智能生成音乐的成功不感兴趣”。 根据新规则，仍然可以使用人工智能辅助，但歌曲必须由人类创作，并演奏主唱和主要乐器。 人工智能仍然可以用于掌握歌曲，例如使用鼓机和自动调音。 今年早些时候，瑞典音乐排行榜禁止一首歌曲，因为它是由人工智能创作的。 7 月，国际唱片业联合会 (IFPI) 表示，人工智能指南将在拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和东南亚推出，用于其官方排行榜。 更新后的代码基于 IFPI 指令，还排除了引发“流媒体或图表操纵问题”的音乐。 ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示：“这些变化反映了我们在这个快速发展的领域保持活力并提升艺术人性的意图。” “艺术家已经在他们的工作中使用人工智能工具，图表可以而且应该不断发展以为此留出空间，但通过基于艺术家录音的服务批量生成的音乐是另一回事。” 她补充道：“奖励未经许可的人工智能输出的图表将削弱我们所代表的录制音乐的基础。” 艺术家在提交歌曲供排行榜考虑时将被要求声明人工智能的使用。 ARIA 表示，如果后来发现音乐主要是由人工智能生成的，它可以回顾性地调整排行榜位置，如果这首作品名列榜首，它可能会要求退回为达到第一名而颁发的奖项。 上个月，他们在 Instagram 上分享了 2014 年热门歌曲《High》的人工智能辅助版本，标题是：“当你用人工智能重新录制自己的歌曲时，澳大利亚电台就会播放它。” 乐队成员亚当·海德 (Adam Hyde) 在第九频道的《今日》节目中表示，人工智能生成的音乐正在“消除人类的生活体验”。 今年 7 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 承诺为澳大利亚创意人员提供“尽可能最强的保护”，使其免受人工智能的侵害。 阿尔巴尼斯承诺作家和音乐家将...

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 首相称分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 他的评论发表之际，政府敦促TikTok和其他社交媒体公司删除逆行驾驶视频。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.

body.zh: 政府敦促社交媒体公司删除庆祝危险驾驶的帖子，总理安迪·伯纳姆称分享这些帖子“真正应受谴责”。 早些时候，国防部长卢克·波拉德 (Luke Pollard) 告诉 BBC 早餐会，“社交媒体公司可以轻松删除这些内容，并调整其算法以阻止其传播”。 周六，一辆在双车道上逆行的汽车在米德尔斯堡附近撞上了他们的车，两名警察死亡。另一辆车上的五名乘客也被杀。 据信，这五名乘客之一、18 岁的马凯·萨丁顿 (Makai Saddington) 的 TikTok 账户此前曾分享过看似危险驾驶的视频，但这些视频已被删除。 但克利夫兰警方表示，“没有证据表明周五晚上和周六早上发生的活动的拍摄是为了 TikTok 的目的”。 波拉德表示，政府“已经采取措施”要求社交媒体公司删除此类内容。 他补充道：“他们确切地知道他们网站上有什么内容，他们知道他们的算法是如何工作的。 “他们还知道，人们发布内容是为了获得观看次数，获得的观看次数越多，有时你就能获得金钱，因此发布令人震惊的内容以吸引更多人观看是一种经济激励。” 伯纳姆在基辅对记者表示，那些分享美化危险驾驶视频的人“正在做真正应受谴责的事情”。 唐宁街发言人表示，“为了剪辑和娱乐而美化危险驾驶是完全可耻的”。 她补充说，文化大臣已经明确表示，社交媒体平台应“根据其法律义务”删除视频，并且 Ofcom 得到政府“全力支持对那些不履行职责的人采取行动”。 具有非法活动的视频内容本身不一定是非法的 - 根据《在线安全法》 - 由社交网络决定标记的内容是否非法并采取相应行动。 TikTok 表示，其政策禁止可能造成严重人身伤害的内容，包括危险驾驶。 它补充说，它正在积极删除违反其规则的视频和帐户，包括据信属于萨丁顿的帐户。 该公司表示，2026 年 1 月至 3 月期间，99.8% 的内容因违反其主动删除的政策而被删除。 虽然 TikTok 下架了一些视频，但这并不一定是因为它认为这些视频非法，而可能只是因为它们违反了公司自己的条款和条件。 《在线安全法》中规定了一些特定的例外情况，但它们可能很难解释。 例如，内容...

title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch和亚马逊因使用直播内容训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 该诉讼指控Twitch未经主播许可或未给予适当补偿，就使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

body.zh: 亚马逊因在流行的流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频来训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“完善创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

title.en: ‘You can taste the ash’: surviving in America’s wildfire smoke capital
title.zh: “你可以尝到火山灰的味道”：在美国野火烟雾之都生存

summary.en: A magical corner of Oregon has the highest US rate of wildfire smoke deaths. How do residents live with the haze – and grief? Driving into the county, you can’t miss the sign. “IT’S THE CLIMATE”. Continue reading...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A magical corner of Oregon has the highest US rate of wildfire smoke deaths. How do residents live with the haze – and grief?

Locals tell me it’s a flex – or was before the irony set in. This evergreen corner of Oregon , near the California border, is a beautiful tangle of mountains and forest carved out by the Rogue and Illinois rivers. Once upon a time, the climate was the draw. Cool and wet in the winters, sunny but not too hot in the summers. The forests protected you from unbearable heat beyond the ridge.

Across the US and Europe this summer, people have choked beneath red skies and endured extraordinarily unhealthy air – scenes that would be grimly familiar to anyone in the American west.

Josephine county is the deadliest place for wildfire smoke in the US, according to a 2025 study published in Nature magazine. It ties with Trinity county, California, as having the highest rate of wildfire smoke deaths linked to climate breakdown between 2006 and 2020, the years the researchers analyzed, with an estimated 17 premature deaths per 100,000 people.

They describe ash falling from the sky and coating their cars like snow. “You can taste it!” says Cynthia Hewitt, a retiree and restaurant owner . When the smoke is particularly thick, she wets towels and wedges them around her doorframes to try to prevent the haze from coming into her living room. “It gets on the furniture and everything,” she says.

Everything includes wine. If you taste certain bottles from bad smoke years, I’m told, that campfire tang clings to the grapes.

Randi Maldonado, a beautician I met in a hair salon with two workers and three air purifiers, tries to calm her toddler’s lungs by sitting in the bathroom with the door closed and hot water roaring from the bathtub faucet. “Like a humidifier,” she says. It helps her child breathe.

Her mother, Kim Williams, the other salon worker, tells me that her client’s husband died not long after leaving the windows open overnight during a wildfire smoke inundation.

A local nurse, Joann Reed, says the smoke has gotten so bad in recent years that even hospitals can’t keep it out. She recalls a summer, a few years ago now, when a hospital where she was working tasked employees with standing near exits, in part to shut doors as fast as possible. “You could see a smoke cloud, just a haze, as you walked up and down the hallways,” she tells me. “There’s no filtration system strong enough to get rid of that much constant smoke.”

Some wear masks. Others wish they were brave enough to wear masks but they get tired of the stares from people who still see masks as code for “woke America”. (Josephine county is far more conservative than Oregon’s familiar “Portlandia” tropes. More than one person suggests to me that the way to solve the wildfire...
body.zh: 俄勒冈州的一个神奇角落是美国野火烟雾死亡率最高的地方。居民如何忍受雾霾和悲伤？ 当地人告诉我，这是一种弯曲，或者说是在讽刺出现之前。俄勒冈州的这个常绿角落，靠近加利福尼亚州边境，是由罗格河和伊利诺伊河冲刷而成的美丽的山脉和森林。曾几何时，气候是吸引人的因素。冬季凉爽湿润，夏季阳光充足但不太炎热。森林保护你免受山脊之外难以忍受的炎热天气的影响。 今年夏天，在美国和欧洲，人们在红色的天空下窒息，忍受着极其不健康的空气——这些场景对于美国西部的任何人来说都是非常熟悉的。 根据《自然》杂志 2025 年发表的一项研究，约瑟芬县是美国野火烟雾最致命的地方。它与加利福尼亚州三一县相关，因为在 2006 年至 2020 年研究人员分析的年份中，与气候崩溃相关的野火烟雾死亡率最高，估计每 10 万人中有 17 人过早死亡。 他们描述说，火山灰从天而降，像雪一样覆盖了他们的汽车。 “你可以尝尝！”退休人员兼餐馆老板辛西娅·休伊特 (Cynthia Hewitt) 说道。当烟雾特别浓时，她会弄湿毛巾并将其塞在门框上，以防止烟雾进入客厅。 “它会沾到家具和所有东西上，”她说。 一切都包括酒。有人告诉我，如果你尝了一些烟味不好的年份的酒，葡萄上就会沾上篝火的味道。 我在一家美发沙龙遇到了美容师兰迪·马尔多纳多（Randi Maldonado），她带着两名工作人员和三台空气净化器，她坐在浴室里，关着门，浴缸水龙头里喷出热水，试图让孩子的肺部平静下来。 “就像加湿器一样，”她说。它可以帮助她的孩子呼吸。 她的母亲金·威廉姆斯（Kim Williams）是另一位沙龙工作人员，她告诉我，她客户的丈夫在一场野火烟雾淹没中打开窗户过夜后不久就去世了。 当地护士乔安·里德 (Joann Reed) 表示，近年来烟雾变得非常严重，即使是医院也无法阻止。她回忆起几年前的一个夏天，当时她工作的一家医院要求员工站在出口附近，部分原因是尽快关门。 “当你在走廊里走来走去时，你可以看到烟雾云，只是薄雾，”她告诉我。 “没有足够强大的过滤系统来消除那么多持续的烟雾。” 有些人戴着口罩。其他人希望自己有足够的勇气戴上口罩，但他们厌倦了那些仍然将口罩视为“觉醒的美国”代号的人的目光。 （约瑟芬县比俄勒冈州熟悉的“波特兰迪亚”比喻保守得多。不止一个人向我建议解决野火的方法......

title.en: Scientists discover 149 new deep-sea species at remote Indian Ocean seamounts
title.zh: 科学家在偏远的印度洋海山发现149种深海新物种

summary.en: An expedition to the central eastern Indian Ocean, specifically around Christmas and Cocos islands, has uncovered 149 new deep-sea species. This region, accounting for a fifth of global ocean area, has been relatively understudied despite 90% of it reaching depths greater than 1,000 meters.
summary.zh: 一支探险队在印度洋中东部，特别是圣诞岛和科科斯群岛附近，发现了149种深海新物种。该区域占全球海洋面积的五分之一，尽管其中90%的深度超过1000米，但其深海生物多样性此前相对未被充分研究。

body.en: The Indian Ocean accounts for about a fifth of global ocean area, with 90% of it reaching deeper than 1,000 meters (3,280 feet). Yet compared to the Pacific and Atlantic, its deep-sea biodiversity is relatively understudied — particularly the seamounts of the ocean’s central eastern region. An expedition that surveyed dozens of these volcanic underwater mountains around the Christmas and Cocos islands, located southwest of the Indonesian island of Jakarta between Australia and Sri Lanka, has revealed remarkable marine animal biodiversity along the Indian Ocean seafloor. Published in Deep-Sea Research Part II: Topical Studies in Oceanography in June, the resulting study details 149 new species, including a sea cucumber from the genus Oneirophanta, a new fish from the greeneye family (Chlorophthalmus), and a parasitic barnacle from the genus Rhizolepas. Researchers surveyed at depths ranging from 94 to 5,431 m (308 to 17,818 ft), mapping a dark abyssal seafloor punctuated by 40 to 120-million-year-old volcanic seamounts that can be up to 70 kilometers (43 miles) across. They had never been studied before, study lead author Tim O’Hara, a marine scientist at Museums Victoria in Melbourne, told Mongabay. “People had been around the islands in shallow water before, but no one had looked at life in the deep. It was a massive hole in the data,” O’Hara said. Mapping remote underwater mountains Getting to these sites required time. The islands are so remote that, leaving from Darwin on the northern coast of Australia, it took nearly seven days to arrive at Christmas…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度洋约占全球海洋面积的五分之一，其中 90% 的深度超过 1,000 米（3,280 英尺）。然而，与太平洋和大西洋相比，其深海生物多样性的研究相对较少，尤其是海洋中东部地区的海山。一支探险队对圣诞岛和科科斯群岛周围的数十座水下火山进行了勘察，发现了印度洋海底显着的海洋动物生物多样性。圣诞岛和科科斯岛位于印度尼西亚雅加达岛西南部，位于澳大利亚和斯里兰卡之间。这项研究成果于 6 月发表在《深海研究第二部分：海洋学专题研究》上，详细介绍了 149 个新物种，包括 Oneirophanta 属的海参、绿眼鱼科 (Chlorophamus) 的一种新鱼，以及 Rhizolepas 属的寄生藤壶。研究人员在 94 至 5,431 m（308 至 17,818 英尺）的深度进行了勘察，绘制了黑暗的深渊海底，其中点缀着 40 至 1.2 亿年前的火山海山，直径可达 70 公里（43 英里）。研究主要作者、墨尔本维多利亚博物馆的海洋科学家蒂姆·奥哈拉 (Tim O’Hara) 告诉 Mongabay，以前从未对它们进行过研究。 “人们以前曾在浅水区的岛屿周围活动过，但没有人观察过深海中的生命。这是数据中的一个巨大漏洞，”奥哈拉说。绘制偏远水下山脉地图 到达这些地点需要时间。这些岛屿太偏远了，从澳大利亚北海岸的达尔文出发，花了近7天的时间才到达圣诞节……本文最初发表于Mongabay

reflection.en: The discovery of 149 new deep-sea species in the Indian Ocean reminds us of the incredible depth and diversity of Yahweh's creation. From the volcanic seamounts near Christmas and Cocos islands, these hidden creatures testify to a wisdom that fills the Earth with countless wonders, many still unknown to us. It invites us to marvel at the intricate life...

summary.en: In 2024, the price of cacao on world markets spiked dramatically, nearly quintupling from what it had been a year earlier. Prices have since dropped, but along with a land crunch in Côte d’Ivoire, the world’s top producer of the commodity, the prospect of high financial rewards...

body.en: In 2024, the price of cacao on world markets spiked dramatically, nearly quintupling from what it had been a year earlier. Prices have since dropped, but along with a land crunch in Côte d’Ivoire, the world’s top producer of the commodity, the prospect of high financial rewards have helped to drive a rapid expansion of new plantations in the forests of southeastern Liberia. This region contains some of West Africa’s last intact rainforest. The land on which these plantations are being developed is customarily owned by local communities, and many of their residents have been eager to reap the rewards of the cacao market. Handshake deals between them and migrants from neighboring Côte d’Ivoire and Burkina Faso is now driving a wave of deforestation. “The people of the southeast, where you have a lot of forests, have realized or seen that cocoa can give them more money than they get from other traditional things like charcoal burning and subsistence farming,” says Liberian journalist James Giahyue. “It’s like a new phenomenon, and a new opportunity.” As editor-in-chief of news outlet The DayLight, Giahyue has guided extensive coverage of environmental issues in Liberia. He was an integral member of a Mongabay reporting team that published an investigation into deforestation there this past July. He spoke to Ashoka Mukpo from his base in Monrovia. The following interview has been lightly edited for clarity. Mongabay: A big part of the cocoa story in Liberia is migration. So many of these cocoa workers that…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 2024 年，世界市场上的可可价格大幅飙升，几乎是一年前的五倍。此后价格有所下降，但随着世界最大商品生产国科特迪瓦的土地紧缩，高额经济回报的前景推动了利比里亚东南部森林中新种植园的迅速扩张。该地区拥有西非最后一些完整的雨林。开发这些种植园的土地通常归当地社区所有，许多居民都渴望获得可可市场的回报。他们与邻国科特迪瓦和布基纳法索的移民之间的握手协议正在推动一波森林砍伐浪潮。利比里亚记者 James Giahyue 表示：“拥有大量森林的东南部地区的人们已经意识到或看到，与烧炭和自给农业等其他传统产业相比，可可可以给他们带来更多的钱。” “这就像一种新现象，也是一个新机会。”作为新闻媒体《日光报》的主编，Giahyue 指导了对利比里亚环境问题的广泛报道。他是 Mongabay 报告小组的重要成员，该小组于去年 7 月发表了一份关于当地森林砍伐的调查报告。他在蒙罗维亚的基地与阿育王穆克波进行了交谈。为了清晰起见，以下采访经过轻微编辑。 Mongabay：利比里亚可可故事的一个重要部分是移民。如此多的可可工人......本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Kenyan investigators arrest 4 people linked to 18 Amboseli elephant deaths
title.zh: 肯尼亚调查人员逮捕了与 18 头安博塞利大象死亡有关的 4 人

summary.en: At least four suspects have been arrested in connection with the deaths of 18 elephants in the Amboseli ecosystem in southern Kenya, near the border with Tanzania. Preliminary investigations by a multiagency team suggest poisoning from agricultural pesticides, authorities say....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: At least four suspects have been arrested in connection with the deaths of 18 elephants in the Amboseli ecosystem in southern Kenya, near the border with Tanzania. Preliminary investigations by a multiagency team suggest poisoning from agricultural pesticides, authorities say. In July, 16 elephants were found dead at Kimana Sanctuary and Kuku Group Ranch in the Amboseli ecosystem. The death toll rose to 18 in August, after two more elephant carcasses were found in Kitenden B reserve, near the Amboseli National Park. On Aug. 21, Kenya Wildlife Service’s (KWS) communication director Duncan Wanyama told Mongabay by phone that another elephant was in critical condition in Amboseli and under close watch by animal experts. The KWS has previously said that most of the elephants found dead were female and their calves. Investigations have led to the recovery of substances, including chemicals that are potentially toxic, and “unlabelled materials”, which have been secured for further scientific analysis, Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Tourism and Wildlife Rebecca Miano said in a statement seen by Mongabay. “Although the investigations remain active, the arrest of persons of interest and the recovery of exhibits do not in themselves establish criminal culpability,” she said. Miano added that a suspect believed to have crucial information about the killings of the elephants was still at large. Initial investigations indicated that the elephants died after ingesting a toxic substance, with laboratory tests pointing to cyanide. The elephants were thought to have come into contact with the chemical in pesticides sprayed on tomatoes…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 至少四名嫌疑人因涉嫌在肯尼亚南部靠近坦桑尼亚边境的安博塞利生态系统中死亡 18 头大象而被捕。当局表示，多机构小组的初步调查表明，中毒事件是由农业杀虫剂引起的。 7月，安博塞利生态系统的基马纳保护区和库库群牧场发现16头大象死亡。 8 月份，在安博塞利国家公园附近的 Kitenden B 保护区又发现了两具大象尸体，死亡人数上升至 18 人。 8月21日，肯尼亚野生动物管理局（KWS）通讯主管邓肯·万亚马（Duncan Wanyama）通过电话告诉Mongabay，另一头大象在安博塞利处于危急状态，并受到动物专家的密切关注。 KWS此前曾表示，大部分被发现死亡的大象都是雌性及其幼象。肯尼亚旅游和野生动物内阁秘书丽贝卡·米亚诺（Rebecca Miano）在 Mongabay 看到的一份声明中表示，调查已回收了一些物质，包括可能有毒的化学物质和“未标记的材料”，这些物质已被确保进行进一步的科学分析。她说：“尽管调查仍在进行中，但逮捕相关人员和追回证物本身并不能确定刑事责任。”米亚诺补充说，一名据信拥有有关大象被杀的重要信息的嫌疑人仍然在逃。初步调查表明，大象是在摄入有毒物质后死亡的，实验室检测结果显示是氰化物。大象被认为接触了喷在西红柿上的杀虫剂中的化学物质……这篇文章最初发表在 Mongabay 上

summary.en: JOHANNESBURG, South Africa — York Timber Holdings signed a 10-year renewable electricity agreement with electricity trader Discovery Green for power for its Jessievale sawmill in June 2026. Renewables will now make up approximately 90% of the mill’s electricity use, and the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: JOHANNESBURG, South Africa — York Timber Holdings signed a 10-year renewable electricity agreement with electricity trader Discovery Green for power for its Jessievale sawmill in June 2026. Renewables will now make up approximately 90% of the mill’s electricity use, and the agreement is a trend that is spreading amongst commercial users in South Africa. “The 10-year agreement gives York Timbers access to renewable electricity at scale, while improving long-term certainty regarding electricity costs,” said Linmari Pelser, the company’s group risk and compliance officer. Discovery Green is a subsidiary of one of South Africa’s largest health insurance schemes; Discovery’s renewable energy division works with companies that want to increase energy efficiency and shift to renewables, including “wheeling” agreements like the one with York Timber. Under the agreement, York Timber’s electricity will still arrive over the same infrastructure, but Discovery Green will coordinate the equivalent amount of power being fed into the national grid from a range of solar and wind producers across the country. York Timber also operates a 700 kW solar farm at the mill. Pelser said the agreement will reduce the sawmill’s greenhouse gas emissions, while reducing its exposure to electricity tariff hikes and potential future carbon-based costs, such as South Africa’s Carbon Tax. This tax on greenhouse gas emissions was introduced in 2019, and generous allowances that allowed most polluters to pay only a fraction of their assessed costs are scheduled to be lifted this year. Dan Ginsberg, head of actuarial and research and development at Discovery Green,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 南非约翰内斯堡 — 2026 年 6 月，York Timber Holdings 与电力交易商 Discovery Green 签署了一项为期 10 年的可再生电力协议，为其 Jessievale 锯木厂提供电力。可再生能源目前将占该工厂用电量的约 90%，该协议正在南非商业用户中蔓延。 “这项为期 10 年的协议使 York Timbers 能够大规模获得可再生电力，同时提高电力成本的长期确定性，”该公司集团风险与合规官 Linmari Pelser 表示。 Discovery Green 是南非最大的健康保险计划之一的子公司； Discovery 的可再生能源部门与希望提高能源效率并转向可再生能源的公司合作，包括与约克木材公司签订的“轮换”协议。根据协议，约克木材公司的电力仍将通过相同的基础设施到达，但 Discovery Green 将协调全国范围内一系列太阳能和风能生产商向国家电网输送的等量电力。 York Timber 还在工厂内运营着一个 700 千瓦的太阳能发电厂。佩尔瑟表示，该协议将减少锯木厂的温室气体排放，同时减少其电价上涨和未来潜在的碳成本（例如南非的碳税）的风险。这项温室气体排放税于 2019 年开始征收，预计今年将取消允许大多数污染者仅支付其评估成本一小部分的慷慨补贴。 Discovery Green 精算和研发主管 Dan Ginsberg……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: El Niño is disrupting the Pacific’s marine food web from the bottom up
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象正在自下而上地破坏太平洋的海洋食物网

summary.en: As the 2026 El Niño strengthens in the equatorial Pacific, satellites are capturing the first major signs of disruption to the marine food web. According to by NASA’s Earth Observatory observations, satellite measurements show a substantial drop in surface concentrations of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: As the 2026 El Niño strengthens in the equatorial Pacific, satellites are capturing the first major signs of disruption to the marine food web. According to by NASA’s Earth Observatory observations, satellite measurements show a substantial drop in surface concentrations of chlorophyll across the Central Pacific compared with neutral conditions in June 2025. Chlorophyll is the pigment that helps plants absorbs sunlight to generate energy, and its reduction indicates a decline in phytoplankton, the base of the ocean’s food webs. Hyung-Gyu Lim, an associate professor of oceanography at Chonnam National University in South Korea, told Mongabay by email that a developing El Niño can slow the process of upwelling, where nutrient-rich cold waters rise from the ocean depths to the surface. “This may trigger less nutrient supply. It is not surprising for me,” Lim said. Matthew Kehrli and Graham Trolley, oceanographers at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center, wrote in a NASA Earth Observatory article that El Niño can suppress upwelling because easterly equatorial trade winds weaken, causing the warm surface layer of the ocean to extend deeper. They added that as El Niño progresses, chlorophyll concentrations will likely decrease further over a broader region. The ecological consequences of this nutrient decline would mean less food available for zooplankton, as well as for fish, seabirds, and marine mammals, the NASA Earth Observatory article said. This affects fisheries: Peru’s anchovy fisheries, for example, saw significant declines in catch during previous El Niño events, driven by warmer surface waters, reduced upwelling, and lower…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 随着 2026 年厄尔尼诺现象在赤道太平洋加强，卫星正在捕捉到海洋食物网遭到破坏的第一个主要迹象。根据美国宇航局地球观测站的观测，卫星测量显示，与 2025 年 6 月的中性条件相比，中太平洋表面叶绿素浓度大幅下降。叶绿素是帮助植物吸收阳光产生能量的色素，其减少表明浮游植物（海洋食物网的基础）的减少。韩国全南国立大学海洋学副教授 Hyung-Gyu Lim 通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay，正在发展的厄尔尼诺现象可以减缓上升流的过程，即营养丰富的冷水从海洋深处上升到海面。 “这可能会导致营养供应减少。这对我来说并不奇怪，”林说。美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的海洋学家马修·科尔利和格雷厄姆·特罗利在美国宇航局地球观测站的一篇文章中写道，厄尔尼诺现象可以抑制上升流，因为东赤道信风减弱，导致海洋温暖的表层延伸得更深。他们补充说，随着厄尔尼诺现象的发展，叶绿素浓度可能会在更广泛的地区进一步下降。美国宇航局地球观测站的文章称，这种营养物质下降的生态后果将意味着浮游动物以及鱼类、海鸟和海洋哺乳动物的食物减少。这会影响渔业：例如，秘鲁的凤尾鱼渔业在之前的厄尔尼诺事件中，由于地表水变暖、上升流减少和水位下降，渔获量大幅下降。本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

body.en: Jack Klein takes heat readings, gives fans to overheated passengers and lugs big jugs of water into the stations On a recent August day in the subterranean furnace of New York City’s subway, one bearded, curly haired man was studying his phone for different reasons than the other wilting passengers – to track the soaring temperatures and ponder how underground train stations can cool down in an era of climate crisis. Jack Klein, a 31-year-old construction site manager, has in the past two years taken it upon himself to become a sort of guerrilla subway heat operative, sticking teardrop-shaped thermometers to steel beams in seven of the hottest Manhattan stations and posting social media videos of the hades-like summer temperatures that commuters have to endure. Continue reading...

May we embrace practices that honor Yahweh's creation, recognizing that all...

title.en: ‘I love rats but we can’t live with them’: the headache of rising rodent populations around the world
title.zh: “我爱老鼠，但我们无法与它们共存”：全球啮齿动物数量上升带来的难题

summary.en: Robert Corrigan, a renowned rodentologist, has dedicated his life to studying rats and believes there are improved methods for managing their increasing populations in urban areas. Despite the challenges they pose, he expresses a personal fondness for the rodents, acknowledging they have supported his career.
summary.zh: 著名鼠类学家罗伯特·科里根毕生致力于研究老鼠，并认为有更好的方法来管理城市中不断增长的鼠类数量。尽管老鼠带来了挑战，但他个人对这些啮齿动物怀有喜爱之情，并承认它们支撑了他的职业生涯。

body.en: Robert Corrigan has been dealing with the ‘smart’ rodents all his life – and believes there are better solutions to deal with the growing infestation in the world’s cities “The rodents have paid for every single bill I’ve ever had – every mortgage, every car payment, every pint of Guinness,” says Dr Robert Corrigan. “It’s been a great ride and I’m still at it.” New York-based Corrigan is one of the most respected voices in the world of rodentology. Now in his 70s, he has devoted his entire adult life to studying rats and our relationship with them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 罗伯特·科里根 (Robert Corrigan) 一生都在与“聪明”的啮齿动物打交道，他相信有更好的解决方案来应对世界城市中日益严重的鼠害问题。“啮齿类动物为我支付的每一笔账单都付了钱——每笔抵押贷款、每笔汽车付款、每一品脱吉尼斯黑啤酒，”罗伯特·科里根博士说。 “这是一次很棒的旅程，我仍然坚持下去。”总部位于纽约的科里根是啮齿动物学界最受尊敬的声音之一。现年 70 多岁的他将整个成年生活奉献给了研究老鼠以及我们与它们的关系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights the global challenge of rising rodent populations, a 'headache' for cities worldwide. While we seek 'better solutions' to manage these infestations, the expert Robert Corrigan's surprising affection for rats reminds us of a deeper truth. Genesis 1:31 declares that Yahweh saw all He had made, and it was 'very good,' inviting us to...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了全球范围内不断增长的鼠类数量所带来的挑战，对世界各地的城市来说都是一个“难题”。当我们寻求“更好的解决方案”来管理这些鼠患时，专家罗伯特·科里根对老鼠出人意料的喜爱提醒我们一个更深层的真理。创世记1:31宣告雅伟看他所造的一切都“甚好”，这邀请我们思考所有受造物的内在价值，即使是那些对人类生活空间构成挑战的部分。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Bomb Fishing Is Wreaking Havoc on Indonesia's Coral Reefs
title.zh: 炸弹捕鱼正在摧毁印度尼西亚的珊瑚礁

summary.en: Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”
summary.zh: 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸作业的渔民每年引爆超过8,000枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Inside Climate News and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”

Nicknamed the “Amazon of the Seas,” the Coral Triangle is the world’s most biologically diverse marine ecosystem. Sink below the surface and you’ll encounter the sound of a vibrant symphony of snapping shrimp, crunching crustaceans, and feeding fish.

But then the rhythmic music of life will dissolve into eerie silence, punctured only by the plosive boom of detonating bombs.

Off the coast of Indonesia’s Spermonde Archipelago, underwater microphones captured over 3,500 explosions in just 3,600 hours of recording, according to researchers from the Zoological Society of London.

The source? Blast fishing — a globally banned technique that uses plastic bottles packed with explosives to stun and kill everything in a 90-foot radius. The highly destructive practice has been documented in at least 34 countries, from Lebanon and Libya to Brazil and Ecuador.

While fishers predominantly use the method to catch fish for sale at local markets — identifiable by their ruptured internal organs and burst swim bladders — it’s also a grave threat to colorful coral reef habitats.

“Bomb fishing is quite likely the leading cause of reef loss in this area,” said Ben Williams, the paper’s lead author, noting that a single bomb can wreak 200 square feet of destruction. “These picturesque reefs get converted into a landscape that looks like the moon. It’s just rubble and dead coral with very little sign of life.”

In 2023, researchers from Britain and Indonesia snorkeled down and anchored $150 audio recorders to short stakes in the seafloor. Using A.I. software — which the team has now made open-source — they scoured 16 months of audio in just a few hours to identify possible detonations.

While the A.I. filtered suspected cases, each suggested sound wave was then manually verified to assess if it stemmed from a bomb or a misfiring boat engine.

With sound traveling over four times faster through water than air, the team of marine scientists were able to detect detonations from over 10 miles away.

“When [the bombs] are close, it’s so loud that it can shake you out of your skin,” said Williams. “But if you put your head up on the surface, you probably can’t even see the boat that did it.”

Accounting for stormy-season setbacks and spearfishermen who tampered with the recorders, the team calculated that there were likely more than 8,500 blasts each year — all within an area of just 350 square miles.

With a bomb dropped once every 62 minutes, the...
body.zh: 本文最初由《内部气候新闻》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛海岸作业的渔民每年会引爆 8,000 多枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。 珊瑚三角区被誉为“海洋亚马逊”，是世界上生物多样性最丰富的海洋生态系统。沉入水面以下，您会听到虾虾、甲壳类动物咀嚼和鱼儿喂食的充满活力的交响乐声。 但随后，生命的节奏音乐将消失在令人毛骨悚然的寂静中，只有炸弹爆炸的爆炸声刺破这一切。 据伦敦动物学会的研究人员称，在印度尼西亚斯佩蒙德群岛海岸附近，水下麦克风在短短 3,600 小时的记录中捕捉到了 3,500 多次爆炸。 来源？爆破捕鱼——一种全球禁止的技术，使用装有炸药的塑料瓶来击晕并杀死 90 英尺半径内的所有物体。从黎巴嫩、利比亚到巴西和厄瓜多尔，至少有 34 个国家记录了这种极具破坏性的做法。 虽然渔民主要使用这种方法捕捞鱼类并在当地市场出售（可以通过内脏破裂和鱼鳔破裂来识别），但它也对色彩缤纷的珊瑚礁栖息地构成严重威胁。 该论文的主要作者本·威廉姆斯 (Ben Williams) 表示：“炸弹捕鱼很可能是该地区珊瑚礁消失的主要原因。”他指出，一枚炸弹就可以造成 200 平方英尺的破坏。 “这些风景如画的珊瑚礁变成了看起来像月亮的景观。它只是碎石和死珊瑚，几乎没有生命迹象。” 2023 年，来自英国和印度尼西亚的研究人员潜入海底，将价值 150 美元的录音机固定在海底的短木桩上。使用人工智能该团队现已将软件开源，他们在短短几个小时内搜索了 16 个月的音频，以识别可能的爆炸。 虽然 A.I.过滤掉可疑病例后，每个建议的声波都会被手动验证，以评估它是否源于炸弹或失火的船发动机。 由于声音在水中传播的速度比空气中传播的速度快四倍多，海洋科学家团队能够探测到 10 英里外的爆炸。 “当[炸弹]靠近时，声音非常大，可以把你震得浑身不舒服，”威廉姆斯说。 “但如果你把头伸出水面，你可能甚至看不到那艘船。” 考虑到暴风雨季节的挫折和鱼叉渔民篡改记录仪的情况，该团队计算出每年可能发生超过 8,500 次爆炸——所有爆炸都发生在仅 350 平方英里的区域内。 每 62 分钟投下一颗炸弹，...

reflection.en: The tragic destruction of Indonesia's coral reefs by bomb fishing, with over 8,000 explosives detonated annually, serves as a stark reminder of how the pursuit of immediate wealth can devastate creation. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can lead to all kinds of evil, and here we see it turning vibrant ecosystems like the "Amazon of the Seas" into...
reflection.zh: 印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸的炸弹捕鱼每年引爆超过8,000枚炸药，将珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”，这悲剧性地提醒我们，对眼前财富的追求如何能摧毁受造物。雅伟的话语警告说，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它将“海洋亚马逊”这样充满活力的生态系统变为一片废墟和“诡异的寂静”。这种做法不仅伤害环境，最终也损害了依赖这些宝贵资源的社区的长期福祉。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Sydney shark attack survivor describes moment she came to face-to-face with ‘monster’
title.zh: 悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者描述与“怪兽”面对面的时刻

summary.en: Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old mother and teacher, shared her first interview after losing an arm in a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee Beach in June. She recalled that during the terrifying encounter, her primary thoughts were of her one-year-old daughter, which helped her endure the ordeal.

body.en: In her first media interview since the June incident, Leah Stewart, 34, says her thoughts while being bitten were of her one-year-old daughter An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs has recalled the moment she came face-to-face with the “monster”. Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old teacher and mother of a one-year-old daughter, was attacked by a large shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 34 岁的莉亚·斯图尔特 (Leah Stewart) 在 6 月事件发生后首次接受媒体采访时表示，在被咬伤时，她的脑海里浮现的是自己一岁的女儿。 一名澳大利亚妇女在悉尼东郊海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去了一只手臂，她回忆起自己与“怪物”面对面的那一刻。 6 月 13 日，34 岁的教师 Leah Stewart 是一名一岁女儿的母亲，她在库吉海滩晨泳时遭到大鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the terrifying silence of a life-threatening crisis, our deepest loves often become our strongest anchors. Leah Stewart’s focus on her young daughter during the attack reminds us that even in the darkest 'valleys,' the bonds of family provide a profound reason to persevere. We pray for her continued physical and emotional healing as she navigates life...
reflection.zh: 在生命受到威胁的恐怖寂静中，我们最深沉的爱往往成为最坚固的锚。利亚·斯图尔特在遭受袭击时对幼女的牵挂提醒我们，即使在最黑暗的“幽谷”中，家庭的纽带也能提供坚持下去的深刻动力。我们为她在经历如此创伤后的身体和情感康复祈祷，愿雅伟在悲剧后的余波中与她同在。

verse.textEn: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
verse.textZh: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在。

Yahweh's word in Jeremiah reminds leaders of their mandate to "do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who...

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
